raw.title: Product Manager
raw.excerpt: Viget is an independent digital agency that has been designing and building digital products and platforms since 1999.
raw.description:
Viget is an independent digital agency that has been designing and building digital products and platforms since 1999. Our culture is ideal for lifelong learners seeking a variety of meaningful work, supportive collaboration with positive teammates, and a healthy work/life balance. We work from four offices (hybrid) and remote locations throughout the U.S., and enjoy a proven cadence of virtual and in-person meetings and retreats to build camaraderie and stay connected. We work with tech companies (like Robinhood and SpectrumAi), non-profits (like World Wildlife Fund and NPF), and consumer brands (like Stern Pinball and ESPN).
As a Product Manager at Viget, you’ll work on a variety of projects, including complex content and ecommerce sites, but most importantly custom software products. You’ll facilitate product design sprints, define and prioritize requirements, collaborate with our brilliant designers and developers to design and build products, lead quality assurance, and celebrate launches.
At Viget, Product Managers are experts in building digital products. They work collaboratively with clients (often startups) to understand organization goals, define solutions, answer hard questions, and ensure the overall quality of a product. They facilitate product planning and discovery, lead requirements gathering and feature definition, oversee technical delivery (working closely with our engineers), and conduct QA. They have a technical acumen and effectively collaborate with both internal teams and clients on technical matters.

Here are a few examples of the kind of work you’d lead:

  • Bringing a Series B-funded clean energy startup’s established web-based product to native mobile with a team of product designers and React Native developers;
  • Taking a founder’s idea for Optify from concept to prototype to a well-defined product equipped with a name and brand strategy;
  • Partnering with SpectrumAi to design and build Twyll, a modern clinical session-management tool that enables ABA therapists to capture real-time data, and streamline documentation.

Here's what we are looking for:

  • You have worked in a fast-paced software development environment before, either at an agency or product company, though agency experience is preferred.
  • You know how the web works and how a web app works, which means you’re aware of technical constraints when talking to clients. You don’t hesitate to ask a lot of questions in order to define the functionality of what we’re building.
  • You can break down a set of wireframes into actionable tasks for back-end and front-end developers. You’re passionate about finding innovative, efficient, and effective ways to document those tasks.
  • You can shepherd often-vague client requests and ideas through the definition process. You know when to rely on a product designer, but you’re comfortable thinking through logic and creating useful documentation of that logic.
  • You’re able to describe workflows and tasks purely from an end user’s perspective, helping developers make informed implementation decisions.
  • You’ve performed QA. You can distinguish a bug from a functional update from a new feature request. You don’t write merely good bug reports. You write better bug reports – or, at least, that’s your goal each and every time.
  • You have 2 to 10 years of professional experience in a product management role, ideally within an agency.

Project Management at Viget:

  • The project management team at Viget includes two roles:
  • Project Managers own planning, management, and delivery of a variety of project types, including marketing sites, content sites, e-commerce sites, and custom software efforts.
  • Product Managers specialize in the discovery, technical planning, management, and delivery of digital products and custom software.

Everyone at Viget:

  • Embodies our core values of integrity, work ethic, collaboration, creativity, and lifelong learning.
  • Values mentorship, learning, and sharing knowledge.
  • Writes and speaks clearly and effectively when collaborating with teammates and clients.
  • Believes in and supports our commitment to building a diverse and inclusive company.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Annual base salary of $75,000 - $105,000 (mid level) or $95,000 to $125,000 (senior) per year depending on skills and experience
  • Additional comp available via spot performance bonuses, sales referrals, and new hire referrals
  • 401(k) retirement plan matching up to 4%
  • 100% company-paid health and dental coverage for you and your family
  • Stipends for wellness (apps, gyms, etc.) and connectivity (mobile phone or home internet)
  • 15 days PTO (20 after 2 years), 9 paid holidays, and 2 community service days per year
  • Up to $2,000/year in conference and training (professional development) budget

How to Apply:

Apply by completing the application form. We expect you may use AI for research, prep, and proofreading during the job application process. We use AI daily and believe that building AI skills is essential, but at this stage we need to get to know you. To that end, unless directed otherwise, we expect you will not submit AI-generated answers or assignments (writing, coding, designing) nor use AI for real-time help during interviews. Using AI tools to misrepresent your knowledge, ability, or experience is unethical. It’s also impractical and short-sighted since once you’re in the role you’ll often need to think and communicate in real-time without AI help. As a small team with high standards for quality and, above all, integrity, we ask that you write your own application answers, submit work that reflects the real you, and share openly how you used AI in the application process if at all.
We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications and are actively seeking people from underrepresented groups to join our team.
Before you apply, learn more about us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Flickr, X, Vimeo, and by exploring .
Viget maintains a drug-free workplace. We are unable to offer work visa sponsorship at this time.
Viget is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all of us feel valued and heard. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, socioeconomic status, religion, mental or physical disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. raw.description:
About XTEL

XTEL is a leader in advanced, AI-driven solutions for consumer goods companies, combining cutting- edge technology, industry expertise, and data management to accelerate profitable revenue growth and value realization.

Position Overview

XTEL is hiring a Cybersecurity Engineer to strengthen XTEL’s security posture across our platform, applications, and Microsoft environment. You’ll join a growing Security & Compliance team that already maintains a mature compliance foundation (ISO 27001:2022, SOC 2 Type 2, SOC 1 Type 2, ISAE 3402) and an established GRC function, alongside a managed SOC, an IT team, and a Cloud Operations team.

This is a very hands-on role where you’ll lead vulnerability management, work with Engineering and Product to embed security into the SDLC, partner with IT & Cloud Operations to continuously harden our Microsoft environments, and drive triage and remediation of issues surfaced by our SOC. Because you’ll work alongside existing IT, Cloud Operations, and GRC capabilities, success depends on collaboration and influence as much as technical depth.

The ideal candidate must be proactive and self-directed: actively seeking out opportunities to improve security across the organization and able to operate effectively with limited guidance and oversight.

Key Responsibilities

  • Vulnerability management. Own intake, triage, risk-based prioritization, remediation tracking, validation, SLAs, and reporting across our Azure environments (dev, test, prod, and customer-facing) and the development pipeline.

  • Secure SDLC & CI/CD. Partner with Engineering, Product, and QA to continually improve secure development practices:

  1. Pipeline security and security gates in CI/CD.

  2. SAST, DAST, IAST, dependency/software composition (SCA), and code scanning.

  3. Secure code review practices, threat modeling, and security requirements in design.

  • Microsoft environment hardening. Work continuously with IT to further secure infrastructure - identity and access management, endpoint protections, M365 controls, and configuration/hardening baselines.

  • SOC-driven remediation. Coordinate and drive triage and remediation for alerts, incidents, and vulnerabilities reported by XTEL’s SOC, including root cause follow up.

  • Penetration testing. Coordinate external penetration tests (scope, execution support, findings management, retesting and closure), and conduct internal testing.

  • Patch management. Support patch management processes and verification in partnership with IT and Cloud Operations.

  • Cloud security partnership. Partner with Cloud Operations on Azure security architecture, secure-by-design patterns, CSPM, secrets management, and network security.

  • Compliance & audit support. Support security audits and continuous compliance (ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2 Type 2, ISAE 3402), including evidence collection and control improvement.

  • Cross-functional enablement. Translate security findings into clear, actionable guidance for engineers and into evidence and inputs for the GRC function.

  • Continuous improvement. Proactively identify and act on opportunities to raise the security bar across the organization.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 3+ years in cybersecurity engineering, security operations, DevSecOps, or security-focused IT (cloud-native SaaS experience strongly preferred, ideally on Azure).

  • Vulnerability management: Proven track record running vulnerability management beyond scanning - prioritizing and driving remediation to closure across teams.

  • Application & SDLC security: Working knowledge of AppSec and SDLC controls (CI/CD security, SAST/DAST/IAST/SCA, secure code review) and the ability to embed security without slowing delivery.

  • Microsoft environment: Hands-on experience securing Microsoft environments (Entra ID, Intune, Conditional Access, endpoint protections, M365 controls).

  • Cloud security: Working knowledge of Azure security services and cloud security posture management.

  • Self-direction: Ability to work independently, set priorities, and build or mature programs in a lean environment with limited guidance.

  • Communication & ownership: Strong communicator who can drive work and build trust across Engineering, Product, Cloud Operations, IT, and Compliance.

  • English: English proficiency

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity operating within an ISO 27001 / SOC 2 environment and supporting audits.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and securing CI/CD at scale.

  • Hands-on penetration testing or offensive security experience (e.g., OSCP).

  • Experience with compliance automation tooling (e.g., Drata).

  • Relevant certifications (e.g., GIAC, CISSP, AZ-500, SC-200, SC-300).

Who You Are:

  • Proactive and self-starting - you find work that needs doing and do it without waiting to be told.

  • Pragmatic and risk-based - you focus effort where it reduces the most risk and balance security with delivery.

  • Collaborative - you achieve outcomes through influence across teams you don’t manage.

Geographical Location:

  • Belgium, Leuven.

  • Europe Remote

What We Offer

  • Remote or Hybrid working set-up 🏡

  • Flexible working hours;⌚

  • Competitive Salary Package and Bonus scheme;💸

  • A challenging role in a fast-growing AI-driven company; 🪄

  • A diverse and international team with strong ownership and a can-do mentality.🌏

  • Opportunities to contribute meaningfully to the organization’s growth and development.🚀

Equal Opportunities Statement

If you have strengths to share, we’d love to hear from you. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences, so don’t hesitate to apply even if you don’t meet all criteria.

XTEL is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

raw.excerpt: Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home.
raw.description:
Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

Anyone can make a product look good. Can you make it sell?
At Zulay Kitchen, we’re looking for a creative thinker who can turn everyday kitchen products into something people actually want to buy.

Every image is an opportunity to grab attention, stand out from the competition, and drive sales.

Why Zulay?
Because your work doesn’t end when you export an image. You’ll see how your designs perform, learn from real results, and keep pushing your creativity further.

Your next design could help create our next bestseller.Ready for the Challenge?

JOB OVERVIEW:


Plans, directs and coordinates human resource management activities at the professional level to maximize the strategic use of human resources and maintain functions such as team member compensation, benefits, recruitment, personnel policies and procedures, training and regulatory compliance. Acts as internal consultant by analyzing and recommending solutions to human resource issues. Responsible for management of staff as assigned.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Serves as a link between management and TSMs by handling questions, interpreting and administering contracts and helping resolve work-related problems and administering disciplinary procedures. Advises managers on organizational policy matters such as EEO and sexual harassment, and recommends needed changes. Advises HR management on the plans and strategies of assigned client areas. Creates and implements appropriate support as needed including but not limited to coaching, counseling, staff changes, etc.
  • Creates or assists in the development of various human resource plans and processes. Administers compensation, benefits, performance management systems, and safety and community service programs. Provides current and prospective TSMs with information about policies, job duties, compensation, TSM development and benefits. Plans and conducts new TSM orientation to foster positive attitudes toward organizational objectives. Develops and maintains positive rapport with TSM’s at all levels. Participates in departmental team meetings and advises departments on HR related events and plans. Represents and fosters the Henry Schein spirit in all day to day activities.
  • Plans, directs, supervises and coordinates work activities of staff relating to all HR responsibilities and functions. Assists HR team in creating and communicating training programs, compensation planning and benefit updates as required. May assist in administrative support of processes including but not limited to: job descriptions, recruitment, compensation evaluations, policies, reporting, etc. Monitors career path programs for self and assists staff with their development needs by coaching, mentoring or otherwise assisting others to improve their knowledge or skills. SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:


  • 8 - 10+ years Human Resource experience, 5+ in a supervisory or management function.
  • Excellent communication and management skills. Knowledge of business and management principles involved in strategic planning, human resource modeling, leadership techniques and coordination of people and resources. Adept at all HR competencies i.e. compensation, benefits, employee relations, negotiations and employment law. Knowledge of HR/Personnel practices and principles; able to use relevant information and individual judgment to determine whether events or processes comply with laws, regulations or standards, and ability to confidently handle sensitive or emergency situations. Good planning, time management, communication, decision making, presentation, human relations and organizational skills. Solid understanding of technology and proficiency in Microsoft Office programs required. Previous experience with integrated payroll/HRIS system helpful.

GENERAL SKILLS & COMPETENCIES:


  • Strong management and leadership skills and ability to attract, retain, motivate, develop and mentor team members for high performance
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills and ability to resolve disputes effectively

  • Excellent independent decision making, analysis and problem solving skills
  • Understand and act on financial information that contributes to business profitability
  • Ability to plan and manage successful projects; understand available resources, develop timeline, budget, assign tasks and areas of responsibility
  • Lead team(s) to achieve company goals in creative and effective ways
  • Excellent planning and organizational skills and techniques
  • Communicate effectively with senior management

  • Ability to influence, build relationships, understand organizational complexities and manage conflict
  • Broad professional and managerial skills with a good understanding of industry practices and company policies and procedures
  • Ability to lead virtual teams

WORK EXPERIENCE:


Typically 10 or more years of increasing responsibility and complexity in terms of any applicable professional experience; 1 or more years of management experience.

PREFERRED EDUCATION:


Typically a Bachelor's Degree or global equivalent in related discipline. Master's degree or global equivalent a plus.


TRAVEL / PHYSICAL DEMANDS:


Travel typically less than 10%. Office environment. No special physical demands required.

raw.description:
The role

Natterbox runs a cloud communications platform that our customers depend on every day. As a Junior Platform Engineer, you will join the Platform team to help keep it reliable, secure and well understood. You will work alongside senior engineers, learn how our platform operates, and build automation that reduces manual effort.

This is a strong step for someone with early cloud or infrastructure experience who wants to grow into a platform or site reliability career. We expect you to use AI tools in your daily work, for example to troubleshoot faster, write and review scripts, and keep runbooks current.

What you’ll do

  • Support the day-to-day running of our AWS infrastructure under the guidance of senior engineers.
  • Monitor system health, investigate alerts and help resolve incidents.
  • Take part in our on-call rota, initially as secondary alongside a senior engineer, moving to primary once you are ready.
  • Own the Staging environment, keeping it representative of Production so that we catch issues before customers do.
  • Write scripts and infrastructure as code to automate repetitive operational tasks.
  • Contribute to infrastructure migration and modernisation work as the platform evolves.
  • Apply security best practice and help evidence compliance with ISO 27001 and other regulatory frameworks.
  • Document procedures, runbooks and configurations so that knowledge is shared and not held by one person.
  • Respond to requests from other teams where they relate to the platform, prioritised through the Platform team’s queue.

Requirements

What we’re looking for

Essential

  • At least 6 months of practical platform or infrastructure experience.
  • Hands-on experience with core AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, CloudWatch, VPC), from work, study or personal projects.
  • Working knowledge of Linux, including the command line and basic troubleshooting.
  • Some scripting experience (Python or Bash).
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and a methodical approach to diagnosing issues.
  • Clear communication, especially when writing up incidents and procedures.
  • Curiosity and a willingness to learn, including how to use AI tools effectively and responsibly.
  • Available for on-call rota coverage during evenings into the night and weekends.
  • Must be in the UK.

Desirable

  • Exposure to infrastructure as code (Terraform or CloudFormation).
  • Familiarity with Git, GitHub and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Interest in telecoms or VoIP.
  • AWS certification (for example Cloud Practitioner or Solutions Architect Associate).
  • Experience supporting internal teams during incidents, platform requests, or escalations.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary of £32-£35 annually
  • 25 days holiday increasing to 30 days after 2 years
  • Private health insurance (after probationary period)
  • Enhanced Family Leave
  • Cycle to work
  • Allowance of £50 per month to cover the costs of home-working
  • Perkbox: A range of outstanding employee discounts
  • Access to EAP

A Note on Using AI in Your Application

At Natterbox, we love modern technology and actively encourage using generative AI tools like ChatGPT or GitHub Copilot in our daily engineering work to troubleshoot faster and build automation. We certainly don’t mind if you use AI to help refine your CV or check your application.

However, please don’t use AI to present yourself as someone you are not. We are hiring an authentic early-career engineer with real curiosity, honest learning stumbles, and genuine potential and not an artificial, flawless persona.

Please ensure that all application answers and technical summaries are written in your own words and reflect your actual hands-on experience. Most importantly, AI tools must not be used to generate answers during live interview stages or technical assessments. We want to get to know you, how you think through problems, and how we can support your growth as a platform engineer.

Minimum Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

The starting salary range posted for this position is $131,900.00 to $166,600.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation*, equity, or benefits.

Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.

U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

  • 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees

  • 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco

  • Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees

  • Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)

  • 80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next

  • Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members

  • Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:

  • .75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;

  • 1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and

  • Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

Strategics Analytics Manager (Marketing Measurement Partner)

Job Details

Role: Strategic Analytics Manager (Marketing Measurement Partner)
Department: Data & Measurement
Job Location: Remote (Canada)
Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)
Compensation: $109,000 - $147,000 CAD + Profit Sharing (after 1 year of employment) + Benefits
Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.

The Role

Joining Thrive’s Data & Measurement department as Strategic Analytics Manager, you’ll own Strategic Analytics / Marketing Measurement workflows that drive growth across our clients marketing programs. You’ll partner with internal media teams and client marketing teams by providing measurement consultation and delivering technical insights that inform business decisions. You’ll be a core part of our lift experimentation program, leading client lift tests from design through execution to final presentation. You’ll also support clients and media teams with broader data and measurement capabilities, including measurement reporting, customer or event-level analysis, or media mix modelling, and help shape the evolution of Thrive’s strategic marketing measurement service.

Your focus will of responsibilities will be:

  • Domain: Own marketing measurement outcomes through strategic and technical lenses, from scoping client objectives, to executing analysis and presenting insights. This will involve designing and executing geo lift tests, building analyses and insights reporting, and consulting client and internal teams on the right measurement approaches.
  • Client: Be the measurement lead across client partnerships, working with paid media teams to turn data into insights and decisions that clients can act on.
  • People: Serve as a strategic translator between data and marketing teams, supporting product feedback loops, identifying gaps, and driving integrated project success. Contribute to Thrive’s knowledge across marketing measurement and strategic analytics by educating non-technical stakeholders.
  • Company: Build Thrive's capacity to lead marketing measurement strategy by refining playbooks, sharing knowledge, and strengthening cross-department roadmaps and systems. Support our Data & Measurement department’s broader service and product evolution to drive stronger marketing analytics insights, tools and strategy across our client roster.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:

  • In your first 30 days you’ll focus on learning Thrive’s systems, building relationships with your team, and understanding our current operating model. You’ll immerse yourself in existing or onboarding client workflows and begin to get acquainted with our in-house measurement solutions across lift experimentation and media mix modelling.
  • In your first 60 days you’ll begin to support Strategic Analytics / Measurement client workflows across geo lift experimentation, custom reporting and analysis, and measurement consultation.
  • In your first 90 days you’ll begin to own Strategic Analytics / Measurement client workflows to advance insights and measurement outcomes. You’ll collaborate with the Data & Measurement team on priority initiatives across measurement service evolution and incoming client partnerships.

Qualifications

  • Marketing Measurement Expertise: You have deep experience with marketing measurement tools, advertising privacy, lift experimentation, attribution, and/or media mix modelling. You understand which data and signals matter most for marketing investment decisions.
  • Growth Marketing Acumen: You're fluent in marketing metrics and unit economics across ecommerce and/or B2B demand generation (e.g., ROAS, CPA, CPM, CAC, LTV, ROI, brand lift, MQL/SQL) and apply them in your analysis and consulting.
  • Technical Data Rigour: You use data to uncover root causes and challenge assumptions, leveraging SQL, Python, and LLMs to troubleshoot discrepancies and build custom analyses and reporting.
  • Consultative Influence: You have a proven track record of influencing marketing executives, gaining buy-in on complex measurement approaches, and translating data into actionable business decisions.
  • Curiosity & Adaptability: You thrive in fast-moving environments, embrace evolving methods and services, and see change as an opportunity to grow.

---

Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

raw.description:
Astrolab is The Lunar Operations Company. We design and build the systems and hardware the lunar economy will come to depend on — rovers, power, and data networks for sustained operations on the Moon. We are focused on the problems that must be solved before the next chapter of human exploration can scale. The Moon does not forgive untested assumptions. The people who work here know that, and they wouldn't have it any other way.

As a GNC engineer at Astrolab, you will be responsible for designing, analyzing, and testing Guidance, Navigation, and Control algorithms for our lunar rover fleet. You will support development and maturation of GNC for crewed, semi-autonomous, and fully autonomous rover operations. GNC engineers own hardware selection and characterization, algorithm development and tuning, algorithm and integrated performance analysis, and verification and validation for the GNC subsystem. You will work with simulated environment as well as test vehicles to design, mature, and prove GNC functionality and performance.

Note: Some travel may be required for this position

What you'll do:

  • Define GNC subsystem and algorithm requirements
  • Design, analyze, develop, tune, verify, and validate rover GNC algorithms and support conversion of algorithm prototypes into FSW
  • Contribute to the development of the GNC simulation
  • Work with avionics and other engineering teams to select GNC sensors such as IMUs, star trackers, cameras, LiDARs, etc.
  • Support GNC sensor characterization, calibration, and testing
  • Support development of integrated hardware/software GNC subsystem testbeds
  • Develop GNC algorithm documentation and work with vehicle software team to convert prototypes into flight code, including supporting unit and integrated testing of flight implementations
  • Work with vehicle software team, avionics team, mobility team, and integration and test team to verify GNC subsystem implementation and performance
  • Support field testing of GNC software using test vehicles in a variety of lighting and terrain conditions
  • Develop GNC analysis and test plans and perform GNC analysis and testing on hardware in the loop testbeds
  • Support vehicle integration and testing of GNC functions
  • Develop vehicle level calibration plans and support vehicle level calibrations

What you'll bring:

Basic Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 3+ years of professional experience developing Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) systems
  • Experience with Python and familiarity with C++
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience developing path planning, obstacle avoidance, or similar algorithms
  • Experience designing, tuning, and testing Extended Kalman Filters for vehicle state estimation.
  • Experience designing, tuning, and testing vehicle control algorithms (e.g., high-gain antenna pointing)
  • Experience building, testing, and validating GNC simulation tools
  • Experience performing GNC performance analysis, including Monte Carlo analysis
  • Experience supporting GNC development from initial concept through flight operations
  • Experience collaborating across multidisciplinary engineering teams to mature GNC designs into flight software
  • Strong technical writing and verbal communication skills

Benefits and Perks

  • Join a team of best-in-class engineers building the foundation of planetary surface exploration
  • Equity ownership in the company
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and mental health support
  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Flexible PTO and parental leave
  • Home office set up reimbursement
  • Weekly lunch stipend, plus complimentary snacks and beverages on-site
  • Once a month social hour on-site with food and drinks

Gorilla Logic is looking for an experienced Senior Fullstack Java Software Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development, maintenance, and modernization of enterprise applications, backend services, and data integration solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Apache Airflow, and relational databases, along with experience working with Java MVC architectures and modern frontend technologies, preferably Vue.js, although experience with React, Angular, or similar frameworks will also be considered. We are also looking for engineers who are highly comfortable incorporating AI-assisted development tools into their daily workflows to improve productivity, code quality, troubleshooting, and software delivery. In this role, you will work across the full application stack, supporting both modern and legacy systems while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable software solutions.

What you'll do

  • Design, develop, and maintain fullstack enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, and modern frontend technologies.
  • Maintain and modernize legacy Java applications following MVC architectural patterns.
  • Develop and enhance user interfaces using Bootstrap 5, Vue.js, React, Angular, or similar technologies.
  • Build and integrate RESTful APIs, microservices, and backend services.
  • Configure and maintain Apache Airflow environments, developing DAGs and integrations using operators to orchestrate data processing workflows.
  • Design and implement ETL workflows and data integrations across enterprise systems.
  • Work with PostgreSQL and other relational databases to support application functionality and data processing.
  • Implement communication between services using RabbitMQ or similar messaging technologies.
  • Integrate applications with enterprise systems, billing platforms, and external services.
  • Participate in architectural discussions, code reviews, testing, and deployment activities.
  • Actively leverage AI-assisted development tools throughout the software development lifecycle, including coding, debugging, testing, code reviews, and technical problem-solving.
  • Apply engineering judgment and validation practices to ensure AI-generated code meets quality, security, and maintainability standards.
  • Identify opportunities to improve development workflows and engineering productivity through AI-assisted tools and practices.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, including fullstack development with Java.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java 9, 11, or 17.
  • Strong experience with Spring Boot, preferably versions 3.5 or 4.x.
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow, including configuring environments from scratch, developing DAGs, and implementing integrations using operators.
  • Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL, SQL, and relational database design.
  • Experience maintaining or developing legacy Java applications using MVC architecture.
  • Frontend development experience with Vue.js, React, Angular, or similar frameworks, along with familiarity with Bootstrap 5.
  • Understanding of microservices architecture and inter-service communication using RabbitMQ or similar messaging technologies.
  • Basic understanding of ETL processes, data pipelines, and system integrations.
  • Strong familiarity and hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Google Gemini, Cursor, or similar solutions throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Ability to effectively leverage AI tools for coding, debugging, troubleshooting, testing, code reviews, and development tasks while independently validating AI-generated outputs.
  • Experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs.
  • Strong understanding of software design principles, clean code, and development best practices.
  • Experience with Git, Agile methodologies, and distributed development teams.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and technical ownership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience developing frontend applications using Vue.js.
  • Experience implementing AI-driven workflows or integrating AI-powered capabilities into software applications (a plus).
  • Familiarity with AI Engineering Harnesses, including structured AI development workflows, automated validation, and feedback mechanisms (a plus).
  • Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures and LLM integrations (a plus).
  • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), MCP servers, or AI tool integrations (a plus).
  • Experience with Python for scripting, automation, or data processing.
  • Experience with Zuora or similar subscription management and billing platforms.
  • Familiarity with ERP systems, invoicing, and enterprise billing processes.
  • Experience with Snowflake or similar data warehousing solutions.
  • Experience with Microsoft SQL Server (MS SQL).
  • Experience with AWS or other cloud platforms.
  • Experience with Docker and Testcontainers.
  • Familiarity with Test-Driven Development (TDD).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Business Financial Group | Job Description

Engagement:Part-time consulting engagement for a U.S. client

Work arrangement:Remote, with availability for scheduled U.S. business-hour meetings

Time commitment: 15-20monthly hours; additional availability may be needed during initial stabilization

Compensation:To be discussed based on experience and agreed scope

About Business Financial Group

Business Financial Group (BFG) provides accounting, tax, payroll, and financial advisory services to U.S. businesses. We are seeking an experienced Fractional CFO to support a client engagement delivered through a partner advisory firm.

Role overview

The Fractional CFO will strengthen the client’s weekly cash flow visibility, improve forecasting reliability, and provide clear financial analysis for management decisions. This hands-on advisory role requires close coordination with the partner firm, BFG’s Fractional Controller, and the client’s accounting team. The professional will progressively assume leadership of recurring cash flow meetings under the partner firm’s oversight.

Key responsibilities

Cash flow and liquidity oversight

  • Review bank balances, expected customer collections, vendor payments, debt obligations, and other near-term cash commitments; identify liquidity risks and decisions requiring management attention.

  • Prepare a concise, one-page weekly cash flow summary before the scheduled Monday review meeting, with practical recommendations and follow-up actions.

  • Participate in weekly cash flow reviews and progressively lead the discussions in line with the agreed transition plan.

Forecasting and financial data reliability

  • Review and maintain financial projections in Clockwork, perform weekly forecast-to-bank tie-outs, and investigate material differences between projected and actual cash balances.

  • Review recurring obligations, assumptions, and forecast mappings; coordinate corrections with the Fractional Controller and monitor reconciliation against agreed variance tolerances.

  • Monitor the timeliness and completeness of customer invoices and vendor bills in QuickBooks Online (QBO). Escalate material delays affecting forecasts to the partner firm on the same business day.

Financial analysis and financing support

  • Support the Fractional Controller with analytical reviews of loan balances, advances, repayments, accrued interest, and inventory balances; identify discrepancies and their reporting implications.

  • Coordinate a financing support package comprising trailing twelve-month profit and loss, current balance sheet, year-to-date financial statements, debt schedule, accounts receivable aging, and a 13-week cash flow projection.

  • Review the package for apparent inconsistencies and submit it to the partner firm for review and authorization before external distribution.

Action tracking and collaboration

  • Maintain the 90-day financial action tracker before each weekly meeting, documenting progress, overdue actions, dependencies, and decisions needed.

  • Coordinate financial findings and executive communications with the partner firm; work effectively within its branding and client communication arrangements.

  • Maintain confidentiality, document work and recommendations, track time against the agreed allocation, and promptly flag additional capacity needs.

Required qualifications and experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related discipline.

  • Substantial progressive finance experience, including responsibility as a CFO, Fractional CFO, Finance Director, or equivalent senior financial advisor serving U.S. businesses.

  • Demonstrated hands-on expertise in cash flow management, short-term liquidity planning, financial forecasting, and explaining forecast variances.

  • Strong working knowledge of QBO, financial statements, U.S. accounting practices, debt schedules, and accounts receivable and payable analysis.

  • Experience with Clockwork or comparable forecasting software, with the ability to work independently in Clockwork following onboarding; strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

  • Clear professional English, confidence leading management discussions, sound judgment, and the ability to turn financial findings into practical recommendations.

  • Ability to deliver reliably within a limited monthly allocation, attend recurring meetings, and respond promptly during agreed communication windows.

Preferred qualifications

  • CPA, CMA, CA, MBA in Finance, or a comparable professional qualification.

  • Experience preparing lender reporting packages, supporting financing applications, and advising businesses with liquidity constraints.

  • Experience with inventory-based businesses, manufacturing, beverage production, or spirits; familiarity with Proof 8 is an advantage.

  • Prior fractional advisory or outsourced finance experience and collaboration through Slack and shared Google Drive workspaces.

Working relationships and scope

The role focuses on cash flow advisory, forecasting oversight, and financial analysis. The Fractional Controller retains ownership of month-end close, accounting reconciliations, and adjustments. The partner firm retains the client relationship, overall financial strategy, financing negotiations, long-term planning, and exit advisory. Additional responsibilities require an agreed scope change.

Please upload your resume in PDF format only. Resumes submitted in any other file format will not be considered.

Who we are
Sponge exists to bring the world’s boldest strategies to life through the people who deliver them, specialising in unlocking the ‘human layer’ of complex transformation. We’ve been leading the industry for decades with our best-in-class digital learning capability and, combined with the emergent growth of our consulting services, we are succeeding in being the partner to our customers who are trying to bridge the critical gap between L&D and the business. This role is a rare and exciting opportunity for any passionate learning professional looking to be part of a dynamic, entrepreneurial team that gets to the heart of what L&D is truly trying to do: solve strategic business challenges through the lens of learning!

So, what exactly is a Learning Experience Consultant?
A Learning Experience Consultant (LExC) at Sponge is a learning leader who is customer-obsessed, thrives in ambiguity, and confidently crafts learning solutions that help strategically move the needle on an organisation’s goals. With strong commercial acumen, senior stakeholder management, and a track record in strategic learning consultancy, they build and maintain meaningful partnerships with our customers who are some of the world’s most prestigious brands. The role primarily holds a dual focus: on the sales side, an LExC drives our commercial momentum by supporting our strategic bids. On the execution side, LExCs are responsible for delivering our delivering our consultative engagements - the analysis, design, development, and execution of a learning strategy and experience blueprint in collaboration with senior stakeholders, SMEs and internal Sponge collaborators.

Responsibilities

Your day-to-day will look something like this:
  • Meaningfully apply a deep understanding of credible best practices in learning (e.g. neuroscience, cognitive psychology, pedagogy, behavioural science).
  • Support clients in realising meaningful behavioural change with measurable results.
  • Design bespoke solutions which reflect the Unforgettable Learning brand and human-centred design principles, which solve for specific learner needs and our client’s challenges.
Support our sales efforts – both in bids and enablement
  • Be an active contributor in our sales process – from supporting discovery calls to leading client pitches.
  • Articulate Sponge’s value in clear and concise ways (e.g. enablement material, case studies, thought leadership.)
Lead and execute consultative engagements
  • Apply consultative skills to assess skill gaps and prioritise learning needs to solve business challenges through effective learning experiences.
  • Be a simultaneous challenger and advisor to our clients - taking a leadership role in advising our strategic accounts on the best approach to their learning strategy.
  • Design and facilitate creative and effective workshops using tailored activities to meaningfully partner with relevant stakeholders.

Requirements

And the skills you’ll need to succeed include:
  • Strategic Consultancy: Ability to understand and translate unique organisational needs into an activated learning strategy (applying L&D theories, methodologies and industry best practices), including recommending/developing innovative and effective solutions.
  • Experience Design:Working collaboratively with our team of learning[LC1] designers, visual/motion designers (and more) to craft a compelling and impactful learning experience utilising our best-in-class bespoke digital learning capability.
  • Storytelling: Ability to convey complex and ambitious ideas within a compelling narrative – whether in a sales pitch or presenting findings to an executive group.
  • Business Acumen: Ability to navigate the needs of a business – being a learning leader while “speaking” the language of the business. Capable of adapting your style in a manner relevant and useful to the wider business, including finding solutions that meet the practicalities of every organisation.
  • Customer Excellence:Able to build effective relationships from peers to C-suite executives, demonstrate expertise to establish credibility and trust, and exude a strong executive presence through confidence and professionalism.
A preferred experience profile would be:
  • Demonstrated consultative experience in designing and implementing impactful learning solutions.
  • Experience in an agency environment – working with a variety of customers and industries in a fast-paced, dynamic setting.
  • Deep knowledge of latest approaches to learning theory and practice.
  • Significant experience working in a service delivery environment.
And some essential attributes we think you’ll need along the way:
  • Comfort in navigating ambiguity
  • Tremendous initiative
  • Resilience under pressure
  • Entrepreneurial attitude and desire to try new methods, tools, and processes

Benefits

  • A competitive salary - Our priority is to find the right person
  • Flexible working hours
  • Remote and Hybrid working options available
  • Pension scheme
  • Income protection and life assurance
  • 25 days holiday (excluding bank holidays)
  • Your birthday off
  • Healthcare cash plan
Be you, with us!
At Sponge, we are all different. And that’s what makes us great! We hire talented people with different and diverse backgrounds, stories, and perspectives not just because it’s the right thing to do, but because it makes us stronger.
We are actively working and committed to increasing diversity in our teams and management positions. It’s our ambition to create an inclusive environment where we can all be ourselves together.
What’s next? If this sounds like you, then you’re on your way to joining a forward-thinking industry leader and a team of like-minded, exceptionally talented people. Simply send us your CV, and we will be in touch. We can’t wait to hear from you!

Strategics Analytics Manager (Marketing Measurement Partner)

Job Details

Role: Strategic Analytics Manager (Marketing Measurement Partner)
Department: Data & Measurement
Job Location: Remote (Canada)
Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)
Compensation: $109,000 - $147,000 CAD + Profit Sharing (after 1 year of employment) + Benefits
Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.

The Role

Joining Thrive’s Data & Measurement department as Strategic Analytics Manager, you’ll own Strategic Analytics / Marketing Measurement workflows that drive growth across our clients marketing programs. You’ll partner with internal media teams and client marketing teams by providing measurement consultation and delivering technical insights that inform business decisions. You’ll be a core part of our lift experimentation program, leading client lift tests from design through execution to final presentation. You’ll also support clients and media teams with broader data and measurement capabilities, including measurement reporting, customer or event-level analysis, or media mix modelling, and help shape the evolution of Thrive’s strategic marketing measurement service.

Your focus will of responsibilities will be:

  • Domain: Own marketing measurement outcomes through strategic and technical lenses, from scoping client objectives, to executing analysis and presenting insights. This will involve designing and executing geo lift tests, building analyses and insights reporting, and consulting client and internal teams on the right measurement approaches.
  • Client: Be the measurement lead across client partnerships, working with paid media teams to turn data into insights and decisions that clients can act on.
  • People: Serve as a strategic translator between data and marketing teams, supporting product feedback loops, identifying gaps, and driving integrated project success. Contribute to Thrive’s knowledge across marketing measurement and strategic analytics by educating non-technical stakeholders.
  • Company: Build Thrive's capacity to lead marketing measurement strategy by refining playbooks, sharing knowledge, and strengthening cross-department roadmaps and systems. Support our Data & Measurement department’s broader service and product evolution to drive stronger marketing analytics insights, tools and strategy across our client roster.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:

  • In your first 30 days you’ll focus on learning Thrive’s systems, building relationships with your team, and understanding our current operating model. You’ll immerse yourself in existing or onboarding client workflows and begin to get acquainted with our in-house measurement solutions across lift experimentation and media mix modelling.
  • In your first 60 days you’ll begin to support Strategic Analytics / Measurement client workflows across geo lift experimentation, custom reporting and analysis, and measurement consultation.
  • In your first 90 days you’ll begin to own Strategic Analytics / Measurement client workflows to advance insights and measurement outcomes. You’ll collaborate with the Data & Measurement team on priority initiatives across measurement service evolution and incoming client partnerships.

Qualifications

  • Marketing Measurement Expertise: You have deep experience with marketing measurement tools, advertising privacy, lift experimentation, attribution, and/or media mix modelling. You understand which data and signals matter most for marketing investment decisions.
  • Growth Marketing Acumen: You're fluent in marketing metrics and unit economics across ecommerce and/or B2B demand generation (e.g., ROAS, CPA, CPM, CAC, LTV, ROI, brand lift, MQL/SQL) and apply them in your analysis and consulting.
  • Technical Data Rigour: You use data to uncover root causes and challenge assumptions, leveraging SQL, Python, and LLMs to troubleshoot discrepancies and build custom analyses and reporting.
  • Consultative Influence: You have a proven track record of influencing marketing executives, gaining buy-in on complex measurement approaches, and translating data into actionable business decisions.
  • Curiosity & Adaptability: You thrive in fast-moving environments, embrace evolving methods and services, and see change as an opportunity to grow.

---

Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

Astrolab is The Lunar Operations Company. We design and build the systems and hardware the lunar economy will come to depend on — rovers, power, and data networks for sustained operations on the Moon. We are focused on the problems that must be solved before the next chapter of human exploration can scale. The Moon does not forgive untested assumptions. The people who work here know that, and they wouldn't have it any other way.

As a GNC engineer at Astrolab, you will be responsible for designing, analyzing, and testing Guidance, Navigation, and Control algorithms for our lunar rover fleet. You will support development and maturation of GNC for crewed, semi-autonomous, and fully autonomous rover operations. GNC engineers own hardware selection and characterization, algorithm development and tuning, algorithm and integrated performance analysis, and verification and validation for the GNC subsystem. You will work with simulated environment as well as test vehicles to design, mature, and prove GNC functionality and performance.

Note: Some travel may be required for this position

What you'll do:

  • Define GNC subsystem and algorithm requirements
  • Design, analyze, develop, tune, verify, and validate rover GNC algorithms and support conversion of algorithm prototypes into FSW
  • Contribute to the development of the GNC simulation
  • Work with avionics and other engineering teams to select GNC sensors such as IMUs, star trackers, cameras, LiDARs, etc.
  • Support GNC sensor characterization, calibration, and testing
  • Support development of integrated hardware/software GNC subsystem testbeds
  • Develop GNC algorithm documentation and work with vehicle software team to convert prototypes into flight code, including supporting unit and integrated testing of flight implementations
  • Work with vehicle software team, avionics team, mobility team, and integration and test team to verify GNC subsystem implementation and performance
  • Support field testing of GNC software using test vehicles in a variety of lighting and terrain conditions
  • Develop GNC analysis and test plans and perform GNC analysis and testing on hardware in the loop testbeds
  • Support vehicle integration and testing of GNC functions
  • Develop vehicle level calibration plans and support vehicle level calibrations

What you'll bring:

Basic Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 3+ years of professional experience developing Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) systems
  • Experience with Python and familiarity with C++
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience developing path planning, obstacle avoidance, or similar algorithms
  • Experience designing, tuning, and testing Extended Kalman Filters for vehicle state estimation.
  • Experience designing, tuning, and testing vehicle control algorithms (e.g., high-gain antenna pointing)
  • Experience building, testing, and validating GNC simulation tools
  • Experience performing GNC performance analysis, including Monte Carlo analysis
  • Experience supporting GNC development from initial concept through flight operations
  • Experience collaborating across multidisciplinary engineering teams to mature GNC designs into flight software
  • Strong technical writing and verbal communication skills

Benefits and Perks

  • Join a team of best-in-class engineers building the foundation of planetary surface exploration
  • Equity ownership in the company
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and mental health support
  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Flexible PTO and parental leave
  • Home office set up reimbursement
  • Weekly lunch stipend, plus complimentary snacks and beverages on-site
  • Once a month social hour on-site with food and drinks

Business Financial Group | Job Description

Engagement:Part-time consulting engagement for a U.S. client

About Business Financial Group

Business Financial Group (BFG) provides accounting, tax, payroll, and financial advisory services to U.S. businesses. We are seeking an experienced Fractional CFO to support a client engagement delivered through a partner advisory firm.

Role overview

The Fractional CFO will strengthen the client’s weekly cash flow visibility, improve forecasting reliability, and provide clear financial analysis for management decisions. This hands-on advisory role requires close coordination with the partner firm, BFG’s Fractional Controller, and the client’s accounting team. The professional will progressively assume leadership of recurring cash flow meetings under the partner firm’s oversight.

Key responsibilities

Cash flow and liquidity oversight

  • Review bank balances, expected customer collections, vendor payments, debt obligations, and other near-term cash commitments; identify liquidity risks and decisions requiring management attention.

  • Prepare a concise, one-page weekly cash flow summary before the scheduled Monday review meeting, with practical recommendations and follow-up actions.

  • Participate in weekly cash flow reviews and progressively lead the discussions in line with the agreed transition plan.

Forecasting and financial data reliability

  • Review and maintain financial projections in Clockwork, perform weekly forecast-to-bank tie-outs, and investigate material differences between projected and actual cash balances.

  • Review recurring obligations, assumptions, and forecast mappings; coordinate corrections with the Fractional Controller and monitor reconciliation against agreed variance tolerances.

  • Monitor the timeliness and completeness of customer invoices and vendor bills in QuickBooks Online (QBO). Escalate material delays affecting forecasts to the partner firm on the same business day.

Financial analysis and financing support

  • Support the Fractional Controller with analytical reviews of loan balances, advances, repayments, accrued interest, and inventory balances; identify discrepancies and their reporting implications.

  • Coordinate a financing support package comprising trailing twelve-month profit and loss, current balance sheet, year-to-date financial statements, debt schedule, accounts receivable aging, and a 13-week cash flow projection.

  • Review the package for apparent inconsistencies and submit it to the partner firm for review and authorization before external distribution.

Action tracking and collaboration

  • Maintain the 90-day financial action tracker before each weekly meeting, documenting progress, overdue actions, dependencies, and decisions needed.

  • Coordinate financial findings and executive communications with the partner firm; work effectively within its branding and client communication arrangements.

  • Maintain confidentiality, document work and recommendations, track time against the agreed allocation, and promptly flag additional capacity needs.

Required qualifications and experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related discipline.

  • Substantial progressive finance experience, including responsibility as a CFO, Fractional CFO, Finance Director, or equivalent senior financial advisor serving U.S. businesses.

  • Demonstrated hands-on expertise in cash flow management, short-term liquidity planning, financial forecasting, and explaining forecast variances.

  • Strong working knowledge of QBO, financial statements, U.S. accounting practices, debt schedules, and accounts receivable and payable analysis.

  • Experience with Clockwork or comparable forecasting software, with the ability to work independently in Clockwork following onboarding; strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

  • Clear professional English, confidence leading management discussions, sound judgment, and the ability to turn financial findings into practical recommendations.

  • Ability to deliver reliably within a limited monthly allocation, attend recurring meetings, and respond promptly during agreed communication windows.

Preferred qualifications

  • CPA, CMA, CA, MBA in Finance, or a comparable professional qualification.

  • Experience preparing lender reporting packages, supporting financing applications, and advising businesses with liquidity constraints.

  • Experience with inventory-based businesses, manufacturing, beverage production, or spirits; familiarity with Proof 8 is an advantage.

  • Prior fractional advisory or outsourced finance experience and collaboration through Slack and shared Google Drive workspaces.

Working relationships and scope

The role focuses on cash flow advisory, forecasting oversight, and financial analysis. The Fractional Controller retains ownership of month-end close, accounting reconciliations, and adjustments. The partner firm retains the client relationship, overall financial strategy, financing negotiations, long-term planning, and exit advisory. Additional responsibilities require an agreed scope change.

So, what exactly is a Learning Experience Consultant?
A Learning Experience Consultant (LExC) at Sponge is a learning leader who is customer-obsessed, thrives in ambiguity, and confidently crafts learning solutions that help strategically move the needle on an organisation’s goals. With strong commercial acumen, senior stakeholder management, and a track record in strategic learning consultancy, they build and maintain meaningful partnerships with our customers who are some of the world’s most prestigious brands. Your day-to-day will look something like this:
  • Meaningfully apply a deep understanding of credible best practices in learning (e.g. neuroscience, cognitive psychology, pedagogy, behavioural science).

  • Be an active contributor in our sales process – from supporting discovery calls to leading client pitches.

Capable of adapting your style in a manner relevant and useful to the wider business, including finding solutions that meet the practicalities of every organisation.

A preferred experience profile would be:

  • Experience in an agency environment – working with a variety of customers and industries in a fast-paced, dynamic setting.

And some essential attributes we think you’ll need along the way:

Be you, with us!
At Sponge, we are all different. And that’s what makes us great! We hire talented people with different and diverse backgrounds, stories, and perspectives not just because it’s the right thing to do, but because it makes us stronger.
We are actively working and committed to increasing diversity in our teams and management positions. It’s our ambition to create an inclusive environment where we can all be ourselves together.
What’s next? If this sounds like you, then you’re on your way to joining a forward-thinking industry leader and a team of like-minded, exceptionally talented people. Simply send us your CV, and we will be in touch. We can’t wait to hear from you!
