raw.description:
The Company

At Servant, we specialize in empowering leaders and organizations within faith communities through innovative digital transformation and change management solutions. We are dedicated to providing tailored strategies that align with our clients' values and missions, focusing on service, integrity, and excellence. Our team is passionate about driving impactful change by equipping our partners with the tools and technologies they need to thrive in a digital age.

Position

We're looking for a hands-on Controller to own Servant's day-to-day accounting and financial operations. This person will bring our accounting function in-house, establish reliable processes, and give leadership clear, timely visibility into the financial health of the business.

Working directly with the COO and partnering across Growth, Delivery, Resource Management, and People Ops, the Controller will oversee the full accounting cycle, tax compliance, payroll accounting, and financial reporting. They'll also connect contracts, project delivery, and billing while improving visibility into cash flow and project profitability.

This is an opportunity to build a scalable finance function in a lean, technology-forward environment, using automation and AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency and accuracy.

What You'll Do

Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Own the full accounting cycle, including general ledger, journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, and monthly close.
  • Prepare timely, accurate financial statements, including profit and loss, balance sheet, and cash flow.
  • Manage accounts payable, vendor payments, expenses, and approval workflows.
  • Own client and contract invoicing; monitor accounts receivable, resolve billing discrepancies, and improve collections.
  • Prepare commission journal entries and accruals, ensuring expenses are recorded accurately in the appropriate periods.
  • Own payroll accounting, including payroll entries and reconciliation of payroll expenses, employer taxes, benefits costs, and payroll liabilities.
  • Oversee applicable state and local tax compliance, coordinating registrations, filings, reconciliations, and payments with Rippling and external tax advisors. Monitor deadlines and maintain supporting documentation.
  • Partner with People Ops to review payroll tax reporting, resolve discrepancies, and support accurate, timely filings and payments. People Ops retains ownership of payroll processing, employee changes, and benefits administration through Rippling.
  • Coordinate income tax preparation, annual financial reviews, and other external accounting requirements with outside advisors.
  • Maintain accurate financial records, documentation, policies, and internal controls.

Financial Reporting & Business Partnership

  • Deliver monthly financial reporting with clear explanations of performance, trends, and variances.
  • Give the COO and leadership team visibility into revenue, expenses, margins, cash flow, and working capital.
  • Monitor cash flow and proactively flag risks, timing gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Partner with the COO on budgets, forecasts, and financial projections; analyze actual results against plan and recommend corrective actions.
  • Serve as the primary owner of accounting and financial reporting in leadership discussions, providing clear insights and recommendations.

Project Accounting & Services Operations

  • Partner with Growth, Delivery, and Resource Management to connect signed contracts, project setup, delivery, and client billing.
  • Improve visibility into project costs, engagement margins, utilization, and services profitability.
  • Maintain consistency across accounting, project management, CRM, and billing systems.
  • Review project budgets, cost allocations, and revenue recognition in accordance with applicable standards and company policies.
  • Coordinate the accounting treatment and documentation of qualifying software development costs, including capitalization, with the COO and external advisors.
  • Identify opportunities to improve billing accuracy, reduce revenue leakage, and strengthen financial accountability.

Systems & Process Improvement

  • Own and optimize financial workflows in QuickBooks and Bill.com.
  • Improve data consistency across connected systems and streamline recurring accounting processes through automation, integrations, and responsible use of AI-enabled tools.
  • Reduce manual work and recurring errors while improving close timelines, reporting, documentation, and financial controls.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of progressive accounting or finance experience, with hands-on responsibility for accounting operations and financial reporting.
  • Experience in a services-based, project-driven business, such as consulting, professional services, or technology services.
  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, general ledger management, reconciliations, month-end close, and financial statements.
  • Experience with accounts payable, accounts receivable, client billing, and contract invoicing.
  • Hands-on experience with QuickBooks and Bill.com.
  • Experience with tax compliance oversight, payroll accounting, and coordination with payroll providers or external tax advisors.
  • Ability to improve processes and internal controls, interpret financial data, and communicate actionable insights to business leaders.
  • Strong spreadsheet skills, attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to operate independently across multiple systems and priorities.

Preferred

  • Experience with Productive or another project accounting or resource management platform.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, Salesforce, or another CRM and the connection between pipeline, contracts, delivery, and billing.
  • Experience with CashFrog or a similar cash flow forecasting tool.
  • Experience with software development cost capitalization.
  • Experience in a lean business with employees and independent contractors.
  • Experience with budgeting, forecasting, project profitability, utilization reporting, and commission accounting.
  • Experience using AI and automation to improve financial workflows and reporting.

Benefits

  • Health Insurance
  • HSA & FSA offerings
  • 401K with company match
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Company Holidays & Serve days
  • Remote work
  • Technology & Home Office Allotment
  • Quarterly travel + Annual Team Offsite

Description

This position will offer you the ability to apply and expand your knowledge of underground transmission line engineering, including routing, duct bank configurations, manhole placement and electrical principles to:

  • Design underground transmission lines for voltages up to 500kV.
  • Responsible for cost analyses, development of design criteria, siting and routing challenges, and placement of manholes for underground transmission lines.
  • Responsible for physical design including duct bank layouts, development of trenchless designs, cable pulling calculations, development of drawing packages.
  • Responsible for cable selection studies, determining bonding scheme, performing ampacity calculations.
  • Develop riser structure configuration and structural loading.
  • Develop specifications including cable procurement, duct bank installation, trenchless installation and general construction specifications.
  • Work and coordinate with vendors and clients to specify transmission line components.
  • Direct a small project team of other engineers, designers and drafters.

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in Canada for this position.

This position may require access to U.S. export-controlled information. As such, candidates must be a citizen of a country listed in Appendix A to Part 810 of the Code of Federal Regulations. Please click here to determine your eligibility.

Essential skills and experience:

  • This position requires a BS degree from a Canadian Engineering Accreditation Board-accredited undergraduate program or a US based ABET-accredited program.
  • Proficiency with CYMCAP modeling
  • Proficiency with cable tensioning calculations and/or software
  • 12 or more years of experience as a member of a project team in observing project schedules and budget constraints on diverse underground transmission projects
  • Design experience incorporating code requirements, EPRI recommendations, client requirements
  • Experience in cost estimate development and schedule creation and coordination
  • Experience with XLPE cable design
  • Experience in the preparation of specifications for installation and procurement of underground transmission line materials and components
  • Knowledge to verify/review right of way requirements, bonding schemes, underground transmission line plan and profile drawings and other construction documents
  • Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principles involved in the production of technical plans, drawings, and models
  • Experience in writing and providing support documentation for engineering calculations
  • Familiarity with design codes and standards such as NESC, EPRI Green Book, IEC, CSA, IEEE, ANSI, IBC, ASCE 7, AISC, and ACI 318
  • Proficiency with MS Office applications
  • Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills
  • Attention to detail

Valued but not required skills and experience:

  • Have a current P.Eng license or the ability to acquire one within one year
  • Experience with High Pressure Gas Filled or High-Pressured Fluid Filled pipe type cable systems and associated equipment
  • Experience with underground distribution or low voltage cable systems

Depending on the role, employees may use data, automation, artificial intelligence, and other digital tools to support research, analysis, engineering and design activities, workflow improvement, or other aspects of their work. Experience with AI, automation, programming, or similar technologies is valued where relevant but is not required unless specifically identified elsewhere in the job description.

The Senior Product Owner is a member of the Utilization Management Web team responsible for defining requirements, IT needs, and user stories while also prioritizing the Team Backlog to streamline the execution of program priorities while maintaining the conceptual and technical integrity of the features or components for the team. The Product Owner maximizes value produced by the team by ensuring user stories meet the business' needs and complies with the Definition of Done. This role has significant relationships and responsibilities outside the Agile team, including working with other Product Owners, Product Managers or Operational Leaders, HGB Associates, Business Owners, and other stakeholders. This role has significant relationships and responsibilities outside the Agile team, including working with other Product Owners, Product Managers or Operational Leaders, HGB Associates, Business Owners, and other stakeholders. This role serves as the integral connector between business or operational functions and technology.

Job Description:

The Senior Product Owner is responsible for having a deep understanding of how and which technology platforms and tools are used by HGB associates in the respective operational area they support. This understanding serves as the foundation for improving technology that increases the value of products and services indirectly and/or directly to HGB customers. This understanding occurs through either being a user of this technology or learning through other users. Critical thinking, problem solving, and keen listening skills are required for this role



Once this understanding is achieved, the Senior Product Owner is responsible for engaging with the Product Manager or Operational Leader to learn priorities and pressing needs of the operational team. The Senior Product Owner is then positioned to serve as a representative of the operational team to define and prioritize requirements, initiatives, and/or user stories with the Agile Team. This will require work assignments that are moderately complex to complex where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.

As part of the prioritization process, the Senior Product Owner is responsible for preparing and participating in for Program Increments. This includes briefing the Product Manager and/or Operational Leader and other Clinical Operations Leaders on the recommended program vision, roadmap, and content presentations.

Once the Program Increment is complete, the Product Owner is responsible for iteration and program execution which includes, but is not limited to maintaining team backlog; iteration planning; accepting user stories; assisting with decision making related to sequencing of work; ensuring and facilitating adequate user testing prior to push to production; and coordinating with other Product Owners as needed. Included in this phase is supporting and/or producing the system demonstration of the fulfillment of the user stories for various stakeholders.

While performing in this role, the Senior Product Owner must possess excellent communication skills with all stakeholders to ensure the right product is being built, in the right order, within budget and by the deadline. The Senior Product Owner monitors progress throughout the feature life-cycle, working closely with the operational team to resolve questions and challenges, reduce risk to contract standards and minimize delays. The Senior Product Owner will serve as the Agile team's primary contact for information, work prioritization, and decision-making while also reporting back to the Product Manager and/or Operational Leader to report progress and to ensure alignment.



Key Accountabilities:

1. Works with business teams, scrum master, product managers, Clinical Operations leaders and other HGB teams on understanding and communicating the business needs and priorities. This effort will also include document demands in ServiceNow or designated system. 20%

2. Acts as the main point of contact for the agile scrum team to ensure the product is being built within budget and deadline. Communicates and collaborates with Clinical Operations leadership and other Product Owners on progress, status, and challenges. 20%

3. Participates in the daily, weekly, and monthly scrum team activities by articulating IT needs and requirements, writing features and stories, works prioritizations, obtains product manager alignment on features, stories, and prioritization, makes critical decisions, and builds the backlog for their product. 60%

This role description in no way states or implies that the key accountabilities above are the only ones being performed by the individual(s) with this role description. The individual(s) may be called upon and required to follow other instructions or perform other duties and tasks requested by his or her supervisor, consistent with the purpose of the position, department and/or company objectives.

  • Bachelor degree or equivalent
  • 5+ years of technical experience, product ownership, or project management experience
  • Exceptional oral and written communication skills
  • Detail oriented with excellent organizational and project management skills
  • Critical thinker who can anticipate team needs and take initiative to present ideas, ask the right questions and deliver the highest quality work
  • Problem solver who can find viable solutions that meets business needs, absent from all ideal tools and resources.
  • Ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks with concurrent deadlines

raw.description:
Who We Are

Goodway Group is one of AdAge's 2026's BEST PLACES TO WORK! As an independent and remote-first media and marketing services firm with a 90+ year history, Goodway Group has the security of an established company combined with a start-up feel. With leading data-driven and technology-enabled digital media and marketing services firm with teams in the U.S. and the UK, our diverse team of digital strategists, media practitioners, technologists and data scientists have won the most prestigious awards for innovative marketing technology, impactful work and inclusive remote-first places to work including being honored as a multiyear winner in Ad Age Best Places to Work, Ad Exchanger's Best Use of Technology by an Agency Award and two MarTech Breakthrough Awards and a certified service partner to The Trade Desk.

*We are only accepting candidates outside of the US* Please only apply if you reside outside of the US* Priority for those who live in Brazil, Colombia, Mexico, and Peru.

Role Overview

As a Product Manager, you will help define and deliver Goodway’s data, AI, digital marketing, and internal business products across Goodway’s build-and-buy technology ecosystem. This role combines strategic product thinking with hands-on execution and partners closely with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, AI Enablement, Client Services, Sales, and senior leadership.

You will own one or more product areas from discovery through launch and ongoing improvement. You will translate customer and business needs into clear product strategies, roadmaps, and requirements while helping technical teams deliver scalable, high-quality solutions.

This includes internally developed products, user interfaces, automated workflows, data solutions, integrations, and external platforms that support CRM, media planning, audience activation, programmatic marketing, campaign execution, measurement, and optimization.

Goodway is continuing to evolve GOES™, its AI-native decision intelligence platform, including capabilities across data management, performance reporting, forecasting, scenario planning, customer and audience intelligence, measurement, optimization, and AI-enabled workflows.

What You Will Do

  • Own and evolve the roadmap for one or more technical product areas in partnership with Product and Technology leadership.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer, user, and business needs through research, stakeholder interviews, customer conversations, usage data, and feedback.
  • Develop a working understanding of the platforms, data sources, and workflows that support Goodway’s marketing and advertising operations, including CRM, media planning, audience activation, programmatic buying, campaign execution, reporting, measurement, and optimization.
  • Translate business goals and user problems into product strategies, priorities, success measures, and delivery plans.
  • Prioritize initiatives based on customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, risk, and organizational capacity.
  • Lead the product lifecycle from discovery and definition through development, launch, and continuous improvement.
  • Write clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and supporting documentation.
  • Partner with engineering and technical leaders to define scalable solutions, clarify tradeoffs, and manage dependencies.
  • Break complex initiatives into incremental, testable releases that deliver value while supporting the long-term product vision.
  • Facilitate relevant delivery activities, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, and retrospectives.
  • Proactively manage risks, blockers, assumptions, and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Serve as a product advocate and subject-matter expert for your product area.
  • Partner with clients and internal users to validate concepts, gather feedback, and support adoption.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Client Services to communicate product value and support go-to-market efforts.
  • Define product goals and success metrics, and use analytics, feedback, experimentation, and business data to evaluate outcomes.
  • Communicate product progress, decisions, tradeoffs, and results clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Understand how campaign, audience, media, placement, spend, pacing, performance, and measurement data flows across systems and informs product decisions.

What You Bring

  • 6+ years of experience in technical product management, product management, technology consulting, software development, data, analytics, or a related field.
  • Experience taking technology products or complex capabilities from discovery through launch and ongoing iteration.
  • Experience working in a technology ecosystem that includes internally built products, third-party platforms, data providers, APIs, and integrations.
  • Familiarity with marketing technology and advertising platforms such as Salesforce, Placements.IO, Fluency, audience activation platforms, media planning tools, programmatic platforms, measurement systems, or similar products.
  • Experience working closely with engineering, analytics, data science, or AI teams.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, Agile methodologies, APIs, integrations, data systems, and cloud-based technology.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and the ability to understand data models, analytical workflows, and technical tradeoffs.
  • Experience defining product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, workflows, and release plans.
  • Experience with tools such as Jira, Linear, Confluence, or similar platforms.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a collaborative, fast-moving, and sometimes ambiguous environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in digital advertising, ad tech, marketing technology, media, commerce, or data products.
  • Experience with programmatic advertising, audience data, identity, measurement, attribution, media planning, or optimization.
  • Experience with data warehouses such as Snowflake, Redshift, or similar platforms.
  • Experience evaluating or supporting build-versus-buy decisions across marketing technology, data, analytics, and workflow solutions.
  • Experience with analytics and product measurement tools such as Sigma, Tableau, Looker, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Google Analytics.
  • Experience with AI/ML products, generative AI, LLMs, agentic systems, or intelligent automation.
  • Experience supporting API partnerships, third-party integrations, or data provider relationships.

Success in This Role

Success means creating clarity in complex problem spaces, aligning teams around high-value opportunities, and helping deliver products that are useful, scalable, and measurable. You will be successful when customers and internal users adopt Goodway’s products, engineering teams have the context they need to execute effectively, and the roadmap produces meaningful business outcomes.

Check us out at to learn more!

If you identify as a female candidate, and feel you can do this role even if there are a few things perhaps you've not done, please apply anyway! Goodway Group is 70% Female! We realize that men tend to apply for jobs when they can meet around 60% of the requirements for the role, where women tend to only apply when they know they meet 100% of the requirements.

Goodway Group is human-first, constantly working to become more inclusive and to make sure our employee population reflects our desire to constantly add to our diversity in all ways. We want applications from everyone, regardless of race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, citizen status, age, disability, military or protected veteran status, genetic predisposition or carrier status or any other legally protected status.

raw.description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

The role of the Specialist, Responsible Sourcing Operations – Advancement associate encompasses diverse responsibilities, including ensuring factories comply with VF standards, supporting safety and worker rights initiatives, driving environmental sustainability, and contributing to worker and community development efforts. In this role, the Advancement associate collaborates with VF factories, regional offices, cross-functional teams (including the factory compliance team), NGO partners, and various stakeholders to facilitate enhancements across all responsible sourcing domains. This role supports the implementation of responsible sourcing requirements and improvement activities at assigned factories. The Specialist conducts routine factory visits, follows up on corrective actions, reviews supporting evidence, maintains accurate records, and provides practical guidance based on established VF requirements. The Specialist is expected to identify and promptly escalate critical, recurring, or unresolved issues to the reporting manager and relevant subject matter teams.

The role plays a crucial role in advancing VF's commitment to comprehensive and sustainable practices across the sourced factory base.


Factory Compliance:


  • Support assigned factories in understanding and implementing applicable VF requirements, local legal requirements, and relevant international standards.
  • In partnership with the sourcing and compliance teams, support assigned factories in identifying compliance gaps, developing and implementing corrective action plans, and verifying the effectiveness of corrective actions through factory visits, document reviews, and follow-up discussions.
  • Escalate overdue, recurring, ineffective, or potentially critical corrective actions to the reporting manager and relevant Responsible Sourcing teams.
  • Communicate with vendors and factories on existing or new requirements in the Facility Guidelines, provide context, tools, and knowledge for suppliers to prepare ahead of audits.

Safety:


  • Collaborate closely with the VF Safety Team and VF's Safety Program Providers, offer assistance to in-scope factories in addressing safety concerns. This involves conducting both on-site and remote visits to address issues identified during safety assessments, aiming to enhance working conditions and prevent factory downgrades.
  • Aid the VF Safety Team in coordinating both on-site and remote visits from third-party assessment, training, and remediation firms.

Worker Rights:


  • In collaboration with the VF Worker Rights Team and external stakeholders (where applicable), support on incident investigation and remediation of labor issues or allegations, using knowledge of the country’s national legislation and international conventions on workers' rights.
  • Support the company to quickly respond to critical concerns/issues arisen in countries of responsibility.

Environmental:


  • In collaboration with the VF Environmental Sustainability Team, drive improved environmental sustainability performance at factories by proactively working with factory management to build Environmental Management Systems.
  • Where appliable, work with the Environmental Sustainability Team and external stakeholders to promote and advise on participation in energy efficiency programs and renewable energy programs in countries of responsibility.

Worker and Community Development (WCD):


  • In collaboration with VF’s WCD team, drive factory participation in the basic needs assessment to determine localized, community-specific needs.
  • Support the WCD team and external partners on program implementation at factories, and regularly review performance with factory, implementation partners, VF management and workers to ensure the WCD program meets it’s objectives.

KEY COMPETENCIES:


  • Embodies the highest level of personal and professional integrity and ethics
  • Experience in factory compliance audits with excellent knowledge on labor, Health & Safety, and environment local laws.
  • Thorough knowledge on auditing processes and database administration.
  • Excellent report writing and communication skills in both oral and written English.
  • Ability to develop and maintain partnerships with key stakeholders across the business.
  • Independent worker, strong problem-solving skill.
  • Ability to consider perspectives aside from their own.
  • Has a keen sense of urgency & able to prioritize and complete the assigned task in a tight schedule.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE:


  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in responsible sourcing, factory compliance, social auditing, supplier improvement, or a related field, including practical experience in factory engagement and corrective action follow-up.
  • Bachelor’s degree in labor relations, law, occupational health and safety, environmental science or engineering, social sciences, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Expertise in using Microsoft Office including Word, Excel, Outlook and Web skills
  • Relevant Knowledge and Experience:
  • Labour, Health, Safety, and Environmental auditing.
  • Laws, Regulations and Industry Standard of the region
  • Laws & Regulation of Labor & Employments;
  • Knowledge of human and labor rights.

Welcome to the Agentic Commerce Era

At Commerce, our mission is to empower businesses to innovate, grow, and thrive with our open, AI-driven commerce ecosystem. As the parent company of BigCommerce, Feedonomics, and Makeswift, we connect the tools and systems that power growth, enabling businesses to unlock the full potential of their data, deliver seamless and personalized experiences across every channel, and adapt swiftly to an ever-changing market. We believe in harnessing AI responsibly to unlock new possibilities, and we’re looking for individuals who use it intentionally to solve problems, accelerate outcomes, and expand what’s possible in their role. Our purpose is to help businesses confidently solve complex commerce challenges so they can build smarter, adapt faster, and grow on their own terms. If you want to be part of a team of bold builders, sharp thinkers, and technical trailblazers who shape the future of commerce, this is the place for you.

We are seeking a commercially minded, proactive Customer Success Manager (CSM) to own and grow a portfolio of named customer relationships with direct accountability to Net Revenue Retention (NRR) as the primary performance metric and core OKR.


This role is responsible for driving customer outcomes across the full customer lifecycle — from onboarding and adoption through retention, renewal, expansion, and advocacy. Success in this role requires balancing customer value delivery with commercial accountability by proactively managing customer engagement, mitigating risk, leading escalations, influencing adoption, identifying growth opportunities, and reducing churn to maximize long-term customer value.


What You’ll Do:

Customer Retention & Revenue Growth

  • Own a portfolio of customer accounts with direct accountability for achieving Net Revenue Retention (NRR) targets through retention, expansion, renewal performance, and churn mitigation.
  • Develop and execute strategic success plans aligned to customer business goals, measurable outcomes, and growth opportunities.
  • Drive customer value realization to increase retention, deepen product adoption, and maximize long-term customer value.
  • Identify expansion opportunities and partner with Sales to influence upsell, cross-sell, and account growth initiatives.
  • Lead proactive renewal planning and commercial engagement strategies to maximize renewals and reduce revenue attrition.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of portfolio performance, identifying revenue opportunities and risks to achieve quota attainment.

Customer Engagement, Adoption & Advocacy

  • Own the end-to-end customer lifecycle including onboarding, adoption, engagement, renewal, and expansion.
  • Drive executive and operational engagement through business reviews, success checkpoints, and strategic planning sessions.
  • Increase customer adoption and utilization through targeted success initiatives tied to measurable business outcomes.
  • Build trusted customer relationships that improve loyalty, strengthen advocacy, and increase referenceable customer participation.
  • Leverage engagement insights and customer feedback to improve customer outcomes and long-term account health.

Risk Management, Escalations & Churn Mitigation

  • Proactively identify customer and commercial risks through health indicators, engagement trends, adoption signals, business changes, and renewal indicators; develop and execute mitigation plans to protect revenue outcomes.
  • Own customer escalations end-to-end by driving urgency, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, maintaining clear communication, and restoring customer confidence.
  • Act as the central point of accountability for critical customer situations, ensuring timely resolution and executive visibility when required.
  • Develop and execute recovery and retention plans for at-risk accounts to improve customer health and maximize renewal outcomes.
  • Maintain ongoing portfolio risk forecasting and escalation visibility to proactively manage churn exposure and expansion readiness.
  • Monitor customer health scores, usage data, and account indicators to drive proactive intervention and improve retention performance.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Operational Excellence

  • Partner closely with Sales, Product, Support, Operations, and Leadership teams to deliver a seamless and value-driven customer experience.
  • Act as the Voice of the Customer internally by translating customer insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Maintain disciplined account planning, CRM hygiene, forecasting accuracy, and data-driven decision making.
  • Operate effectively in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities while maintaining focus on business outcomes.

Success Metrics (KPIs):

  • Net revenue Retention
  • Expansion Pipeline & Closed-Won Growth
  • Renewal Performance
  • Customer Engagement & Adoption
  • Customer Health Improvement
  • Churn Reduction & Risk Recovery
  • Customer Advocacy & Referenceable Customer Growth
  • Forecast Accuracy & Portfolio Health

Who You Are:

  • 3–5 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Customer Growth, Consulting, Ecommerce, Sales, or another customer-facing commercial role.
  • Experience managing a portfolio of customer accounts with accountability for customer outcomes including retention, renewals, adoption, growth, or revenue performance.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted customer relationships, influence stakeholders, and communicate effectively across all levels, including executive audiences.
  • Proven ability to identify risk, navigate escalations, and execute retention strategies to drive customer satisfaction and long-term value.
  • Strong understanding of customer lifecycle management, success planning, account strategy, and value realization.
  • Experience using customer insights, business metrics, and data analysis to inform decisions, prioritize actions, and improve outcomes.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, solve problems proactively, and execute with urgency in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Customer-first mindset with strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a track record of following through on commitments.
  • Demonstrated ability to uncover opportunities for customer expansion and commercial growth through strategic engagement and partnership.
  • Exposure to Enterprise grade SaaS, ecommerce, or subscription-based environments.
  • Strong negotiation skills for driving renewals, securing expansions and protecting account value.
  • Comfortable learning new systems, adapting to change, and continuously improving ways of working.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience using Gainsight to manage customer engagement, health, and lifecycle activities.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce and Tableau for customer management, reporting, and data-driven decision making.
  • Experience operating in SaaS and technology-driven environments.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered productivity and workflow tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or NotebookLM.
  • Understanding of ecommerce and adjacent industries, including digital commerce, retail, B2B, wholesale, manufacturing, and consumer goods.
  • Experience working with customer data, reporting, analytics platforms, and deriving actionable insights from business metrics.

What We’re Looking For

  • Customer-first mindset with strong commercial acumen.
  • Ownership mentality with accountability to revenue and retention outcomes.
  • Ability to balance relationship management with business growth objectives.
  • Strong execution, prioritization, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Skilled at influencing cross-functional teams and navigating complex customer environments.
  • Proactive operator who anticipates risk, drives action, and delivers measurable customer and business outcomes.

Commerce is a remote-first company. For team members in Austin, Atlanta, and London, we offer optional collaborative workspaces for team gatherings, workshops, and in-person connection. Use them whenever they’re helpful, balancing focused individual work with meaningful in-person collaboration.

Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications and geographic location. We also consider internal equity to help ensure fair and consistent pay practices across our teams.


Where applicable, this role may also be eligible for variable compensation (such as bonus or commission), equity, and benefits in accordance with local policies. Details will be shared during the hiring process. We are committed to equitable and transparent pay practices that align to market data, internal equity, and individual contribution.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Learn more about the Commerce team, culture and benefits at

Fleet provides its customers flexibility and predictability to meet their upside demand forecasts, addressing a key need in the market as traditional leased models are struggling to keep pace with the demand for new Cloud and AI infrastructure. Fleet is led by a team of industry veterans that have already made a lasting imprint on the evolution of global digital infrastructure and are committed and uniquely capable of upleveling data center development scale and operations in the face of rising demand. Fleet is well positioned to bring in-house design, engineering and operational capabilities to collaborate with customers on tailored solutions for campuses of 500MW+. This unique model enables Fleet to provide the world’s largest and most sophisticated customers a seamless extension of their own data center fleets with constant access to design innovation.

Position Overview

The Director of Land Development supports the pre-development phase of Fleet’s data center projects and carries those projects forward through the balance of their lifecycle. The Director of Land Development leads site diligence, campus master planning, entitlements, and permitting, from initial site control or joint venture through stabilization, then stays with the project through lease, vertical construction, stabilization, and the ultimate disposition of the asset. The Director of Land Development works closely alongside senior members of the organization, and represents Fleet before the jurisdictions, agencies, utilities, and communities that decide whether a campus gets built.

Job Responsibilities

In addition to other duties assigned, the Director of Land Development will hold the following primary responsibilities:

  • Lead site inquiry and evaluation of prospective sites in assigned markets, identifying the risks and opportunities that determine whether a site advances to site control or joint venture formation, and carrying multiple projects across diverse jurisdictions at once
  • Own the pre-development workstream plan for assigned projects: define the diligence scope at site control or joint venture formation, sequence the studies that gate a development decision, and hold the schedule that carries a site from control to vertical construction
  • Run land and site diligence, including title and survey, geotechnical, environmental, wetlands, cultural resources, traffic, and water and wastewater, and convert the findings into buildable area, phasing, and cost consequences that leadership can act on
  • Lead entitlements and permitting across local, state, and federal jurisdictions: map the approval path for each site, prepare applications alongside counsel and consultants, and carry hearings through to recorded approvals and issued permits
  • Direct masterplanning with internal and external stakeholders so each campus plan reconciles critical load, building form factor, substation and switchyard siting, water strategy, and site constraints, and revise that plan as customer requirements, power availability, and investment strategy move
  • Support the internal power teams on the entitlements, permits, and land use matters that power infrastructure requires, including substation and switchyard siting approvals, transmission and distribution easements and rights-of-way, conditional use approvals for generation and battery energy storage, and the property rights needed to bring interconnection and behind-the-meter solutions onto the site
  • Support the creation and management of a bottom-up pre-development budget, tracking commitments and spend against it and helping forecast the capital draw by phase so leadership can plan funding
  • Assemble and manage the consultant bench: write scopes of work, support solicitations, bid-leveling, recommend awards to management, negotiate agreements with internal legal, and hold each firm to its deliverable dates
  • Interrogate engineering and consultant deliverables before they circulate, testing them against the approval path, the site constraints, and the development schedule, and returning work that does not hold up
  • Represent Fleet before local government, including planning and zoning commissions and public works staff, and attend city council and county commission meetings as required
  • Work the rest of the local apparatus that moves an approval, including assessors, clerks, utilities, and state and local economic development offices, and build the relationships that drive approvals
  • Support leasing and capital markets on assigned sites, translating site and schedule reality into delivery dates and costs that can be committed to customers, lenders, and investment partners
  • Advance the horizontal development features that makes a campus buildable, including securing water, wastewater, fiber, and road infrastructure and coordinating earthworks packages specific to data center campus use
  • Represent Fleet in the community, building and maintaining relationships with adjacent landowners and community groups, and reflecting the company's approach to land stewardship and local economic benefit in every public interaction
  • Uphold company Environment, Health & Safety standards across consultant and contractor activity on assigned sites
  • Hand projects to construction without losing the record, transferring permit conditions, commitments made to jurisdictions and utilities, and design assumptions, then stay with assigned projects through vertical construction, stabilization, and disposition
  • Contribute to scalable tools and processes that improve project delivery and communication, from schedule and budget standards to trackers and reporting templates, so each new site starts from the last one's lessons

Education & Experience

  • Education/Accreditations: Bachelor's degree in engineering, real estate development, architecture, planning, or an equivalent discipline. Current or past Professional Engineer licensure greatly preferred.

    Experience: Minimum of five years' experience in large-scale land development, civil engineering, site planning, construction, or data center and energy development, including direct ownership of at least one entitlement path from application through approval. Civil engineering experience greatly preferred. Candidates who have taken a greenfield site through to a construction start will stand out.

    Travel: 50%. This position requires regular travel to project sites, jurisdictional hearings, utility and consultant meetings, and Fleet offices, with meaningful time in the field during active entitlement periods.

Core Skills & Competencies

  • Working knowledge of real estate development fundamentals, including ownership and site control structures, land use frameworks, rezoning mechanics, and the entitlement processes that apply to large-scale industrial and infrastructure projects
  • Practical command of the diligence stack, including what each study can and cannot resolve and how long each one takes in a given jurisdiction
  • Ability to read a civil site plan and a utility one-line and press the engineer who drew it, sufficient to test buildable area, phasing, and infrastructure assumptions rather than accept them
  • Working knowledge of power and energy infrastructure as it relates to data center development — including utility interconnection, behind-the-meter power solutions, and battery energy storage systems — sufficient to track queue position, study milestones, and energization dates against the campus schedule
  • Command of pre-development budgeting and capital forecasting, with enough modeling literacy to see how a schedule slip or a scope change lands in project returns
  • Demonstrated negotiating experience with consultants, contractors, utilities, and public agencies, covering scope, fee structure, and the commitments made to secure an approval
  • Ability to carry several sites in different jurisdictions at once without dropping conditions, deadlines, or commitments, and to reprioritize as sites advance or stall
  • Judgment to escalate, surfacing a schedule or cost problem while it can still be fixed — without waiting to be directed
  • Direct writing, covering internal reports and dashboards as well as external land use applications, producing packages a senior audience can act on without a walkthrough
  • Strong verbal communication, including internal presentations and public speaking at local government meetings
  • Ability to manage projects and teams to a predictable conclusion, and to problem solve by leveraging independent analysis, local relationships, corporate resources, and executive support
  • Curiosity and the ability to network in structured and unstructured settings, surfacing opportunities and challenges early
  • Fluency in Excel for budgets and schedules and PowerPoint for leadership reporting, with comfort in drawing markup and project tracking tools

Location: New York, NY, Morristown, NJ, or remote

Travel Requirement: 50% This position requires regular travel to project sites, jurisdictional hearings, utility and consultant meetings, and Tract Capital offices, with meaningful time in the field during active entitlement periods.

Expected Salary Range: $180,000 - $195,000 Base Salary + Discretionary Bonus

Fleet Data Centers Employment
Fleet Data Centers employees enjoy competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, including 100% employer-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401K program, standard paid holidays, and unlimited PTO.

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may perform other related duties to meet the organization's ongoing needs.

About Anaconda

Be at the center of AI

Anaconda is built to advance AI with open source at scale, giving builders and organizations the confidence to increase productivity, and save time, spend and risk associated with open source. 95% of the Fortune 500 including Panasonic, AmTrust, Booz Allen Hamilton and over 50 million users rely on the value The Anaconda AI Platform delivers through a centralized approach to sourcing, securing, building, and deploying AI. With 21 billion downloads and growing, Anaconda has established itself as the gold standard for Python, data science, and AI and the enterprise-ready solution of choice for AI innovation. Anaconda is backed by world-class investors including Insight Partners. Learn more at .

Summary:

Anaconda's Distribution Engineering team builds, secures, and operates the systems that produce and release packages for millions of users and thousands of enterprise customers. As supply chain security demands escalate and AI-driven workflows raise the bar, manual package-by-package remediation no longer scales. We need a Staff Software Engineer to set technical direction for vulnerability remediation at scale, architect platform infrastructure that serves our community reliably, and lead the remediation of complex CVEs that protect our users.


What You'll Do:
  • Set technical strategy for vulnerability remediation from CVE intake through release, making risk-based decisions on patching, backporting, upgrading, or mitigation
  • Architect and build remediation infrastructure including build and test pipelines, vulnerability scanning, signing, SBOM generation, and VEX documentation
  • Lead remediation of critical and complex CVEs involving deep dependency chains and ABI-sensitive packages
  • Improve reliability, observability, and access controls across build and release platform infrastructure as automation and AI agent usage scales
  • Define remediation SLAs and metrics that balance speed, security rigor, and engineering effort
  • Write design documents that clearly communicate tradeoffs, facilitate technical review, and guide cross-team implementation
  • Diagnose root causes when infrastructure breaks and advocate for technical investments that reduce production risk
  • Partner with upstream open-source maintainers to coordinate fixes and contribute patches back to the community
  • Use AI-powered development tools to eliminate toil and accelerate triage, patch analysis, testing, and code review
Your impact will be measured through:
  • Time-to-remediate for high-severity CVEs drops measurably with consistent SLA adherence
  • Manual remediation effort decreases as automation scales across the package catalog
  • Build and release infrastructure becomes more reliable and secure with fewer single points of failure
  • Platform security improvements measurably reduce risk surface area for enterprise customers
  • Engineering teams ship faster with higher confidence through improved tooling and clearer remediation status
What You Need:
  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • 5+ years in infrastructure, platform engineering, release engineering, or security remediation roles
  • Strong expertise in Python and deep experience with C/C++ or other compiled languages including native build systems and ABI debugging
  • Hands-on packaging and build experience with conda, Python wheels, or Linux distribution packaging
  • Experience designing and operating CI/CD, build, or release infrastructure at scale with an SRE mindset
  • Strong command of CVE/CVSS frameworks, exploitability analysis, vulnerability scanning, and supply chain security concepts including SBOM, VEX, SLSA, signing, and provenance
  • Track record leading large cross-team technical initiatives and influencing outcomes without direct authority
  • Proven ability communicating complex tradeoffs in design documents and technical reviews to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience mentoring engineers at all levels and multiplying impact across teams
  • Proficiency with AI-powered development tools to accelerate work while maintaining strong engineering fundamentals
What Will Make You Stand Out:
  • You have upstream open-source contributions or maintainer experience in widely-used projects
  • You bring hands-on experience with cloud platforms like AWS or Azure, container orchestration with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, or GitOps tooling such as ArgoCD
  • You have built artifact signing, attestation, or provenance systems in production environments
  • You have worked at an open-source, AI-focused, or data science company and understand the unique challenges of serving technical communities at scale
  • You have thrived in fast-paced startup environments where pragmatism and tradeoffs matter more than perfection
  • You push back constructively on timing and scope, asking 'why' before diving into 'how', and you advocate for technical investments that reduce long-term risk
  • You embody our values: 'Curious by Default', 'Build Together', 'Own It', and 'Lead with Guts and Heart', and our behaviors: Clarity, Care and Candor
  • You care deeply about fostering an environment where people of all backgrounds and experiences can flourish
Why You'll Like Working Here:
  • You'll thrive in a high-performance environment where results are recognized and rewarded
  • Your work directly contributes to shaping the future of data science, machine learning, and AI in the enterprise.
  • You'll work alongside a collaborative team that values diverse, thoughtful discussion, clarity and candor.
  • You'll be supported by a culture that puts employees first - with flexible hours, a fully remote setup, and a genuine commitment to your wellbeing and growth.

The application deadline for this role is 12/30/2026;applicants will be reviewed on an ongoing basis until the role is filled.

The base salary range for this role is $189,500 - $228,500, along with annual bonus potential, equity participation, and benefits.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by various factors, including work location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter will provide more specific details on the salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

In addition to base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  • Flexible Vacation Policy
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Short Term and Long Term Disability
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Monthly Wellness Stipend
  • Employee Assistance Program and Mental Health Resources

An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

Anaconda, Inc. (“We”, “Us”) are committed to protecting and respecting your privacy. This Privacy Notice sets out the basis on which the personal data collected from you, or that you provide to Us, will be processed by Us in connection with Our recruitment processes.

By clicking “Submit Application”, you acknowledge you have read our Privacy Policy and that Anaconda can retain your application data for up to 1-year, unless otherwise stated. raw.description:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

Responsible for leading, planning and execution of all data management activities for assigned projects, ensuring focus on data integrity, validity, reliability in accordance with standard processes, sponsor guidelines, industry best practices and regulatory standards. Act as coach, mentor and/or Subject Matter Expert within the department, aiding Manager in process improvements, issue escalation and training development and delivery. Support the department and company in achieving objectives and strategic goals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Data Management Operations Serve as primary contact overseeing all data management activities from study start-up through database lock, including data management plan creation, CRF development, database specifications, edit check testing, and data review processes.
  • Database Development & Quality Control Coordinate database build and testing with programmers, define and validate edit checks, perform data review and query management, and process/reconcile electronic data from multiple sources (CIMS, Safety database, labs, IRT).
  • Team Leadership & Supervision Coordinate and supervise 1-7 Data Management staff members, providing training, mentorship, and conducting performance reviews while managing project resources within budget and timelines.
  • Stakeholder Communication & Project Coordination Participate in and lead internal/sponsor meetings, work directly with project managers and teams, track study progress, issue status reports, and serve as escalation point for data-related issues.
  • Training & Documentation Management Develop and deliver training programs for investigators, clinical sites, project teams and sponsors on data collection processes and tools; ensure study documentation is maintained and properly stored in trial master files.
  • Department Development & Process Improvement Contribute to continuous improvement through information sharing, coach and mentor peers, participate in or lead development of SOPs/policies, and support cross-functional working groups.
  • Strategic Support & Advocacy Act as Subject Matter Expert within the department, support manager with process improvements and issue escalation, and promote data management excellence internally and externally.
  • Compliance & Standards Ensure all activities adhere to standard processes, sponsor guidelines, industry best practices, and regulatory standards while supporting departmental and company strategic goals.

Skills & Qualifications

  • A minimum of a one-to-two-year post-secondary certification in a relevant field of study, and 4-6 years of related work experience in Clinical Data Management with ongoing training.
  • Life Sciences or Clinical Research specialty and CCDM (Certified Clinical Data Manager) certification preferred.
  • Ability to set personal pace and prioritize tasks with significant autonomy.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with patience and tact for managing regular contacts with team members, vendors, and clients

What We Offer

    In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

    • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
    • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
    • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
    • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
    • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
    • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
    • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
    • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

      • Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to Apply

    To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

    Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
    Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to .
Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams

Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process.

Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.

raw.description:
About ThriveStudio:

ThriveStudio helps people turn information into visuals others actually understand: presentations, reports, infographics, posters, and more. Our users are teachers, marketers, nonprofits, and teams who aren’t designers and shouldn’t need to be. We’re looking for a Product Manager to work on features end to end and make the creation experience measurably better.

Location:

Remote (EU)

Job Overview:

You’ll work on features from discovery through launch and iteration. You’ll work daily with engineering, design, QA, and support. About 75% of your time is hands-on building: specs, prototypes, rollout plans, and release follow-through. The rest is deciding what comes next. You’ll work AI-first, using AI tools daily for research, specs, and prototypes.

What You'll Do:

  • Define the user problem, success metrics, and trade-offs for your feature area, then run discovery through interviews, data, prototypes, and experiments.
  • Write PRDs and tickets with clear objectives, non-goals, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and a rollout plan.
  • Build a clickable prototype with AI for every feature. Engineers build from your prototype, not from a meeting.
  • Keep your product queue ranked and trusted, so nobody has to ask what’s next.
  • Decide how each feature rolls out (who gets it, behind what gate), and set up monitoring and analytics before launch.
  • Keep help docs, release notes, and internal enablement accurate.
  • Evaluate where AI genuinely helps users. Write evaluation criteria and a fallback before building any AI feature.

What You Bring To This Role:

  • 3-5 years of product management experience, with a record of shipping features that solved real problems and moved a measurable metric.
  • Strong discovery and analytics skills. You pull your own numbers and design clean experiments.
  • Specs and prototypes that need no interpretation.
  • You’re comfortable reading code with an AI agent and tracing a feature from request to database. You can set up test data and run the product yourself without waiting on engineering.
  • Working knowledge of AI concepts (prompts, tokens, models) and the cost and latency trade-offs behind them.
  • Clear, high-signal communication across product, design, engineering, and support.
  • Experience with editors, design tools, or content creation products is a plus.

What Success Looks Like:

Your features move a measurable metric. Engineers are unblocked because your requirements and decisions are clear. You’ll be the go-to person for your product area and ready to own a full roadmap.

Learn More About ThriveCart:

Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and continuous growth. We foster an open environment with regular knowledge-sharing sessions and encourage active participation in shaping the platform. Our values include:

  • Commit to Excellence – We believe in delivering high-quality work and continuous improvement.
  • User-Focused Problem Solving – Every design should contribute to solving a real problem for our users.
  • Team Collaboration – We work better together, valuing input from every team member.
  • Growth Mindset – We embrace challenges as opportunities to learn and grow.

Our team and product are growing rapidly- we achieved YoY growth of 64% from 2022-2023, and we’re just getting started. We believe in open communication, clear goal setting, and that people do best when they have a growth mindset and want to get things done. Our team comes from diverse backgrounds and companies like Shopify, Salesforce, and BigCommerce, and we are running like an independent SaaS company within a PE fund.

About the Role & Team

The Payroll Operations Specialist supports the compliance infrastructure that keeps our customers’ payroll operations running smoothly. You’ll own operational workflows across state registrations, employer account maintenance, workers’ compensation, business registrations, and related requirements.

You’ll work closely with Payroll Operations, Customer Support, Benefit, government agencies, insurance carriers, and external partners to resolve issues and deliver a strong customer experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Own end-to-end workflows across assigned areas, including state registrations, employer account maintenance, workers’ compensation, Foreign Qualification (FQAL), Registered Agent Administration (RAA), Statements of Information (SOI), and related requirements.
  • Research state and local requirements and determine the steps needed to establish and maintain employer accounts, business registrations, and coverage.
  • Work directly with government agencies, insurance carriers, brokers, and third-party partners to establish accounts, obtain information, and resolve issues.
  • Manage account, registration, and policy lifecycle changes, including registrations, updates, state additions, renewals, audits, transfers, and closures.
  • Investigate and resolve registration, account access, policy, coverage, and other operational issues.
  • Maintain accurate customer records, credentials, documentation, deadlines, and status tracking.
  • Communicate requirements, blockers, timelines, and next steps clearly to customers and internal partners.
  • Identify recurring issues and improve processes, documentation, controls, and automation.
  • Manage a high-volume workload while prioritizing time-sensitive and high-risk work.
  • Support other Payroll Operations initiatives and duties as business and team needs evolve.

What We’re Looking For

Location: 100% Remote

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of mobile development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile App Developer with strong Kotlin Multiplatform expertise and an excellent background in native Android development with Kotlin.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our application, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development. Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build Android applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our Android application using Kotlin and Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Design shared application logic and integrate it with platform-specific functionality.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical mobile challenges such as permissions, background execution, battery consumption, connectivity, and differences between devices.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and resolve problems that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and understandable explanations.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production Android applications with Kotlin.
  • Strong practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform, including shared code, platform-specific integrations, and the boundaries between them.
  • Solid understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack Compose, coroutines, Flow, application lifecycle, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills and the ability to investigate problems across application code, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain why an implementation is appropriate.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, sensor data, and proximity detection.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and signal-strength limitations.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful mobile development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing Android applications and Kotlin Multiplatform solutions.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio or GitHub links are welcome where available.

Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.
