Job Description:

Role: Solutions Architect


Who we are

RBRO Solutions builds best-of-breed software for the legal and corporate legal markets, serving customers around the globe. Join a modern, agile team that keeps us among the top companies in our industry.


Our core values: Innovation, Experience, Excellence, Partnership, Balance, Integrity, Diversity and Gratitude.


What to expect

  • Build your career with a growing technology company
  • A challenging, collaborative team environment
  • Competitive salary and medical benefits
  • Salary range: $90,000–$115,000 CAD

About the role

The Solutions Architect turns business needs into sound technical solutions. You will work with business leaders, project managers, vendor architects and subject-matter experts to identify needs, plan delivery alongside other initiatives, and make sure solutions are secure, scalable and maintainable.

Our products run as hosted cloud services and as on-premises installs at customer sites, so the role needs strong judgement across cloud, hybrid and on-premises designs.


Reports to: Director, Software Development/CTO


Responsibilities

Architecture and strategy

  • Own the target architecture and the roadmap that engineering teams deliver against, documenting current state, future state and the transition between them.
  • Lead modernization from .NET Framework 4.8 and Web API 2 to .NET 8/10 and ASP.NET Core, including containerizing Windows services.
  • Own security architecture: Entra ID, OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, JWT, secrets management (Key Vault, Secrets Manager), encryption of data in transit and at rest, and certificate handling.
  • Shape data architecture on SQL Server and PostgreSQL: schema design, stored-procedure conventions, migrations, reporting, and multi-region / DR data.
  • Make sure solutions meet non-functional requirements: security, high availability, reliability, scalability, auditability, capacity and performance.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and enterprise solutions, run impact assessments, and recommend what to adopt.

Solution design and delivery

  • Lead requirements gathering and turn business and non-functional requirements into solution designs, specifications and written architecture decision records.
  • Work with project managers on scope and effort estimates, and with analysts on requirements and test plans.
  • Document the costs, risks and benefits of each solution and communicate them to stakeholders and executives.
  • Confirm that teams implement designs as intended, and lead architecture governance and design reviews.
  • Take part in technical change control: changes are risk-rated, test requirements are defined, and costs and impacts are quantified.

Standards and technical leadership

  • Write and publish architecture standards, guidelines and best practices, and maintain a central architecture repository.
  • Improve CI/CD, test strategy and observability so releases are repeatable.
  • Help the development team with debugging, performance monitoring and tuning.
  • Mentor senior engineers and work with product, support and client-facing teams on technical decisions.
  • Push for simpler, streamlined business processes where the benefit outweighs the risk.

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent education and experience.
  • 5+ years in a solution architect or principle role.
  • Knowledge of microservices architecture and design principles.
  • Experience in cloud-intensive environments, with a sound understanding of cloud deployment and integration patterns (Azure or AWS).
  • Experience architecting multi-vendor environments on-premises, in the cloud and in hybrid models.
  • Working knowledge of application security best practices and tools for web, mobile and cloud applications.
  • Experience authoring architecture standards, guidelines and process documentation at system and enterprise level.
  • Ability to evaluate options on cost, risk and benefit, negotiate trade-offs between features and scalability, and drive decisions with multiple stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications

  • Legal-technology experience, especially iManage Work, NetDocuments or other document management systems.
  • Experience in SQL Server and PostgreSQL.
  • Container orchestration and infrastructure as code.
  • Real production exposure to high-availability issues, such as clustering.
  • Observability at scale with New Relic, Application Insights or NLog.
  • Data residency and compliance work for regulated clients.

Personal traits

  • Self-starter and creative problem-solver who can lead projects with minimal direction.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Pulls together technical and non-technical input and resolves ambiguity respectfully.
  • Clear communicator in writing, in conversation and in presentations.
  • Works well independently and with everyone from senior management to individual contributors; approachable and trusted by colleagues.

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

raw.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

THE COMMUNITY YOU WILL JOIN

Airbnb's Marketing Technology organization builds the infrastructure that powers how we reach and connect with guests and hosts around the world — from audience segmentation and campaign orchestration to last-mile delivery and real-time insights. Our engineers work at the intersection of scale, reliability, and product impact, building platforms that carry billions of messages each year across email, SMS, push, and WhatsApp. We are deeply committed to building AI-natively: agents and LLM-powered automation are becoming core to how we build, operate, and improve our systems.

You'll lead two closely partnered teams that together own Airbnb's communications platform end to end. The Orchestration team builds the systems that let marketing and product teams design and run personalized, event- and list-triggered customer journeys at Airbnb scale. The Delivery team owns the last mile — routing every notification through the right provider, tracking it to a terminal state, and managing contact preferences and vendor relationships. Both teams collaborate deeply with audience segmentation, content, ML, and data engineering teams, as well as product partners across the company.

THE DIFFERENCE YOU WILL MAKE

As the Engineering Manager for this team, you will be the primary technical leader for the systems that decide whether a message reaches a guest or host — and when. You'll set the technical direction, own roadmap execution, and build the kind of team culture where engineers grow and do the best work of their careers, including through deep, genuine adoption of AI-native engineering practices.

The platform is mid-transformation. We are consolidating legacy and next-generation messaging flows onto a single unified path, moving platform health from component metrics to business-impact signals such as campaign delivery SLAs and burn rate, and building end-to-end observability so any owner — human or agent — can answer "what happened to notification X for user Y" in minutes. At the same time, both teams are standing up agentic capabilities: an agent-driven orchestration layer, end-to-end lifecycle testing agents, smart notification scheduling, and AI-assisted on-call triage. You will be the leader who ensures these systems ship with the rigor, reliability, and operational maturity that production-grade messaging and agentic systems demand.

Your leadership will directly determine how reliably Airbnb communicates with its community, how confidently partner teams can build on the platform, and how effectively this team leads Marketing Technology's shift toward AI-native engineering.

A TYPICAL DAY

  • Lead planning, roadmap reviews, and cross-team syncs for Delivery and Orchestration, keeping delivery on track and stakeholders well-informed
  • Run 1:1s with engineers across both teams, with intentional focus on career growth, technical skill development, and early identification of blockers
  • Serve as the primary engineering point of contact for cross-team dependencies — fielding requests from product teams across Airbnb and making clear, reasoned prioritization calls
  • Partner with the Product Manager to sequence the roadmap across journey orchestration, bulk campaign sends, and delivery infrastructure
  • Drive technical strategy for end-to-end observability and SLA-driven delivery: campaign-level delivery tracking, health-gated ramping, dynamic pacing against budgets, and automatic provider failover
  • Oversee the design, delivery, and operational health of production agentic systems: agent-driven orchestration, lifecycle testing agents, smart scheduling, and LLM-assisted on-call triage
  • Champion AI-native development practices across both teams — from AI-assisted coding and review to agents in CI/CD, on-call response, and delivery anomaly detection
  • Own the health and operational maturity of both teams: daytime and 24/7 on-call programs, blameless incident retrospectives, SLO definitions, runbook quality, and third-party messaging vendor escalations
  • Represent the communications platform in org-wide planning cycles and contribute to the broader Marketing Technology engineering strategy

YOUR EXPERTISE

Required

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years in an engineering management role leading platform or infrastructure teams
  • Demonstrated AI-native engineering mindset — you use AI tools daily in your own work, have led teams in genuinely adopting AI-assisted development, and have strong opinions about where agents add real leverage vs. hype
  • Experience leading teams that have designed, built, and operated production-grade agentic systems — autonomous or semi-autonomous agent pipelines, LLM-orchestrated workflows, or multi-agent architectures handling real production traffic
  • Strong technical foundation in high-throughput distributed systems: event-driven architectures, message queues and streaming (Kafka or similar), workflow orchestration engines (Temporal or similar), and multi-provider integrations — able to engage credibly in architecture and design conversations
  • Track record of running reliable, customer-facing production services with defined SLOs, including on-call programs, incident management, and operational excellence across teams of varying size and seniority
  • Demonstrated experience managing engineers across a range of seniority levels, including early-career engineers, with a track record of meaningful career growth outcomes
  • Experience owning cross-team platform relationships: managing inbound dependency requests, negotiating priorities, and communicating commitments with confidence
  • Track record of delivering complex, multi-quarter technical roadmaps — including large-scale migrations or legacy system consolidations — in fast-moving environments

Preferred

  • Experience with notification, messaging, or communications infrastructure at scale — email, SMS, push, or WhatsApp delivery.
  • Experience with customer journey orchestration, marketing automation, or lifecycle messaging platforms
  • Hands-on familiarity with agent frameworks and orchestration tooling (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, Autogen, Temporal, or similar) and practical knowledge of where these systems break down in production
  • Experience building end-to-end observability and business-impact alerting for multi-hop asynchronous pipelines
  • Experience managing teams that own 24/7 on-call rotations and production services with external SLAs or vendor dependencies

YOUR LOCATION

This role is eligible for remote work within the United States. Employees may optionally use any of our US office locations. We expect team members to be available during core collaboration hours in their time zone and to participate in occasional onsite gatherings as the team and org schedule them, typically 2–4 times per year.

OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION & BELONGING

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases.

We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making.

Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here’s how the Director, Digital Experience Ecosystem will make an impact:

The Director, Digital Experience Ecosystem Lead is responsible for the technology ownership, strategy, performance, and continuous evolution of the Digital Experience ecosystem, with a focus on Content Management Systems (CMS), web and digital channels, experience delivery, integrations, and supporting capabilities.

Working closely with Commercial, Medical Affairs, Corporate Affairs and IT leadership, this role translates business and digital experience priorities into technology strategies, roadmaps, and scalable solutions. The Director will serve as the technology leader for Viatris' CMS platform and broader digital experience ecosystem, enabling consistent, scalable digital capabilities across Commercial, Medical, Corporate Affairs, and other enterprise digital channels.

Key responsibilities for this role include:

1. Digital Experience Strategy & Business Partnership

  • Serve as the primary technology partner for Digital Experiences, building strong partnerships across Commercial, Medical Affairs, Corporate Affairs, and other channel owners with shared priorities, clear accountability, and joint ownership of outcomes.
  • Define and drive the technology strategy and roadmap for the Digital Experience ecosystem, balancing shared enterprise capabilities with the distinct business, customer, and regulatory needs of each function.
  • Translate business priorities, customer and stakeholder needs, and channel strategies into scalable technology capabilities and digital experiences.
  • Provide strategic technology guidance and recommendations to support digital experience decisions, investments, and future capabilities across the enterprise.

2. Digital Experience Product & Ecosystem Management

  • Partner across MarTech, CRM, Data, Architecture, Security, Privacy, Compliance, and other technology teams to manage dependencies and deliver connected customer experiences.

  • Manage technology vendors, system integrators, and service providers, ensuring accountability for quality, performance, timelines, cost, and outcomes.

raw.description:
Location: Fully remote
Company: Latvia-based startup
Compensation: We operate on a startup budget. Compensation will be discussed transparently during the hiring process and paid monthly in USD.
Engagement type: Full-time
Working hours: Flexible

About Us

We are a Latvia-based startup building a finance function that combines accurate accounting, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and practical AI automation.

We are looking for a finance professional who can personally manage our accounting, configure the systems supporting it and use AI agents to carry out the work more efficiently.

Job Description

You will personally perform and take ownership of our accounting and financial operations, using AI agents to support your work. Your responsibilities will cover daily bookkeeping, reconciliations, closing, financial reporting, cash planning and applicable Latvian tax reporting.

You will personally carry out the complete migration from QuickBooks to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, using AI agents to support your work. You will be responsible for all implementation tasks, from planning and data preparation through configuration, import, validation and go-live. No external implementation partners will be involved. As part of preparing and importing the data, you will review the complete accounting records for the past five years, identify gaps and errors, and reconcile the migrated data to the source records. You must be comfortable both doing the accounting and setting up the accounting system.

AI agents will assist with document processing, transaction preparation, matching, reconciliation and reporting. You will define their tasks, supervise their execution, investigate exceptions and verify their outputs. You remain responsible for the accuracy and completeness of the work.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform day-to-day bookkeeping, accounts payable and receivable, invoicing, expense accounting and bank reconciliations.
  • Complete month-end and year-end closing, balance sheet reconciliations, accruals and supporting documentation.
  • Set up, configure and maintain Business Central, including the chart of accounts, posting groups, dimensions, VAT setup, bank accounts, accounting periods and relevant financial workflows.
  • Personally execute the complete migration from QuickBooks to Business Central, including data extraction, account and tax mapping, cleansing, system configuration, trial imports, reconciliation and go-live. Review all accounting records for the past five years during migration preparation and import, investigate missing or incorrect entries, document corrections and preserve supporting documents and a traceable audit trail.
  • Prepare and manage applicable Latvian tax and statutory reporting, including VAT, corporate income tax, payroll-related obligations and VID/EDS processes.
  • Handle international customers, suppliers, contractors, foreign currencies and cross-border transactions.
  • Manage cash-flow forecasts, budgets, runway monitoring and management reporting.
  • Prepare payments and administer payroll and contractor payments within agreed approval controls.
  • Configure, instruct and supervise AI agents supporting accounting workflows; improve their performance through clear instructions, reliable source data and systematic verification.
  • Maintain traceability from original documents to accounting entries, resolve exceptions and protect confidential financial information.
  • Identify practical opportunities to reduce costs, improve financial controls and apply lawful tax efficiencies.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience personally performing the full accounting cycle for companies in one or more European countries.
  • Practical experience with accounting, taxation and statutory reporting in one or more European countries, and the ability to apply and verify Latvian requirements. Direct Latvian accounting and VID/EDS experience is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience independently setting up and configuring Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central for real accounting operations, with the ability to personally execute a complete accounting-system migration.
  • The ability to translate business requirements into appropriate accounting configuration and verify that postings, reconciliations and reports work correctly.
  • Practical experience using AI agents or AI-supported automation in finance or accounting, including supervising outputs and handling errors.
  • Strong spreadsheet and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate incomplete records and reconcile inconsistent data.
  • Independent working habits, ownership of deadlines and clear communication with the founder.
  • Professional working proficiency in English and the ability to work effectively with Latvian-language financial documents and reporting requirements.
  • A relevant accounting or finance qualification, or equivalent substantial practical experience.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building or improving the accounting function of a startup or small international business.
  • QuickBooks to Business Central migrations, Business Central implementations and comprehensive reviews and correction of historical accounting records.
  • Configuring integrations with banks, payment platforms, document systems and Microsoft 365.
  • Power Automate, Power BI, APIs or comparable tools used in practical finance workflows.
  • Accounting for digital services, subscriptions and international contractor relationships.
  • Preparing financial information for funding discussions or due diligence.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote role with direct collaboration with the founder.
  • Responsibility for both the accounting work and the systems supporting it.
  • The opportunity to shape how Business Central and AI agents work together in a startup.
  • A practical environment where reliable execution, sensible automation and cost awareness matter.

Remote Working Arrangement

You will organize your work independently, communicate progress clearly and meet agreed accounting and reporting deadlines. Financial systems and confidential information must be handled securely.

This is a full-time role with flexible working hours. You will organize your schedule around agreed accounting and reporting deadlines.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and briefly describe:

  • The European countries in which you have personally handled accounting and tax reporting, and your specific responsibilities.
  • A Business Central implementation or accounting-system migration you personally executed, including the setup, data migration and validation you performed yourself, and any experience with QuickBooks or historical accounting reviews.
  • How you have used AI agents or automation to perform accounting work and verify its accuracy.

Use anonymized examples and clearly distinguish your own work from work delivered by others.

raw.description:
Long Wall Company was created in 2024 to accelerate missile defense technology for the U.S. and our allies. We specialize in ballistic missile defense and are developing Cyclops, a low-cost, mass-producible interceptor. We also produce containerized launchers and offer low-cost targets for threat replication. The future of global security depends on defensive technology that redefines cost, magazine depth, and distribution to deter and defend against evolving threats. Join us.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

Mission-Driven Problem Solvers– The problems in missile defense demand ingenuity. We want engineers, technicians, and corporate professionals who approach challenges with curiosity, embrace failure as a learning opportunity, and stay focused on delivering the best solution for the mission.

Total Ownership– We seek those who take full responsibility for delivering flight-ready work while recognizing that no one succeeds alone. The best engineers, technicians, and corporate professionals make their teammates better, knowing that complementary skills create force multiplication and drive mission success.

SRM Structures Design Engineer

DESCRIPTION

Long Wall is looking for an experienced Solid Rocket Motor (SRM) Structures Design Engineer to support the design, development, and production of SRMs for our interceptor system. This role is responsible for ensuring SRM motor cases, other primary structure, and secondary structure meet demanding missile interception requirements while maintaining manufacturability at scale. The SRM Structures Design Engineer serves as the technical authority for the design of SRM structural components. Responsibilities include design and analysis of motor cases, internal and external joints, raceways, flight equipment mounting, reviewing and interpreting static fire and flight test data, providing technical oversight and direction to suppliers, and defining requirements and verifying compliance throughout development and production. The successful candidate will establish rigorous design methods while driving efficient program execution. They will work closely with propulsion, ballistics, structures and dynamics, aerodynamics, guidance and control, manufacturing, and systems engineering teams to ensure structural design decisions remain aligned with system-level performance, technical baselines, and program objectives.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design SRM structural components to meet technical requirements, including pressure vessels, vehicle primary structure, and secondary structures.
  • Develop, refine, and validate design methods and tools for motor cases, igniter structure, and vehicle integration.
  • Review and provide oversight to suppliers designing structural components for integration into the Cyclops vehicle.
  • Review test data from component structural tests, including solid rocket motor static tests.
  • Prepare, present, and explain technical results to government partners, customers, and suppliers.
  • Other duties as assigned.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a technical discipline, or equivalent experience in complex aerospace or defense development.
  • 5+ years of experience with solid rocket motors or composite structures.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Proficiency with NX, Creo, or other parametric CAD software.
  • Proficiency with product definition creation, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing and engineering drawings.
  • Experience with the design and development of filament-wound pressure vessels and other composite structures.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively in fast‑paced environments that combine private‑investment‑driven development with government test requirements.
  • Ability to interpret engineering artifacts, requirements, and configurations and convert them into actionable activities.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills; capable of aligning engineering teams, surfacing risks early, and maintaining clarity across disciplines.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner closely across technical disciplines with technical authorities (chief engineering, systems engineering, mission assurance), customers, and suppliers to ensure disciplined technical execution.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Hands-on manufacturing experience with composite structures, including filament winding and hand lay-up.
  • Proficiency in MATLAB, Python, C++, FORTRAN, or similar programming languages.
  • Experience supporting missile defense, launch vehicle development, aerospace hardware integration, or other technically complex systems.
  • Familiarity with requirements flow‑down, verification planning, ICD management, and configuration control.
  • Prior experience working within a hybrid program environment (internal rapid development + government‑funded test campaigns).
  • Ability to translate ambiguous technical requirements into executable work.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • This position requires a national security suitability screening following offer acceptance.
  • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods.
  • Ability to use a computer for assignments and communicate effectively in person, via telepresence, and by phone.
  • Ability to travel between Long Wall sites as needed.

ITAR Requirement

This position requires access to information protected under US export control laws, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations and/or the Export Administration Regulations. As such, US person status (including US citizens, U.S. permanent residents, individuals granted U.S. asylum status, or individuals admitted in U.S. refugee status) is a required qualification for this position.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, genetics, or citizenship status (when otherwise legally authorized to work and access export-controlled data) and will not be discriminated against on the basis of such characteristics or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. We encourage applicants of all ages.
National Security Suitability
Depending on the position, Long Wall may require the successful completion of a national security suitability screening in addition to its standard background check. Where required, the screening is conducted by Long Wall’s Facility Security Officer following offer acceptance and may include verification of any current or prior U.S. government security clearances or public trust positions. Information provided during the screening is used solely to determine suitability for the role and is held in confidence by Security. For positions subject to this requirement, any offer of employment is contingent upon a favorable suitability determination.

raw.title: Senior Software Engineer - Autonomous Vehicles
raw.excerpt: Self-driving cars need to know where the road goes, in real time, with no prior map to lean on.
raw.description:
Self-driving cars need to know where the road goes, in real time, with no prior map to lean on. We’re building the perception-based world model stack that makes this possible. It takes raw multi-sensor input and produces a live, accurate 3D model of lanes, boundaries, crosswalks, intersection topology, and traffic control semantics. It also fuses perception, map, and localization data into a consistent model of the driving environment that the rest of the driving stack depends on.

You will join a team of world-class software engineers improving these algorithms. This is a software engineering role: algorithms are only as good as the software that runs them, so we need an engineer who obsesses over quality, performance, and architecture, and who can turn algorithmic ideas into safe, fast, maintainable code for production vehicles on NVIDIA DRIVE Orin and Thor. Your code will meet ASIL-B/D requirements and ship across L2++, L3, and L4 programs.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Build and own core online world model and context fusion software that runs in the car, from architecture through implementation to deployment.
  • Write production C++ for real-time embedded systems, with a focus on correctness, determinism, and maintainability.
  • Design software architecture, interfaces, and data flows that promote code reuse and clean boundaries across vehicle programs, while meeting CPU, memory, and latency budgets.
  • Profile complex pipelines, find bottlenecks, and deliver measurable improvements in CPU utilization, memory usage, and end-to-end latency, backed by reproducible measurements on Orin and Thor.
  • Develop benchmarks and performance regression tests that track improvements and prevent regressions.
  • Use GPU parallelism (CUDA) where it helps to accelerate compute-heavy mapping components.
  • Implement and integrate algorithmic solutions from the mapping team into NVIDIA’s AV stack, working closely with algorithm engineers to understand and refine them while preserving behavior, output quality, and correctness.
  • Develop to automotive safety standards (ASIL-B/D): apply strong static analysis, follow safety-oriented coding guidelines, and achieve 100% line and branch coverage with rigorous unit and integration tests.
  • Build software that is robust to the varied conditions and failure modes of vehicles operating around the world.
  • Contribute to code reviews and uphold the team’s quality and safety expectations.

What we need to see:

  • PhD with 1+ year, MS with 3+ years, or BS with 5+ years of relevant experience in Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience building robust, production-quality software
  • 3+ years of professional modern C++ development, with a strong grasp of memory management, concurrency, and performance.
  • Demonstrated ability to profile and optimize CPU utilization, memory consumption, and latency using profilers and benchmarks under representative workloads.
  • Solid understanding of algorithms and data structures and their impact on performance.
  • Experience designing software architecture and APIs for large, long-lived codebases.
  • A quality-first, systematic approach to debugging and optimization: comfort with static analysis, unit testing, and high-coverage test strategies.
  • Ability to work with algorithm developers and understand their work.
  • Strong communication and analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple teams.
  • Autonomous and responsible, a strong team player who enjoys solving hard problems, with a passion for robotics and autonomous vehicles.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Software development on embedded, real-time, or automotive platforms, including RTOS experience (e.g., QNX, Linux RT), experience with functional safety standards and processes (ISO 26262, ASIL-B/D), MISRA or AUTOSAR C++ guidelines, and safety-qualified toolchains.
  • GPGPU programming (CUDA) and GPU performance tuning.
  • Cache-aware data layouts, memory allocation optimization, multithreading, or SIMD/vectorization.
  • Experience with 3D geometry and graphics.
  • Experience building efficient, reusable APIs and frameworks for complex systems.

#AutonomousVehicles

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:
152,000 USD – 241,500 USD for Level 3; and 184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 13, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

raw.description:
Director I, AP Statistics Curriculum and Assessment

College Board – AP&I

Location:

  • This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type:

  • This is a full-time position

About the Team

The AP Curriculum and Assessment Team at College Board (125+ staff) collaborates with colleagues across all aspects of the AP Program to develop, manage, and deliver AP’s 43 courses in a wide variety of subject areas. AP® is a rigorous academic program built on the commitment, passion, and hard work of students and educators from secondary schools and higher education. AP provides willing and academically prepared high school students with the opportunity to study and learn at the college level. AP’s course teams comprised of educators and disciplinary experts ensure that course curricula are aligned to higher education expectations and reflect the state of the art in the discipline, contribute to instructional resources and tools for teachers, and develop assessments that allow students in these courses to demonstrate their mastery of course content and skills. AP leads in strategic use of AI to expand student access, strengthen instructional design and professional support, and enhance assessment creation and exam analysis. The Math, Computer Science, and Cybersecurity department, which includes precalculus, calculus, statistics, computer science, cybersecurity, and networking is currently comprised of approximately 22 people supporting 8 courses in the AP portfolio.

About the Opportunity

As the Director I, AP Statistics you will be responsible for preserving and improving the quality and validity of the AP Program’s core deliverables within the subject domain: the exam, the course curriculum, and the professional development content. You are also responsible for item development and management from authoring to administration; training and collaborating with subject-matter experts (SMEs), typically college professors and secondary school teachers. You will ethically and effectively integrate AI technologies in assessment creation and review. This includes judiciously using AI assisted tools to support fairness, validity, and innovation in AP assessments. You will train SMEs on assessment development protocols, translate between academics and technical experts (psychometricians), and collaborate to develop formative assessment materials and resources to support AP Statistics teachers worldwide. You will serve as a point of contact in AP for committees and communities of subject-matter experts and will be responsible for the curriculum and assessment for AP Statistics, and, in partnership with other AP teams, further the strategic growth of AP Statistics across the globe. Additionally, you may have the opportunity to present, speak, and moderate dialogue with academic and membership audiences to ensure that ongoing change and improvement within AP courses and exams is understood, accepted, and supported in secondary and post-secondary educational communities.

In this role, you will:


Assessment Development and Scoring (45-75%) 

  • Serve as an assessment leader for AP Statistics, with primary responsibility for assessment development for AP Statistics. Your work in developing and revising test content is of the quality that requires only minimal adjustments based on feedback from your manager and other program leaders.  
  • Independently lead processes for authoring and revising assessment content, including training educator constituents and leveraging generative AI to author and/or review assessment content, improving and/or making more efficient assessment processes and outputs. 
  • Independently lead the development and management of assessment content (formative and summative) and scoring materials for AP Statistics through iterative review stages with multiple internal and external stakeholders, including the AP Statistics Team, Assessment Production team, Test Development Committee, and the Chief Reader, as appropriate. 
  • Independently lead the development of assessment forms for AP Statistics, ensuring the AP Exam development aligns with approved curricula and test specifications. 
  • Lead multiple face-to-face, weekend meetings, and virtual meetings (during work week, evenings, or weekends) annually with the AP Statistics Test Development Committee. You strategize and develop an agenda and approach to ensure the committee’s meeting time is of the highest productivity; you successfully adapt and pivot during the meeting as needed; and you successfully resolve all post-meeting item content edits. 
  • Train and directly supervise Test Development Committee members in AP Statistics as content development contributors and reviewers. Recruit educators for the AP Statistics Development Committee and other opportunities to support AP Program. 
  • Lead the successful scoring of student responses for AP Statistics Exams at the annual scoring event in person and online—the “AP Reading”—and produce AP Reading publications materials for teacher and student use. You plan all year, with increasing intensity in the months leading up to the Reading, ensuring all workflow steps for this incredibly complex event, as well as all post-Reading activities, are accounted for and successfully executed.  

Assessment Quality and Process (10-15%)

  • Contribute to current research and best practices in assessment, and engage regularly with AP Curriculum & Assessment colleagues to align on standards and shared principles guiding AP’s assessment directions
  • Support assessment workstreams within the AP Math, Computer Science, and Cybersecurity.
  • Contribute to processes for efficient, high-quality assessment development.
  • Contribute to initiatives to refine and improve question task models as well as exam design in collaboration with AP Curriculum & Assessment leaders and aligned to other College Board initiatives to achieve psychometric and disciplinary best practices on AP Statistics exams.
  • Monitor exam validity, security, reliability, fairness, and quality, as well as reader reliability in accordance with established Program thresholds for AP Statistics exam, identifying areas for improvement.
  • Collaborate with psychometrics and AP Curriculum & Assessment staff to establish fair, reliable, and valid cut scores for AP Statistics exam.

Course Development, Program Support, and Stakeholder Engagement (5-25%)

  • Refine and improve AP Statistics Course Framework to ensure clear and explicit learning outcomes that align with strategic priorities, including ensuring college/disciplinary standards as well as expanding the scope of reaching a broader audience of AP students.
  • Collaborate with AP teams to support the development of new products for AP Statistics designed to address unmet teacher instructional needs, potentially including developing prototypes, participating in small-scale market-testing, and creating models for subsequent development in conjunction with other AP workstreams. 
  • Recruit educators for the AP Statistics Development Committee and other opportunities to support AP Program.
  • Serve as a recognized and trusted resource within the educator community by collaboration and engagement with the community to drive teacher satisfaction with AP Statistics and its exam.
  • Collaborate with the AP Professional learning team to support AP Statistics consultants and teachers.
  • Work with the AP Higher Education team to co-develop and implement plans to raise college and university awareness of AP Statistics courses and exams, including recruiting college faculty to participate in the AP Reading, co-leading the planning and execution of discipline-specific AP Faculty Colloquia events, and supporting Visiting and Virtual Fellows Programs. 

About You

You (have):

  • A Master’s degree in Statistics or a directly related discipline, and knowledge of current trends in the discipline (required), although a doctorate in the discipline is strongly preferred
  • Expertise in Statistics with at least 5 years of experience in standardized assessment development or related work; experience with digital assessment and teaching preferred
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, with solid technical proficiency and a customer-focused mindset
  • Excellent organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and maintain close attention to detail, including proofreading
  • Demonstrated ability to implement processes and procedures, manage project plans and schedules, and maintain tracking documentation
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across all levels, and engage in giving and receiving constructive feedback
  • Ability to travel 6-8 times per year, plus up to two additional weeks for the AP Reading; must be eligible to work in the United States

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $96,000 to $135,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

Where do you belong?

Your career is more than just a job, it's part of your life. Whether you’re a clinician, or non-clinical professional, at USACS you'll feel a sense of connection working with clinicians and office staff who share your interests and values. We want you to love coming to work each day because you believe in what you do and the people with whom you work. We care about your success.

USACS also understands that location is important. We offer career opportunities for clinicians and non-clinical support staff from New York to Hawaii and numerous points in between. Our supportive culture, outstanding benefits and competitive compensation package is best in class.

Job Description

The Point of Contact, Provider Enrollment serves as a vital support resource for the Provider Enrollment team. This role involves resolving enrollment issues by answering staff inquiries, providing expert recommendations, verifying payer requirements, monitoring enrollment status, and ensuring proper follow-up on Provider Issue Forms. The position also facilitates both group and individual provider enrollments with commercial and government payers, helping to streamline processes and maintain compliance.

Location: Remote


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Monitor enrollment status for group and individuals.
  • Performs and assists with other department duties as required.
  • Act as the primary resource for Provider Enrollment staff by promptly resolving questions and concerns, providing clear guidance, and escalating complex issues to the Team Lead or Manager when necessary.
  • Deliver coaching, training, and quality audits on assigned tasks to enhance team knowledge and accuracy. Collaborate closely with the Team Lead to assess team performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and drive continuous operational excellence.
  • Support the Team Lead in tracking inventory and production metrics, proactively managing workflow, and facilitating timely escalation to ensure smooth operations and meet organizational goals.
  • Develop proficiency in engaging with payors to address and resolve identified enrollment issues efficiently.
  • Research and review individual Provider Issue Forms to determine appropriate follow-up actions and resolutions.
  • Collaborate with the Team Lead to review risks and concerns related to missing documents, ensuring timely mitigation.
  • Maintain and update critical documentation including payer enrollment matrices, standard operating procedures (SOPs), new site sheets, email templates, and welcome letters to support consistent communication and process adherence.
  • Generate and distribute detailed reports on provider credentialing and enrollment data to various departments, supporting informed decision-making across the organization.
  • Stay current on evolving state enrollment requirements for both group and individual providers to ensure compliance and accurate application processing.
  • Assist Contract Implementation staff by accurately documenting enrollment and billing requirements tied to payer contracts.
  • Support IntelliCred Application Mapping efforts to optimize enrollment workflows.
  • Facilitate the completion and submission of payer enrollment applications for government and commercial payers, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
  • Monitor application statuses continuously to detect emerging issues early and communicate them effectively to the team for prompt resolution.
  • Perform and assist with other department duties as required to support overall team success.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Meticulous follow-through on delegated tasks, ensuring completion, quality, and adherence to deadlines through effective staff coordination.
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities, including commitment to team development, adaptability to change, and alignment with organizational goals and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, consistently producing highly accurate work.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify issues and implement effective solutions.
  • Proven ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple tasks efficiently in a dynamic work environment.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the capacity to balance competing priorities and meet deadlines effectively.
  • Ability to thrive in a multi-tasking environment while maintaining focus and productivity.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, fostering positive relationships with clinicians, external agencies, and management.
  • Proficient oral and written communication skills, delivering information clearly, courteously, and professionally across diverse audiences.
  • Proficient in using personal computers (Windows) with strong emphasis on Microsoft Office programs including Outlook, Word, Excel, and Adobe Acrobat.
  • Ability to maintain patience and composure in difficult situations, always demonstrating professionalism.
  • Capacity to work well under pressure and consistently meet strict deadlines.
  • Commitment to maintain confidentiality and handling sensitive information appropriately.
  • Dedication to teamwork by supporting company and department goals, assisting colleagues in developing their knowledge, and positively adapting to change.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience in healthcare provider enrollment.
  • Experience working with government and commercial payers strongly preferred.
  • Prior experience in a fast-paced healthcare environment is an asset.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for prolonged periods and occasionally walk, stand, bend, stoop, and lift up to 15 pounds.
  • Required to have close visual acuity to perform the job.

At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career

About This Role:

Manager, Commercial Field Support

Reporting into: Senior Director, Customer Experience


Position Summary

The Field Support Representatives (FSRs) play a critical role in supporting iRhythm’s field sales organization and advancing the service and retention efforts of iRhythm’s business. The team works most directly with Territory Managers, Key Account Managers, and Regional Sales Directors while also supporting customers through key operational needs.


The Manager, Commercial Field Support, who leads the Field Support Representatives, is responsible for day-to-day execution, coaching, and performance of the FSR organization while helping shape its continued evolution. As the organization matures, this leader will be expected to bring forward leadership, innovation, and operational discipline to help transform the team from primarily reactive support toward a more proactive model that supports and manages meaningful portions of iRhythm’s business through strong service, retention, and field partnership.


This leader coaches both FSRs and Data Coordinator team members to consistently deliver exceptional support to field sales partners and customers. Core areas of team responsibility include account onboarding, account operations support, inventory and shipment coordination, user maintenance, management of special instructions, issue resolution, reporting and insights, and triaging escalations. The Manager partners closely with the Senior Manager, FSR and Senior Director Customer Experience, as well as with Sales, Key Account Management, Customer Care, Clinical Operations, Inventory, and other cross-functional teams to improve account support, customer experience, and team performance.


The ideal candidate is a collaborative people leader who enjoys coaching others, solving complex operational challenges, and identifying innovative ways to evolve team capabilities within a fast-paced medical technology environment.


What You'll Do

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of FSRs to achieve individual, team, and organizational goals.
  • Partner closely with Senior Manager, FSR and Senior Director, Customer Experience to continue to elevate and evolve how this team serves the Commercial Org + Customers.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Conduct regular coaching conversations, performance reviews, and development planning.
  • Support onboarding, training, mentoring, and career development for new and existing team members.
  • Help build future leadership capability by identifying and developing high-potential talent.

Operational Excellence

  • Ensure consistent execution of standardized workflows, operating procedures, and service expectations.
  • Monitor team performance against key operational metrics, service levels, and quality standards.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, eliminate manual work, and streamline processes.
  • Support implementation of new systems, tools, automation, and workflow improvements.
  • Escalate systemic issues and recommend solutions that improve team performance and customer experience.

Commercial Partnership

  • Build strong working relationships with Territory Managers, Regional Sales Directors, Key Account Managers, and Customer Care teams.
  • Partner with commercial teams to resolve customer challenges and improve operational performance.
  • Ensure FSRs are viewed as trusted partners who help drive customer success rather than simply responding to requests.
  • Reinforce role clarity and appropriate ownership across cross-functional teams.

Service, Retention & Field Support

  • Lead a team responsible for supporting the service and retention efforts of iRhythm’s business while balancing customer experience, field sales priorities, and operational efficiency.
  • Coach FSRs to move beyond reactive request management by proactively supporting field sales partners, monitoring account needs, identifying customer risks, and helping resolve issues before they impact customer experience or retention.
  • Use operational reporting, account insights, regional business trends, and customer support data to guide coaching, prioritization, resource allocation, and day-to-day decision-making.
  • Partner with Territory Managers, Key Account Managers, Regional Sales Directors, and cross-functional teams to improve account onboarding, operational execution, customer issue resolution, and service continuity.
  • Develop team capability around account onboarding, operational support, managing special instructions, reporting and insights, escalation triage, and proactive support of customer service and retention activities.

Continuous Improvement

  • Encourage team members to identify root causes and recommend scalable solutions.
  • Participate in cross-functional improvement initiatives and organizational projects.
  • Share feedback from customers and field partners to improve products, systems, and processes.
  • Help drive adoption of best practices across the FSR organization.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • 5–8 years of experience in medical device, healthcare technology, diagnostics, or related healthcare industry.
  • 2–5 years of people leadership experience leading customer-facing or commercial support teams OR consistent proven peer leadership experience at IRTC.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% of the time to effectively contribute to Commercial Leadership meetings, Commercial Business + Training sessions, Host or Attend functional offsites, etc.
  • Demonstrated success coaching and developing high-performing teams.
  • Strong operational problem-solving and organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.
  • Experience working cross-functionally in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to balance day-to-day execution with continuous improvement initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Remote U.S.-based role; preference for candidates residing in Texas or Illinois to align with current business and hiring priorities.
  • Experience supporting field sales organizations.
  • Knowledge of healthcare operations and customer workflows.
  • AI Literacy to drive efficiency and innovation to service line
  • Experience with CRM platforms, operational reporting, and workflow management tools.
  • Experience implementing process improvements or leading operational initiatives.

Leadership Competencies

The successful candidate consistently demonstrates the ability to:

  • Lead with integrity, empathy, and accountability.
  • Develop and coach high-performing teams.
  • Build trusted partnerships across Commercial and Operations.
  • Drive consistency through strong execution.
  • Identify operational challenges and improve processes.
  • Navigate ambiguity with sound judgment.
  • Communicate effectively across all levels of the organization.
  • Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
  • Balance customer needs with business priorities.
  • Embrace change, bring forward innovative ideas, and help others successfully navigate the evolution of the FSR organization.

Are you ready to join a growing team that puts a premium on productivity and has an award-winning culture centered around transforming talented employees into effective business leaders? Then BHG Financial is the place for you.
In 2001, we started with an idea, an opportunity, and $25,000. Back then, our focus was strictly  on serving those in the medical industry. With healthcare in our heritage, we soon expanded  to serve high-earning professionals in many  other industries, providing all with leading-edge financial solutions, including our extensive network of community banks.
Today, BHG Financial has firmly established  its legacy as a leader in the financial services space. Founded on the philosophy of a better way to borrow, we are dedicated to helping accomplished professionals, small businesses, and institutions build upon their success through innovative financial solutions, a hassle-free process, and personalized concierge service.
Our relentless commitment to the success of our customers is part of what has made BHG Financial thrive. We take a 360-degree view of our customers to tailor the best solutions for their financial aspirations. Today's professionals have multiple sources of income, not just their paycheck. Therefore, it is essential to factor those in when making responsible lending decisions. Our continued focus on data, analytics, and proprietary modeling has enabled faster funding for our customers.
From business to personal loans to relationships with community banks, the country’s top professionals and business owners rely on us for our exceptional financial solutions and concierge service to continue their success and legacy.

Who You Are

You are a motivated Accounting professional who is passionate about the financial industry. You excel at being detail-oriented and have experience with day-to-day accounting tasks in a fast-moving environment. In this role, you will need to be a self-starter who is skilled in communicating with cross-functional partners who have different backgrounds, levels, and experiences. A successful Tax Accountant candidate will be able to manage complex workflows that involve multiple stakeholders and build strong relationships across teams.

What You'll Do

  • Federal and State tax return compliance
  • Prepare annual 1099 filings
  • Fixed asset records maintenance
  • Sales and use tax compliance
  • Taxable income and distribution projections and expense accrual forecasts
  • Assist with tax research and memos

  • Bachelor’s degree is required
  • CPA preferred
  • 2-4 years of tax compliance experience with exposure to partnership or indirect tax
  • Excel experience required; Workday is a plus
  • Self-motivated and strong work ethic, with an ability to work independently on multiple projects simultaneously
  • Experience implementing controls and improving processes
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills
  • Able to learn quickly and adapt to fast-pace, deadline-oriented environment
  • Able to organize, prioritize tasks and take accountability

We consider people our #1 asset, and help employees realize their full potential, set and exceed their goals, and explore new opportunities for personal and professional development.

We strive to offer amenities, opportunities, events, and programming that support the interests of our teams, while furthering the culture that makes us Great Place to Work® certified. Some of the benefits you can expect when you join BHG Financial include:
•Medical/Rx/Dental/Vision coverage for employees and their eligible family members
•Competitive PTO and vacation policies
•1 Friday off each month for Wellness Weekends
•Company 401(k) plan with employer contributions after one year
•Company-sponsored training and certification opportunities
•Quarterly award ceremonies where top achievers are celebrated and receive additional bonuses
•Ongoing volunteer opportunities to give back to the community through our BHG Cares program
If you’re ready for a career where you can exercise your passions, be surrounded by co-workers who are relentlessly committed to service, and have a team-player mindset, apply today!

raw.description:
Director, Compliance & Quality Systems

Role Summary

The Director, Compliance & Quality Systems owns ECL's Quality Management System (QMS). You will play an key role in finalizing the design, build, and implementation of the ECL QMS—a critical step toward GMP compliance—and you'll lead ECL through its first client audits and regulatory inspections. Once the QMS is established, you will oversee everyday operations and continuous compliance.

ECL operates from a single site today and will expand to additional sites in the near future. You'll ensure the QMS is designed to scale, so all sites launch with the same quality standard. You'll build and lead a focused team to drive GMP compliance.

This hands-on leadership role offers the opportunity to shape ECL's QMS, embedding quality processes directly into ECL's novel software-driven laboratory platform. We're looking for a leader with deep compliance expertise, as well as the curiosity and agility to reimagine how those requirements are met in a software-driven, connected environment.

Key Responsibilities

QMS Ownership:

  • Own ECL's QMS processes end to end: document control, deviations, OOS, CAPA, change control, risk management, equipment qualification, supplier quality and GMP training
  • Monitor QMS execution at current and future sites through quality metrics, periodic reviews, and internal audits
  • Ensure the ECL QMS meets client quality requirements and the terms of each Quality Agreement, and that required client notifications are communicated accurately and on time
  • Ensure quality and compliance requirements are embedded in ECL's single software platform
  • Run Quality Management Reviews and report quality performance, risks, and resource needs to the executive team

Regulatory Intelligence and Readiness:

  • Track changes in applicable regulations, guidance and standards and assess their impact on ECL operations and client work
  • Monitor inspection trends, warning letters and enforcement themes, & translate them into concrete readiness actions
  • Represent ECL's quality and compliance position with external stakeholders

Audits and Inspections

  • Own the internal audit program, extending it to each new site as it opens
  • Coordinate responses to observations and findings and track them to on-time closure
  • Maintain continuous inspection readiness
  • Manage client quality agreements and support client qualification questionnaires and due diligence

Supplier Quality

  • Own supplier quality program: risk-based supplier selection, qualification, approved supplier list and ongoing performance monitoring
  • Plan and conduct supplier audits; manage supplier corrective actions and change notifications
  • Establish and maintain quality agreements with critical suppliers of instruments, reagents, consumables and services

Training

  • Own the GMP training program at current and future sites
  • Deliver quality, data integrity, and inspection-readiness training, updating content as regulations and procedures change

Leadership

  • Build and lead a focused team supporting QMS and related activities
  • Partner closely with the Quality leadership on strategy, priorities, and escalations

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in life sciences, chemistry, engineering, or related field
  • 10+ years in quality assurance or compliance in a regulated laboratory, CDMO or biopharma environment
  • 3+ years leading QA or QC teams
  • Deep working knowledge of GMP requirements, including 21 CFR Parts 210/211 and data integrity expectations (21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ALCOA+)
  • Direct experience in regulatory inspections and client audits, and writing responses that closed findings
  • Experience with an internal audit program, supplier quality program and/or a GMP training program

Preferred

  • Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in a scientific discipline
  • Experience with ISO 9001 and/or ISO/IEC 17025
  • Experience with computerized system validation (GAMP 5) and highly automated or software-driven lab operations
  • Working knowledge of software development, such as coding, the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and version control
  • Quality certification such as ASQ CQA, CQE or CMQ/OE
  • Experience in a contract service organization supporting clients with differing quality requirements

    • Cultivate strong relationships with product and engineering leadership and act as a pragmatic, solutions-oriented legal advisor.

Own the product terms, disclosures, and compliance requirements for various deployment models, billing and pricing changes, and offerings for government/regulated customers (e.g., FedRAMP-authorized offering).

    • Draft, review, and maintain product-specific legal terms, policies, and documentation.

    • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a high-growth environment.
    • Experience at a SaaS company, particularly in databases, data infrastructure, or data platforms.
    • Hands-on experience advising on product-related AI regulatory compliance (EU AI Act, state AI legislation) or training data governance.

This is an incredible opportunity to join a fast growing and highly valued emerging company supporting the development of core technology in a transformational era.

Compensation is targeted at an annual base salary of $250,000 to $275,000, plus equity, and generous benefits. The total compensation package will vary and depend on the candidate’s level of seniority, number of years of directly relevant experience, and geographic location.

raw.description:
Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

Make Every Experience Matter

Viseven is an AI-native Intelligent Experiences Enabler for life sciences, helping pharma and biotech organizations move from fragmented content operations to connected, compliant, and measurable omnichannel engagement with HCPs and patients. By combining proprietary technology — eWizard, eVa, Kheiron, and Lexi — with agentic AI and strategic consulting, we support the full content lifecycle: from creation and MLR validation to localization and omnichannel publishing. Our clients include Top 50 life sciences, pharma, biotech, and medtech companies around the globe. 

Role Description:

We are seeking a highly skilled and dynamic Transformation Program Manager to lead and drive the successful implementation of large-scale programmes within our Strategic Clients. This is an exciting, fast-paced, and high-visibility role, working closely with the Sales (Account Directors), Delivery (Delivery Directors), Products and Solution Teams, and the wider Senior Leadership Team to ensure ultimate success, adoption, and Client Satisfaction.
As we evolve and adapt to be a leader in Digital Transformation at scale, this role will be instrumental in guiding and managing transformational projects from initiation to successful implementation.

Responsibilities:

    · Work in collaboration with the Account Director to develop and execute a comprehensive transformation plan, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement and adaptability.
    · Lead external stakeholder engagement strategies that address concerns and ensure ongoing support through established, effective communication channels.
    · Provide leadership for successful programme implementation
    · Create and maintain effective project governance
    · Oversee the delivery of the programme in close collaboration with the Delivery Director, ensuring alignment with broader client’s objectives and expectations.
    · Collaborate closely with stakeholders and the internal Learning Solutions team to guide the development and implementation of onboarding programs, training workshops, and supportive resources designed to empower end-users in adopting new processes and systems.
    · Ensure all delivery streams are working together effectively, outputs are synchronised where necessary and internal and external dependencies are mapped and managed
    · Ensure good project planning, resource allocation, risk management, and status reporting.
    · Escalate issues as necessary within the project organisation structure
    · Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of the programme implementation and adoption.
    · Effectively communicate programme goals, progress, and outcomes to all stakeholders and governance structure
    · Ensure ‘compliance’ with standards, existing framework and governance for the programme.
    · Network with cross-functional teams through the entire project life cycle, ensuring adherence to Transformation programme management best practices
    · Foster successful adoption through key consideration of change management and lead the evaluation of change adoption rates, using data and stakeholder feedback to identify resistance and deploy targeted interventions for improved engagement.
    · Collaborate with senior leadership, V7 workstreams, and key stakeholders to ensure alignment and buy-in for transformation initiatives across the business

Required skills and knowledge:

    · Proven experience in managing large-scale business transformation projects.
    · History of being able to manage multiple projects that may overlap or be interlinked when aligning with business requirements
    · Strong leadership skills and the ability to motivate team members.
    · Commercial acumen and experience highly preferable
    · Capability of working under pressure and to tight deadlines
    · Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to foster strong relationships and engage effectively with stakeholders across the organization, including senior leadership and cross-functional teams
    · Exceptional organisational skills and attention to detail.
    · Self-starter with a bias for action, ability to bring structure to ambiguity and build trust based relationships across the organization
    · Comfortable working within an ever-changing environment in a rapidly growing company
    · Strong change management skills to drive successful outcomes
    · Excellent communication, negotiation and conflict resolution skills.
    · Previous experience working on large digital/omnichannel transformation programme.
    · Experience of at least affinity with enabling technologies for deployment of Campaign and Content at scale including CRM, Marketing Automation, CMS, Content Authoring platforms
    · Experience in Modular approaches to deploying Campaign and Content
    · Able to oversee and lead through Delivery Directors and Managers and ensure adherence to strict timelines on time, budget and expectations/success measures.

Why Viseven?

Purpose in Every Service

Your work will contribute to solutions that help pharmaceutical companies bring innovations to market faster and improve how healthcare information reaches people globally. We build technology with purpose — because better communication can lead to better health outcomes.

Care and Connection

We believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and connected. At Viseven, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and genuine care are part of everyday work — for our teammates, clients, and communities. From charity and sustainability initiatives to an inclusive and supportive environment, we grow stronger together.

Grow and Go Beyond

We encourage bold ideas, ownership, and continuous growth. Whether it’s leading new initiatives, shaping products, or expanding your expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to make a visible impact and evolve alongside a global organization.
