Come join our amazing team !

Perform paralegal duties involving residential loan servicing and default proceedings in compliance with outside counsel guidelines, applicable laws, regulations, and company policies related to litigation and mortgage servicing. Responsible for supporting the Legal Department in managing litigation, contested proceedings, and legal issues related to mortgage servicing and lending. Ensure timely and appropriate actions in compliance with company policies and applicable state and federal laws, including mortgage servicing, lending and consumer protection regulations. Perform all duties in accordance with the Company’s policies and procedures, all US state and federal laws and regulations, wherein the company operates.

As a government contractor this position has specific requirements including prior work experience in the mortgage banking industry as well as education and other experience requirements.

The target pay range for this position is $85,000.00 to $105,000.00

What you’ll do:

  • Assist with resolving cases by gathering and organizing information needed for assessing settlement opportunities and preparing draft requests for settlement approval.

  • Resolve routine legal issues under the guidance of senior legal personnel.

  • Open and maintain matters in case management system, including handling incoming mail and service of process.

  • Assist in reviewing pleadings served by third parties or prepared by outside counsel, including but not limited to summons, complaints, affidavits, answers, motions, orders and judgments.

  • Assist with preparing discovery responses and coordinating with business units.

  • Review various legal documents for accuracy and completeness including gathering information required, making corrections and resolving discrepancies.

  • Manage document subpoenas by collecting responsive records and preparing formal responses.

  • Oversee the full lifecycle of capped fee and non-material matters, including performing initial assessment to select from preferred counsel and ensuring proper opening, referring to counsel, monitoring progress, ensuring timely advancement and closing.

  • Secure key personnel for mediations, depositions, and other events that require in person, telephonic or virtual appearances.

  • Coordinate and manage correspondence with outside counsel, third-party entities, and business units in a timely and appropriate manner.

  • Oversee adherence to loan servicing agreements and delegated authority matrixes.

  • Conduct factual research including gathering relevant information from a variety of resources.

  • Prepare check requests, vendor payee forms, IT access and change forms, and FedEx labels.

  • Conduct pre-claim title review including reviewing title records, organizing documents, creating chronologies, preparing and submitting title claims, monitoring for response from insurers and working with carrier retained counsel.

  • Serve as liaison between outside counsel, internal departments, in-house attorneys, and other stakeholders.

  • Provide legal and administrative support to departmental staff, including scheduling meetings, managing phone communications and assisting with projects.

  • Maintain calendar of events and key deadlines.

  • Maintain matter-related reports (quarterly, monthly, and ad hoc) and assist with ensuring their accuracy.

    What you’ll need:

  • Knowledge of mortgage servicing and lending operations, as well as litigation relating to these business practices.

  • Ability to work well in a collaborative environment and to operate independently.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Proficient with Excel, Microsoft Word, Outlook, and Microsoft Teams.

  • Strong analytical and organizational skills.

  • Ability to work with outside counsel, investors, vendors, business units and legal department personnel.

  • Ability to understand complex problems, pay close attention to details, take notes, and to collaborate and explore alternative solutions.

  • Skilled in assessing decisions with potential impact on the immediate team, while proactively monitoring broader organizational effects.

  • Ability to accurately track and record time.

  • Associate’s degree from accredited college and paralegal certification or a bachelor’s degree from accredited college required.
  • Two (2) or more years’ experience working as a paralegal.
  • Two (2) or more years’ experience working in the mortgage banking and servicing industry.

Two (2) or more years’ experience working within litigation case management system, preferably Legal Tracker.

Our Company:

Carrington Mortgage Holdings is a holding company whose primary businesses include asset management, mortgages, real estate transactions and real estate logistics. Collectively, the businesses are vertically and horizontally integrated, and provide a broad range of real estate services encompassing nearly all aspects of single-family residential real estate transactions in the United States. Guided by a leadership team with a wealth of industry experience and guided by a consistent philosophy, Carrington maintains the necessary infrastructure to ensure stability and maximize value during any market cycle. We hope you’ll consider joining our growing team of uniquely talented professionals as we transform residential real estate. To read more visit: .

What We Offer:

  • Comprehensive healthcare plans for you and your family. Plus, a discretionary 401(k) match of 50% of the first 4% of pay contributed.
  • Access to several fitness, restaurant, retail (and more!) discounts through our employee portal.
  • Customized training programs to help you advance your career.
  • Employee referral bonuses so you’ll get paid to help Carrington and Vylla grow.
  • Educational Reimbursement.

raw.description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

About JLL-

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We shape the future of real estate for a better world by using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people and our communities. As a Fortune 500 company, we help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. We have operations in over 80 countries and a global workforce of over 92,000 individuals.

We believe a diverse and inclusive culture is one where everyone succeeds. That’s why we’re committed to creating an environment where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential.

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we’ll let you in on a secret: there’s no such thing as a “perfect” candidate. JLL is a place where everyone can grow no matter how they identify or what background they bring with them. If you’re a leader of any level or experience and this job description resonates with you, let’s talk.

What this job involves -

The Facilities Manager will be the single point of contact responsible for facilities management, assisting the Sr. Facilities Manager and/or the Account Leader with the delivery of quality facility management services. This role will coordinate and manage tenant requirements and service delivery to ensure satisfaction.

Summary of Duties/Essential Functions:

  • Supports the Sr. Facilities Manager and/or Account Lead in the implementation of short and long-term goals & projects for the client
  • Develops and implements innovative programs, processes and procedures that reduce short- and long-term operating costs and increases productivity by working closely with the Sr. Facility Management Lead, Account Leader, and the client.
  • Oversees the monthly/quarterly/annual reporting requirements appropriately based on client needs
  • Completes all facilities related reports accurately and on time following the client’s policies for record keeping.
  • Manages the work assignments for building technicians, vendors, and contractors.
  • Leads facilities staff to deliver expected service levels to the client within the prescribed budget.
  • Assists with the development and implementation of the annual management plan for the buildings within the area.
  • Oversees the development and management of the capital and expense budgets by interfacing closely with the client representative
  • Ensure client satisfaction with site leadership team by providing a seamless interface of the client real estate organization and facilities through leadership, responsiveness and creativity that develops and maintains a positive relationship.
  • Recommends capital improvements and prepares operating budget reports. Prepares monthly operating budget & forecasts and completes monthly variance report.
  • Follows the annual performance plan; accomplish Key Performance Indicators as agreed with client in the Objectives of the Performance Agreement for the position.
  • Share innovations and best practices with the assigned owner of best practices for JLL Facilities Management.
  • Manage contractors when on site ensuring each contractor is following all client and JLL policies and ensuring the delivery of the service is completed correctly.
  • Oversee the overall service delivery of the contracted services. Ensure all Client and JLL polices in regards to delivery of service, safety and compliance are followed.
  • Any/other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in Facilities Management with management/technical emphasis. MBA is a plus
  • 6+ years industry experience required either in the corporate environment, third party service provider, or as consultant
  • Strong leadership & management skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Matrix manage both technical and administrative staff
  • Proficient in MS programs such as Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, etc.
  • Computer proficiency in CMMS systems

What you can expect from us:

You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture. One where we succeed together – across the desk and around the globe. Where like-minded people work naturally together to achieve great things.

Our Total Rewards program reflects our commitment to helping you achieve your ambitions in career, recognition, wellbeing, benefits and pay. We’ll offer you a competitive salary and benefits package.

Join us to develop your strengths and enjoy a fulfilling career full of varied experiences. Keep those ambitions in sights and imagine where JLL can take you...

Apply today!

This position does not provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.


Expected compensation for this position:

85,000.00 – 93,500.00 USD per year

Final compensation packages are determined by various considerations including but not limited to candidate qualifications, location, market conditions, and internal considerations.


Location:

Remote –Atlanta, GA

Job Tags:

Legal Compliance

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:


JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health. Some of these benefits include:

  • 401(k) plan with matching company contributions
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental & Vision Care
  • Paid parental leave at 100% of salary
  • Paid Time Off and Company Holidays
  • Early access to earned wages through Daily Pay

Using AI capabilities, we analyze your application for relevant skills, experiences, and qualifications to generate valuable insights about how your unique profile aligns with the specific requirements of the role you're pursuing.

raw.description:
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end-to-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:

EverPro, a business within EverCommerce, provides software and solutions designed to help home and field service businesses run and grow their companies with greater efficiency and confidence. EverPro brings together purpose-built tools across key trades—including field service, remodeling and roofing, landscaping, and pest and lawn—so service professionals can manage operations, engage customers, and drive long-term growth.

Our solutions support the full lifecycle of running a service business, from scheduling and dispatching work, to estimating, invoicing, and payments, to customer communication, reputation management, and business insights. Together, these connected solutions help service pros win more jobs, save time, and build stronger, more resilient businesses.

We’re looking for a Marketing Manager, Lifecycle & Growth to join the EverPro Marketing team, supporting Invoice Simple.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for driving lifecycle-led business impact by designing, executing, and optimizing customer engagement initiatives that support activation, retention, feature adoption, and revenue growth. You’ll operate at the intersection of Lifecycle Marketing, Product, Product Marketing, Growth, and Data—translating business priorities and customer insights into experiences that meaningfully influence customer behavior.

This role is ideal for a marketer who thinks in customer journeys, applies data to decision-making, and wants ownership over initiatives that directly impact business outcomes in a Product-Led Growth (PLG) environment.


Responsibilities

Customer Lifecycle Strategy & Experience Direction

  • Own lifecycle experience direction for assigned journeys, segments, or initiatives
  • Define which customers experiences are for, what customer need or opportunity they address, and what behavior or outcome they are intended to influence
  • Design end-to-end lifecycle experiences across email, push notifications, and in-app messaging
  • Ensure lifecycle touchpoints work in concert with product experiences to support customer success and growth

Business Impact & Growth Contribution

  • Translate business priorities into lifecycle initiatives that drive activation, retention, adoption, and monetization
  • Develop clear hypotheses for how lifecycle initiatives will contribute to business goals
  • Size expected impact directionally using assumptions, ranges, and customer economics
  • Prioritize initiatives based on potential impact, customer value, and feasibility

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, Growth, Payments, and Data teams
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing Managers to ensure lifecycle messaging reflects approved positioning and customer readiness
  • Use customer insights and performance data to influence decisions and align stakeholders
  • Escalate tradeoffs or conflicts when lifecycle initiatives have broader portfolio impact

Initiative Management & Execution

  • Own execution of complex lifecycle and growth-related initiatives within assigned scope
  • Coordinate timelines, dependencies, and handoffs across Marketing and partner teams
  • Balance multiple initiatives while adapting to shifting business priorities
  • Partner with marketing automation, creative, and analytics teams to bring experiences to life

Performance Analysis, Experimentation & Optimization

  • Monitor lifecycle performance using shared measurement frameworks
  • Design and run experiments to test new approaches and optimize outcomes
  • Analyze results to identify drivers of success or underperformance
  • Translate learnings into clear recommendations for iteration and scale

Collaboration & Thought Leadership

  • Act as an informal advisor to peers on lifecycle best practices and customer engagement
  • Share insights and learnings that improve cross-team effectiveness
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of lifecycle and growth practices across Marketing

Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:

  • 5–7+ years of experience in lifecycle marketing, growth marketing, or customer marketing roles
  • Experience owning customer journeys tied to business outcomes, not just channel execution
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with experience using data to inform decisions
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and influence without direct authority
  • Experience working in B2B or B2C SaaS or Product-Led Growth (PLG) environments

Nice to Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field
  • Experience working with marketing automation platforms such as Braze, Iterable, HubSpot, or similar
  • Exposure to feature adoption, monetization, or payments-related initiatives
  • Experience partnering closely with Product and Product Marketing teams
  • Comfort with directional impact modeling or customer economics

Where: Remote, US

The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States - if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.


Benefits and Perks

  • Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid
  • Day 1 access to a robust health and wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend
  • 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting
  • Flexible and generous (FTO) time-off
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program

Compensation: The target compensation range for this position is $65,000 – $80,000 USD per year in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.



EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!


EverCommerce uses approved artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools to support its business operations. Employees are encouraged to use authorized AI tools, when appropriate for their roles, to improve efficiency, quality, and innovation. All AI use must comply with company policies, including requirements concerning confidentiality, data security, intellectual property, accuracy, and human review. Employees remain responsible for reviewing and validating AI-assisted work.

raw.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Sweden.

About Product Management:

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The opportunity:

As the Product Manager for Application Observability (App O11y), you’ll be responsible for helping application developers and SREs understand how their applications are performing, what’s affecting their users, and where to focus when something goes wrong. You’ll continue to build App O11y on top of the Knowledge Graph and fully integrate high-fidelity signals like traces and profiles, making all three first-class parts of the product experience. You’ll bring these capabilities together into our full-stack observability experience, alongside our Drilldown products, while building AI-first workflows that help customers investigate issues, understand root cause, and take action beyond static experiences.

Your primary responsibility will be to define the vision and roadmap that takes App O11y into its next wave of adoption and revenue growth. This will require heavy customer discovery, using product data to understand where users get stuck, and working with your engineering and design partners to turn those needs into clear priorities. You’ll balance new product opportunities with the depth, performance, and reliability customers need from tracing and profiling, while working across R&D to ensure App O11y is tightly woven into our broader Grafana Cloud suite.

You’ll also work closely with PMM and GTM to help customers understand the value of App O11y. This includes shaping pricing and packaging that make it easy to get started and grow with the product. You’ll regularly review customer feedback and usage data to understand what’s working and where people get stuck, and then be accountable for turning what you learn into stronger adoption and revenue growth.

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you will:

  • Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
  • Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
  • Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities
  • Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.
  • Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
  • Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
  • Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities
  • Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.
  • Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering

What makes you a great fit:

  • A BS/BA in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management
  • 5+ years of experience in a B2B SaaS product
  • Experience using or building observability products, telemetry databases, and/or developer tools, either as a practitioner or for external customers
  • A strong understanding of application architectures and distributed systems, with the ability to discuss tradeoffs in telemetry ingestion, storage, querying, and the workflows built on top
  • Experience working with Engineering and Design teams to build delightful products and features with sound UX in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with OpenTelemetry, application instrumentation, SDKs, and telemetry collectors
  • Experience with distributed tracing or continuous profiling systems, such as Grafana Tempo or Grafana Pyroscope
  • Experience with eBPF and/or automatic instrumentation
  • Experience with open source software and/or commercial open source companies
  • Experience defining or evolving pricing and packaging for consumption-based or product-led SaaS offerings
  • Experience operating applications in production, being on call, or troubleshooting performance and reliability issues

In Sweden, the base compensation range for this role is SEK 814,216 - SEK 977,059. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

raw.description:
Description

Exodigo is the leading underground mapping solution for non-intrusive discovery. Our platforms combine multi-sensor fusion, 3D imaging, and AI technologies to create complete, accurate underground maps that enable confident decision-making for customers across the built world. We transform the project lifecycle for our customers, who include key community stakeholders in the utilities, transportation and government sectors.

We are experiencing sky-rocketing growth and closed a historically large $96M Series B round in July of 2025.

Job description

This is a senior, hands-on production role for a Bentley Systems specialist with proven expertise in creating CAD models and asset data, together with strong Autodesk Civil 3D and BIM workflow experience. The successful candidate will work with engineers, surveyors, and project teams to transform design information, survey data, and existing-condition data into reliable, client-ready deliverables.

What You Will Do:

  • Create and maintain detailed civil engineering drawings (CAD) and 3D models using Bentley Systems base open roads and Open budlings , strong fumiler with Civil 3d and AutoCAD.
  • Develop coordinated BIM deliverables from design drawings, survey data, as-built documentation, and other project inputs.
  • Produce surfaces, alignments, profiles, corridors, grading models, pipe networks, sections, and construction documentation.
  • Create existing-condition models from LiDAR scans and registered point clouds, where applicable.
  • Translate 2D engineering drawings into coordinated 3D models, working directly with designers to capture design intent.
  • Utilities & Existing Conditions: Incorporate survey data, point clouds, and subsurface utility information into models, with an understanding of Subsurface Utility Engineering (SUE) practices and exposure to standards such as PAS128 (UK) or ASCE 38-22 (US).
  • Update models and drawings throughout the project lifecycle and maintain clear version control.
  • Develop and improve templates, standards, object libraries, and repeatable modeling workflows.
  • Coordinate model exchanges and resolve data-quality issues with multidisciplinary contributors.
  • Manage assigned tasks independently and deliver high-quality work within project schedules.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in Bentley OpenRoads, MicroStation, and BIM modeling, preferably on infrastructure projects.
  • Strong experience with Civil 3D and AutoCAD, with knowledge of OpenBuildings Designer (OBD) or Revit considered an advantage.
  • Proven ability to develop accurate 2D drawings and coordinated 3D BIM modelsfrom engineering, survey, and existing-condition data.
  • Strong understanding of civil engineering drawings, survey information, coordinate systems, spatial data, and model setup.
  • Experience delivering BIM/CAD work within ProjectWise environments, including structured workflows and client standards.
  • Understanding of BIM standards and delivery requirements, including ISO 19650, BEPs, and client specifications.
  • Experience with infrastructure projects such as roads, railways, drainage, utilities, land development, or major structures.
  • Strong QA/QC, attention to detail, problem-solving, and ability to work independently while managing multiple assignments and deadlines.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, multidisciplinary project teams, and clients, with good technical English.
  • Experience incorporating survey data, point clouds, LiDAR, laser scans, or GISdata into CAD/BIM models is an advantage.

﻿Significant Advantages

  • Experience with scan-to-BIM / point-cloud-to-CAD workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with OpenBuildings Designer (OBD) and 3D MEP modeling.
  • Proficiency in ReCap, Revit, InfraWorks, Navisworks, or similar tools.
  • Experience developing CAD/BIM standards, templates, automation, or production workflows.

raw.title: Executive Director,  Enterprise Change Management & Adoption
raw.excerpt: Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes.
raw.description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is seeking an Executive Director, Enterprise Change Management & Adoption to join our team!


Primary Responsibilities


1. Enterprise Change Management Strategy & Methodology

  • Define and lead Labcorp’s enterprise change management and adoption strategy aligned to corporate AI, automation, and digital transformation priorities
  • Establish a repeatable, standardized change management methodology and framework (e.g., structured, research-based approaches such as ADKAR / Prosci or equivalent) scaled for enterprise use
  • Ensure change management is embedded at the beginning of major transformation initiatives rather than treated as a downstream communications activity
  • Create scalable approaches that can be deployed consistently across multiple business units and transformation programs

2. Partnership with Workforce Readiness & Transformation

  • Serve as the change and adoption partner to the Executive Director, Workforce Readiness & Transformation, on the AI and Tech-enabled transformation major initiatives
  • Translate workforce impact assessments, future-state role designs, and workforce transition plans into change strategies, stakeholder plans, and adoption approaches
  • Jointly define the division of labor on each initiative so workforce design and change execution are complementary and non-duplicative
  • Co-develop integrated readiness measures that connect workforce readiness with change readiness and adoption
  • Align reskilling and capability-building milestones with adoption and reinforcement timelines

3. Strategic Partnership with IT & AI Transformation

  • Partner closely with Information Technology, Digital Transformation leaders, and the Office of the Chief AI Officer (CAIO) to align change and adoption activities to Labcorp’s AI and digital roadmap
  • Participate in planning and prioritization for major AI, automation, and technology initiatives to proactively identify change impacts and adoption requirements
  • Ensure change management, communications, and adoption activities are incorporated into solution deployment plans and release schedules
  • Drive adoption of enterprise AI tooling, agentic platforms, automation solutions, and emerging technologies
  • Translate technology roadmaps into change impacts, stakeholder actions, and adoption plans

4. Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership Alignment

  • Identify, map, and segment stakeholders across impacted business units, functions, and employee populations
  • Activate and enable executive sponsors, building visible, active, and sustained sponsorship for change
  • Develop and equip a network of change agents, champions, and people leaders to drive adoption at the front line
  • Build leadership alignment and coalition across senior stakeholders on the case for change and the path to adoption
  • Partner with HR Business Partners and business leaders to lead change within their organizations

5. Change Impact & Adoption Assessment

  • Assess the change impacts of AI, automation, and digital transformation initiatives on people, processes, and ways of working
  • Conduct change readiness assessments and identify adoption risks across impacted populations
  • Define adoption requirements and target behaviors for each impacted stakeholder segment
  • Identify sources of resistance early and develop targeted mitigation strategies
  • Partner with Workforce Readiness & Transformation to connect workforce impacts with the change actions required to adopt them

6. Communications & Engagement Enablement

  • Define enterprise change communications strategies that build awareness, understanding, desire, and commitment
  • Partner with Corporate Communications and leadership teams to deliver clear, consistent, audience-specific messaging
  • Develop sponsor, manager, and change-agent communication toolkits and talking points
  • Create engagement approaches that give employees a voice in the change and surface feedback
  • Sequence communications to align with initiative milestones, deployment waves, and adoption moments

7. Change & Adoption Playbook & Operating Model

  • Design, test, and scale a repeatable Change Management & Adoption Playbook
    • Establish enterprise methodologies for:
      • Change impact and readiness assessment
      • Stakeholder analysis and sponsorship activation
      • Communications and engagement planning
      • Resistance management
      • Adoption planning and reinforcement
      • Change measurement and sustainment
      • Continuously refine the playbook based on lessons learned and deployment outcomes
      • Create tools, templates, and frameworks that can be consistently applied across transformation efforts

8. Transformation Execution & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead change and adoption workstreams associated with major AI, automation, and digital transformation initiatives
  • Develop resource model and coordinate change resources across the enterprise to support major transformation initiatives
  • Establish repeatable approaches that can be utilized across multiple transformation initiatives
  • Operate as a player-coach leader who actively participates in solving change and adoption challenges
  • Build Enterprise HR capability in change management

9. Reinforcement, Sustainment & Change Analytics

  • Define adoption, reinforcement, and sustainment approaches that embed new behaviors beyond go-live
  • Develop manager and leadership guidance for leading teams through change and reinforcing adoption

Define and track change and adoption success metrics, including:

  • Change readiness and stakeholder sentiment
  • Adoption and usage rates
  • Proficiency and sustained behavior change
  • Speed of adoption and time-to-value
  • Resistance reduction and issue resolution
  • Partner with Finance, IT, and business leaders to connect adoption to measurable business outcomes
  • Establish data-driven methods for prioritizing change investments and interventions

10. Executive Partnership & Governance

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to the CHRO, CIO, CAIO, and senior business leaders on change and adoption
  • Act as a connector across HR, IT, Talent, Learning, Communications, and business teams
  • Provide visibility into change readiness, adoption progress, risks, and outcomes
  • Support enterprise governance processes related to AI, transformation, and organizational readiness
  • Help shape prioritization of transformation initiatives based on change impact and adoption considerations

Measures of Success

  • Enterprise change management strategy and methodology established and adopted
  • Increased adoption rates and sustained behavior change across priority populations
  • Successful deployment of change and adoption playbooks across multiple initiatives
  • Reduced time-to-adoption for major digital and AI initiatives
  • Active, visible sponsorship and strong leader and employee adoption outcomes
  • Early identification and effective mitigation of resistance
  • Measurable business value realized through adoption of transformation investments
  • Seamless, complementary partnership with Workforce Readiness & Transformation across initiatives

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • 12+ years of experience in organizational change management, transformation, organizational effectiveness, or related fields

Additional Job Standards

  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-scale change management on large, complex transformation initiatives
  • Expertise in:
    • Change management strategy and methodology
    • Stakeholder engagement and sponsorship activation
    • Change and adoption communications
    • Resistance management
    • Adoption planning, reinforcement, and sustainment
    • Change measurement and analytics
    • Transformation program leadership
    • Deep fluency in a structured change management methodology
    • Experience assessing the change and adoption implications of operational, technology, or business transformations
    • Strong analytical and data fluency, with the ability to translate insights into change decisions
    • Demonstrated ability to work across business, HR, and technology functions
    • Experience building enterprise frameworks, methodologies, or operating models
    • Strong executive presence and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience leading change and adoption for AI-enabled, automation-enabled, or digital transformations
  • Experience partnering closely with technology organizations and workforce transformation teams
  • Experience within healthcare, life sciences, diagnostics, logistics, or other operationally complex environments
  • Consulting, transformation, or organizational effectiveness background
  • Familiarity with adoption analytics and digital adoption platforms

Leadership Profile

  • Enterprise-minded: Connects strategy, technology, people, and business outcomes
  • Change strategist: Understands how people and organizations move through and adopt change
  • Collaborative influencer: Leads through influence in highly matrixed environments
  • Systems thinker: Connects technology transformation with the human change required to adopt it
  • Player-coach: Comfortable both developing strategy and driving hands-on execution
  • Adoption leader: Builds sustained behavior change and reinforcement, not just plans and communications

Role Overview

Labcorp is accelerating toward a digitally enabled, AI-powered operating model that is fundamentally reshaping how work gets done, how roles are defined, and how value is created. Technology deployment alone does not deliver that value — value is realized only when leaders and employees actually adopt new tools, new processes, and new ways of working, and sustain those behaviors over time.

The Executive Director, Enterprise Change Management & Adoption leads Labcorp’s enterprise strategy and execution for organizational change management and adoption across AI, automation, and digital transformation initiatives. This leader ensures that the people side of change — awareness, desire, stakeholder alignment, communications, resistance management, and reinforcement — is planned and executed with the same rigor as the technology itself.


This role partners with the Executive Director, Workforce Readiness & Transformation across every major transformation initiative:

  • Workforce Readiness & Transformation serves as the bridge between business operations, Information Technology, Talent & Learning, HR Business Partners, and enterprise leaders to ensure employees, leaders, skills, roles, and workforce structures evolve alongside technology-enabled change.
  • Enterprise Change Management & Adoption owns the change response, including the change strategy, stakeholder engagement, communications, adoption planning, resistance management, and reinforcement that convert workforce strategies into sustained behavior change and realized value.

Together they ensure that transformation initiatives produce both the right future-state workforce and the adoption required to make it stick. This is a highly collaborative, execution-focused role responsible for establishing a repeatable Change Management & Adoption Playbook and applying it across Labcorp’s most strategic transformation initiatives.


Purpose of the Role

The Executive Director will ensure that enterprise transformation investments translate into adopted, sustained new ways of working through:

  • Enterprise change management strategies that move leaders and employees from awareness to adoption
  • Change impact and adoption assessments tied to digital transformation initiatives
  • Stakeholder engagement, sponsorship activation, and leadership alignment
  • Communications and engagement strategies that build understanding and commitment
  • Resistance identification and mitigation approaches
  • Adoption planning, reinforcement, and sustainment mechanisms
  • Change readiness, adoption, and behavior-change measurement
  • Measurable business value realization through adoption

This role focuses on how people move through change and adopt new ways of working. and ensures the change required to adopt them succeeds.


Why This Role Matters

Technology does not create value on its own. Value is realized when organizations successfully change how people work, lead, communicate, and sustain new behaviors.


Where Workforce Readiness & Transformation prepares the workforce — the roles, skills, and structures of the future — this role ensures the organization actually adopts those changes. It is the execution complement that turns readiness into results.

raw.description:
Що у нас є: — реалізований робочий продукт — новий продукт, який ми вже розробили й тепер хочемо активно просувати — команда класних спеців (програмісти, сейли, дизайнер, копірайтер і т.д.) — ресурси та купа ідей для наступних запусків.

І зараз нам потрібен маркетолог, який допоможе перетворювати ці ідеї на реальні результати.

Ми не шукаємо маркетингового гуру з досвідом запуску двадцяти стартапів. Нам цікава людина з хорошою маркетинговою базою, кількома роками досвіду в IT та бажанням пробувати нове.

Така, якій цікаво розібратися, чому один канал працює, а інший ні, яка готова тестувати нестандартні гіпотези, не боїться експериментувати й любить, коли результат роботи можна побачити в цифрах.

Що потрібно буде робити:

  • Підтримувати маркетинг KeyApp: процеси налаштовані й працюють, тож винаходити велосипед не доведеться. Але якщо бачиш, як зробити краще, ми тільки за.
  • Брати участь у запуску нових продуктів: досліджувати ринок, конкурентів та аудиторію, визначати позиціонування, формувати й реалізовувати Go-to-Market стратегії.
  • Генерувати й тестувати маркетингові гіпотези. Шукати нові канали залучення: SEO, PPC, контент, LinkedIn, email, спільноти, партнерства та будь-які інші інструменти, які можуть дати результат.
  • Працювати з воронкою залучення: від першого знайомства з продуктом до реєстрації, покупки та повернення клієнта. Шукати точки втрати конверсії та можливості її покращення.
  • Аналізувати маркетингові та продуктові метрики, оцінювати ефективність каналів, експериментів і вкладених ресурсів. Не просто збирати цифри, а розуміти, що з ними робити далі.
  • Використовувати AI-інструменти для досліджень, генерації ідей, аналізу даних, автоматизації та прискорення маркетингових процесів.
  • Співпрацювати з розробниками, дизайнерами, PPC-спеціалістом та Sales. У нас є кому реалізовувати ідеї, головне розуміти, що і навіщо ми робимо.
  • Долучатися до пошуку нових продуктових можливостей: досліджувати перспективні ніші, вивчати потреби аудиторії та пропонувати ідеї для майбутніх продуктів.

Що пропонуємо:

  • Можливість реально впливати на продукт. Твої ідеї не мають проходити сім кіл погоджень. Якщо бачимо потенціал, обговорюємо, тестуємо й дивимося на результат.
  • Готову команду для реалізації. Не потрібно самому одночасно бути маркетологом, програмістом і дизайнером.
  • Різноманітні завдання. Тут буде і робота зі зрілим міжнародним продуктом, і запуск нових сервісів, і можливість долучатися до створення наступних.
  • Стабільну зарплату у твердій валюті. Скільки домовились, стільки й отримуєш. Завжди вчасно, без неприємних сюрпризів.
  • Фінансовий бонус. За результатами роботи, адже круті результати мають винагороджуватися.
  • Час на відпочинок і турботу про себе. 24 календарні дні оплачуваної відпустки та лікарняні.
  • Work-life balance. 8-годинний робочий день, субота й неділя — вихідні. Без культури овертаймів, бо ми впевнені: хто добре відпочиває, той добре працює.
  • Повний remote. Працюй звідти, де тобі комфортно. Головне для нас — результат, а не присутність в офісі.
  • Простір для розвитку та експериментів. Оплачуємо професійне навчання й конференції, підтримуємо нові ідеї та даємо можливість реалізовувати їх на практиці.
  • Здорову корпоративну культуру. У нас прийнято говорити прямо, бути чесними, відкритими й поважати одне одного. Любимо жарти.

Що для нас важливо:

  • Профільна освіта в маркетингу та 1−3 роки практичного досвіду маркетологом в IT, бажано в продуктовій компанії.
  • Розуміння принципів digital-маркетингу, побудови маркетингових воронок та основних метрик: CAC, LTV, CPA/CPI, конверсій.
  • Практичний досвід роботи хоча б із 2−3 каналами залучення клієнтів: PPC, SEO, email, LinkedIn, SMM або іншими.
  • Досвід роботи з маркетинговою аналітикою (GA4 або аналогами), UTM-мітками та оцінкою ефективності кампаній.
  • Впевнене використання AI-інструментів у щоденній роботі.
  • Англійська від B1—B2 для роботи з міжнародними ринками, дослідженнями та англомовними матеріалами.
  • Уміння самостійно організовувати роботу, ставити зрозумілі завдання іншим спеціалістам і доводити свої ідеї до реалізації.

Але найголовніше для нас — твій підхід до роботи.

Ми шукаємо людину, яка:

  • Ініціативна. Не чекає, поки їй принесуть готовий план, а сама пропонує, що ще можна спробувати.
  • Допитлива. Любить розбиратися в нових продуктах, технологіях, ринках та інструментах.
  • Самостійна. Уміє перетворити ідею на конкретні дії, організувати процес і довести його до результату.
  • Не боїться експериментів. Розуміє, що не кожна гіпотеза спрацює з першого разу, але з кожної можна зробити висновки.
  • Дружить із цифрами. Уміє аргументувати рішення даними, а не лише відчуттям, що «це має зайти».
  • Хоче розвиватися. Не обмежує себе одним маркетинговим каналом і готова освоювати нові напрямки.

Буде плюсом:

  • Досвід у B2B, SaaS, mobile marketing або ASO.
  • Участь у запуску нового продукту чи виході на новий ринок.
  • Базові навички роботи з Canva, Figma, CapCut.
  • Власні проєкти, блог, канал чи будь-які інші маркетингові експерименти, які ти запускав/запускала самостійно.

Keyapp — українська продуктова IT-компанія, яка створила платформу для просування мобільних застосунків і допомагає збільшувати органічний трафік для iOS та Android по всьому світу.

Ми працюємо з логікою продукту, даними, API та інженерними рішеннями, які допомагають краще розуміти ринки мобільних застосунків.

Description

Are you someone who enjoys solving complex data problems, connecting the dots, and finding better ways to get things done?

We're looking for a curious, detail-oriented, and resourceful Data Analyst to help solve some of our organization's most challenging data questions. In this role, you'll respond to regulatory data requests that require navigating complex business questions, analyzing multiple data sources, and collaborating across teams to deliver accurate, reliable information. You'll become a trusted expert in insurance data while developing a broad understanding of our business and solving meaningful problems. Beyond answering today's questions, you'll help us work smarter by identifying opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and improved data practices to make future requests faster and easier to fulfill. If you enjoy tackling difficult data challenges — and finding ways to make them easier to solve the next time — we'd love to hear from you.

Candidates who live within 50 miles of Boston, MA; Portsmouth, NH; Seattle, WA; Columbus, OH; or Plano, TX will follow a hybrid schedule, coming into the office two days per week. Otherwise, this role is remote with occasional travel.

What You'll Do:

  • Solve challenging data problems: Investigate complex regulatory data requests, identify relevant data sources, and perform the analysis needed to deliver accurate, complete, and defensible responses.
  • Become a trusted data expert: Develop a deep understanding of our insurance products, underwriting data, and business processes, helping partners navigate complex data questions.
  • Collaborate to deliver results: Work closely with regulatory, compliance, product, underwriting, and technology teams to understand requirements, resolve data challenges, and ensure responses meet business needs.
  • Improve how we work: Identify recurring challenges and opportunities to simplify, standardize, and expedite the process of responding to regulatory requests.
  • Build reusable knowledge: Document data sources, business logic, and prior analyses to make future requests easier to understand and fulfill.
  • Drive visibility and accountability: Develop and maintain reporting that provides senior leadership with visibility into regulatory request status, progress, and emerging challenges, highlighting risks and issues that may require escalation or leadership support.

What We're Looking For:

  • Experience: 5+ years in data analytics or a related data solutions role, including coding for data management, data warehousing, or other data environments.
  • Tooling: Comfortable across the broader data and analytics toolset used for the role (e.g., Snowflake, SAS Viya, SQL, GitHub), with the ability to use AI-assisted tools (e.g., GPT/Copilot/Claude) to improve productivity.
  • Project management: Demonstrated experience leading projects from scoping through delivery and reporting on progress and challenges.
  • Analytical mind: Candidate must be analytical and curious, with the ability to read ambiguous regulatory guidance, ask the right questions, and translate vague instructions into precise data requirements and testable rules. Strong written and oral communication skills required.
  • Leadership & autonomy: Proven ability to lead work cross-functionally and influence with limited guidance.
  • AI: experience applying generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to data analysis, documentation, or workflow automation.

Qualifications

  • Strong written and oral communication skills required.
  • Bachelor`s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related discipline preferred.
  • Master`s in same or related disciplines strongly preferred.
  • 5-7 years’ experience using SQL and/or Python for data analysis and reporting in data warehouse or similar data environments; experience with Snowflake and SAS is a plus.
  • 5-7 years of experience in data research and process automation, with strong documentation skills.

Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve. We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. raw.description:
About Alchemy Analytical Group
AAG is a leading manufacturer of consumables for life science analytical instruments, helping scientific and industrial customers by providing the key products they need to run their labs. Headquartered in Southwest Michigan, we operate 13 business units across the U.S., Canada, UK, and Ireland., with revenues exceeding $100 million.

Backed by Kanbrick, a long-term investment partner, we’re building the systems, processes, and technology needed to support our next stage of growth. That creates an opportunity for people who enjoy solving complex problems, building scalable solutions, and helping transform how data is used across the business.

The Role
AAG runs on data spread across companies, sites, and systems that operate largely independently. We are building a consolidated data warehouse: the one place where the group’s data is reliable, current, and usable for those running the business. This infrastructure will be the foundation by which we operate and scale the business, from the CEO to the shop floor, and is intended to support every function including Commercial, Manufacturing, Finance, Marketing, etc.

Reporting to the AAG Global Director of Strategy & Corporate Development the Data Engineer will:

  • Lead the creation of production-grade infrastructure. Develop reliable, documented, and stable technology to run reporting and decisions against.
  • Build and maintain data pipelines. Get data flowing into the warehouse cleanly and consistently from across AAG’s companies and systems (e.g., ERP, CRM, shop floor data tracking, etc.) and keep it flowing as sources change.
  • Own the reporting layer. Shape raw data into models that people can use, so the business gets answers. Build and maintain reporting that ties the numbers to how the companies operate.
  • Take ownership of the system. Working alongside current technical leadership, take over its development and day-to-day maintenance.
  • Technical foundations. You are comfortable with SQL and a modern data stack, building ELT pipelines, modeling data in a cloud warehouse, and working in code rather than only in BI tools.

Requirements

Who We’re Looking For
This is a build role with real ownership from day one and a clear path to broader responsibility:

  • A data or analytics engineer who has built or substantially contributed to data pipelines or a warehouse and wants to own one end to end.
  • A software engineer who has gravitated toward data infrastructure and wants a system to call their own.
  • A technically strong analyst who has outgrown spreadsheets and BI tools and has started building the pipelines behind them.
  • A quick learner who can work with the Strategy & Corporate Development team to translate user requirements from the CEO and AAG Leadership Team into code.

What will make someone thrive here is less about background than disposition:

  • An ownership instinct. You treat the system as yours, including the highlights of new module releases and the unglamorous maintenance that keeps it trustworthy.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. You make progress before every requirement is defined, and you ask the right questions as you go.
  • A bias toward solutions that work. You take an 80/20 approach to get to solutions efficiently, then refine and harden where needed.

Skills, software and tools
Nexus runs on Azure. Fivetran lands data from the group’s ERP systems into Databricks, where a medallion model (bronze, silver, gold) governed by Unity Catalog is built in SQL and Python and deployed from GitHub. The gold layer is mirrored nightly into Azure PostgreSQL and served through an Entra gated web portal.

The essentials below are the foundations. Everything under nice to have is something you can pick up here. If you meet most of the essentials, apply: we are hiring for trajectory, not for a checklist.

Essential: SQL · Python · Azure · Databricks · Dimensional modeling · ELT Pipelines · CI/CD and Github / branching · AI-native development and experience with Codex or Claude Code

Nice to have: Finance and accounting literacy · ERP systems · Manufacturing data / process experience

This role can be remote in the U.S., UK, or Ireland or in person at one of our locations (Stevensville, Michigan (US), Devon (UK), or Strathaven (Scotland)). The role will also require periodic (<10%) domestic and international travel.

raw.excerpt: SummaryCreates complex design of VIP aircraft interiors and/or structures to meet customer criteria, quality standards, FAA requirements, budget and project schedules using Computer Aided Drafting/Design tools.
raw.description:
Summary

Creates complex design of VIP aircraft interiors and/or structures to meet customer criteria, quality standards, FAA requirements, budget and project schedules using Computer Aided Drafting/Design tools. This is a temporary role, employed through an agency. We have multiple openings for this position.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Designs complex mechanical aircraft interior furnishing and/or structures such as ceilings, sidewalls, OEM mods, flooring, floor structure, ceiling grids,
  • Analyzes and interprets subsystem and project specifications.
  • Selects materials for mechanical designs based on structural needs and materials specifications. Evaluates trade-offs in materials, hardness, composites, treatments, coatings, and other selections to best meet design objectives. Works with materials suppliers and material testing when needed.
  • Applies experience and knowledge, and works with Manufacturing Engineers to optimize designs for reduced parts counts, reduced manufacturing costs, reduced assembly error, and other factors affecting production cost and quality
  • Understands Bills of Materials, assembly concepts, fabrication specifications.
  • Ensures designs meet customer criteria, quality standards and FAA requirements.
  • Adheres to budget and project schedules.
  • Provides design guidance and feedback to other engineering personnel.
  • Maintains state-of-the-art knowledge in mechanical design practices, materials, components, and software design tools. Independently finds or creates solutions to problems requiring research, resourcefulness and creativity.
  • Works with the Design Department to develop esthetic product designs that meet the market need and customer acceptance.
  • Provides liaison engineering support.
  • Support test setups preparation and test reports development.
  • Maintains regular attendance including being at work, being on time to work and working full shifts.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Competencies:

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

Greenpoint Core Competencies

  • Adaptability – Adapts to changes in the work environment, manages competing demands, and accepts constructive criticism/feedback and changes approach or method to best fit the situation.
  • Communications – Expresses ideas and thoughts effectively in verbal and written form, exhibits good listening and comprehension, and keeps others informed and uses appropriate communication methods.
  • Dependability – Responds to requests for service and assistance, follows instruction and responds to management direction, takes responsibility for own actions and doing the best job possible, keeps commitments, and maintains reliable attendance.
  • Initiative – Sets and achieves challenging goals, demonstrates persistence and overcomes obstacles, measures self against standard of excellence, recognizes and acts on opportunities, and takes calculated risks to accomplish goals.
  • Teamwork – Balances team and individual responsibilities, exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views, gives and welcomes feedback, contributes to building a positive team spirit, and puts success of team above own interests.
  • Work Quality – Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness, displays commitment to excellence, looks for ways to improve and promote quality, applies feedback to improve performance, and monitors own work to ensure quality.

Job Core Competencies

  • Judgment – Displays willingness to make decisions, exhibits sound and accurate judgment, supports and explains reasoning for decisions, includes appropriate people in decision-making process, and makes timely decisions.
  • Planning and Organization – Prioritizes and plans work activities, uses time efficiently, plans for additional resources, integrates changes smoothly, sets goals and objectives, and works in an organized manner.
  • Job Knowledge – Competent in required job skills and knowledge, exhibits ability to learn and apply new skills, keeps abreast of current developments, requires minimal supervision, displays understanding of how job relates to others, and uses resources effectively.

Summary of Education, Experience & Certification

Bachelor's degree (B.S.) in engineering, a minimum of 8 years relevant experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Aviation background and aircraft interior experience required.

Employees working on programs subject to International Traffic in Arms Regulations must qualify as a US Person which is defined as a US Citizen, a Permanent Resident who does not work for a foreign company, foreign government, foreign governmental agency or organization, or a political asylee for legal compliance purposes.

Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong Computer Aided Drafting/Design skills, both 3D (Inventor preferred) and 2D (AutoCAD)
  • Familiarity with industry standard practices, fasteners, materials, and component parts. As well as the ability to search and specify new supplied parts.
  • Understanding of manufacturing methodologies, design-for-manufacturing and assembly, costing, and material selection.
  • Knowledge of industry design, documentation, and drafting (ANSI Y14.5) standards.
  • Understanding of mechanical motion modeling, and weight and balance analysis
  • Ability to check engineering drawings for Fit, Form and Function.
  • Ability to meet high expectations for meeting strict schedule, budget and technical solutions with minimal margin of error.
  • Ability to adapt to tailored processes designed for prototype engineering (vs. production engineering)
  • Broad and diverse knowledge of multiple disciplines:
    • Mechanical: lower and upper attached structure, monuments, ceilings, side walls, flooring, placards, OEM modifications, etc.
    • Avionics: Locating, provisioning, and installations for LRUs (electrical equipment.
  • Ability to work independently and cross-functionally as part of an established and growing team.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong time management and organizational skills.
  • Ability to sit for extended periods of time, use hands to lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and have close/color vision ability to adjust focus.
  • Ability to travel as required.
  • Ability to work outside of core business hours as required.

The expected WA salary range for this position is between $109,000.00 - $150,000.00 USD. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, education, location, and other factors permitted by law. Our suite of comprehensive benefits include: healthcare (medical, dental & vision), life insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) savings plan with company match.

About Greenpoint Technologies
Greenpoint delivers nose-to-tail VIP Jet aircraft interiors for private clients and Heads-of-State. We are proud to be known in the aerospace industry for our design and engineering innovation, award-winning company culture, and on-time delivery of our beautiful products. We use leading-edge tools and employee-built processes to deliver extraordinary, one-of-a-kind custom aircraft interiors. It’s complex work, but we work smart. In return for hard work, collaboration, and creativity, our people experience a culture custom built for high achievers:

  • Big jobs and stretch assignments.
  • High accountability environment, with transparent decisions aligned to values, open communication, and engaged leadership.
  • Ability to make a big, visible impact on the end product.

We welcome diverse contributions and provide equal employment opportunities to all individuals without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

raw.description:
About MediaRadar

MediaRadar, equips marketing, sales and analytics leaders with the intelligence they need to stay ahead. Our platform delivers always-on, AI-enabled Creative, Competitive, Commercial and Market Intelligence—spanning ad strategy, media spend, creative assets and brand messaging across 30+ media channels and five million brands.

With deep insights into more than 35 million ad and campaign assets and $280 billion in media spend, MediaRadar provides a single, interoperable source of truth that plugs seamlessly into enterprise analytics and AI systems. The result: faster, cleaner and more actionable intelligence that drives competitive advantage.

About The Role

We are seeking a Remote Broadcast Engineer to ensure the optimal performance of Deeplisten collection systems across the U.S. and Canada, maintaining a reliability rate of 99% or better. This role involves troubleshooting, repairing, and upgrading hardware and software systems, coordinating site relocations, and maintaining inventory. The ideal candidate will have civilian or military technical training, strong problem-solving skills, and experience with PC hardware repairs, software installations, RF reception, and data communications. Responsibilities include responding to alerts, coordinating third-party maintenance, and being on-call as needed for 24/7 support, including travel on short notice. This position requires strong communication skills, the ability to lift up to 75 pounds, work on rooftops, and maintain professional interactions with clients and vendors. A valid driver’s license and passport is required.

Requirements

We are looking for a Remote Broadcast Engineer with experience in the following areas:

  • Civilian or military technical training.
  • Demonstrated troubleshooting and problem isolation skills.
  • A working knowledge of the following areas:
    • PC Operation including diagnosis & repair to circuit level of hardware
    • Software installation & setup on hard drives & bios or firmware upgrades
    • Basic setup & programming of routers, & VPN firewalls
    • RF reception for radio and television (General antenna theory).
    • General understanding of cable signal operation.
    • Antenna cabling and signal distribution.
    • General basic electronics.
    • Use of some power and hand tools.
    • Basic electronic test instruments.
  • Strong communication skills

MAJOR JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • On a daily basis, use “Logimonitor”, PR_Web”, “Slack” and “Gmail” to see and be alerted to issues, troubleshoot and repair local site problems.
  • Field alerts from the “Pager Duty” on a daily basis and resolve these problems in an expeditious manner.
  • Perform onsite or remote repairs on Local Sites using a third party maintenance vendor or local site contact.
  • Maintain and keep current, a parts inventory database.
  • Ship parts, or have parts ordered and shipped, for repair of Local Sites, using the most timely and cost effective method.
  • Be in an “On-call” status, in an interdepartmental rotation, with other employees. This is on a 24/7 basis for the maintenance and repair of Local Site hardware problems, which includes weekends and holidays.
  • Travel to various cities, as necessary, possibly on less than 24-hour notice.
  • Troubleshoot and repair the data communications network using data communications vendor or third-party maintenance.
  • Coordinate necessary moves of Local Sites, which includes, but is not limited to, site selection, rent negotiations, power installation, climate control as necessary, signal installation, data communication installation, and the physical relocation of Mediaradar equipment. Perform any other duties as deemed necessary by the Field Operations manager.
  • Maintain detailed documentation on all work performed.

ADDITIONAL JOB DUTIES:

  • Must be able to lift 75 pounds
  • Must be able to climb ladders and perform work on rooftops.
  • Must have a valid drivers license
  • Must be able to acquire passport

CUSTOMER/CLIENT CONTACT AND INTERACTION:

  • This position requires constant telephone work with local contacts, potential landlords, cable companies, television stations, and other individuals outside of the company. At all times the incumbent should present a positive, professional company image and demeanor.
  • In all contacts, both internal and external, the incumbent must be persuasive, yet diplomatic, while at all times keeping Company needs and interests as the ultimate goal. When traveling, a positive professional attitude, appearance, and demeanor must be presented at all times. The Broadcast Engineer is probably the only person that the contacts in these cities will meet from the company.

Benefits

In addition to career progression, training and development, and an excellent work/life balance, future Radarians can expect a great benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • 401k with Company Match
  • Flexible PTO
  • Commuter Benefits
  • Gym Discounts
  • Summer Fridays

We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences makes us stronger and more innovative. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

In accordance with the EEO-1 reporting requirements, we collect demographic data as part of our efforts to ensure fair and equitable hiring practices across all levels of our organization.
