raw.description:
Data Scientist

What you will be doing:

This position will support independent and collaborative research programs in biostatistics and health outcomes research. Under the direction of senior team members, you will clean and analyze RWE data, implement established statistical methods, document reproducible analyses, and contribute to observational studies and partner deliverables. You will work with researchers, clinicians, product teams, and engineers to translate well-defined research questions into analyses and to communicate results clearly.


Biostatistics and Epidemiology

Real-World Evidence and Observational Research

Partner support: public health agencies, health systems, and academia

Key Responsibilities


Research Support and Collaboration – 25%

  • Support research projects conducted with public health agencies, hospitals and health systems, and academic institutions
  • Contribute to observational studies, such as cohort and cross-sectional analyses, using administrative, claims, and EHR data
  • Work with senior team members and subject matter experts to refine research questions and analytical requirements
  • Assist product and engineering teams in translating validated findings into product features or implementation requirements

Study Design and Statistical Analysis – 25%

  • Implement statistical analysis plans and research protocols developed with senior researchers
  • Apply established statistical methods, including descriptive statistics, hypothesis testing, regression models, and basic propensity score methods, with guidance
  • Perform data quality checks, create analytic datasets, and document assumptions, code, and results to support reproducibility
  • Generate and test defined hypotheses and summarize study results for clinical, operational, and policy audiences

Stakeholder Engagement and Research Partnerships – 15%

  • Participate in meetings with agency, health system, academic, and internal partners to gather requirements and provide analytical updates
  • Document partner needs, decisions, and follow-up actions
  • Use developing clinical, public health, or technical knowledge to help translate partner questions into measurable outcomes
  • Contribute analysis details and acceptance criteria to product backlogs

Publishing and Presentations – 15%

  • Contribute analyses, tables, figures, methods, and results to peer-reviewed manuscripts and technical reports
  • Prepare presentation materials, posters, and supporting documentation for conferences, partner meetings, and internal reviews
  • Present assigned portions of project work with coaching from senior team members

Knowledge Sharing – 10%

  • Share analytical approaches, demonstrations, and lessons learned with colleagues
  • Participate in technical reviews, training, and professional development
  • Build proficiency in healthcare data, epidemiologic methods, and team tools

Research Operations – 10%

  • Contribute to project estimates, research timelines, and work plans
  • Follow established research standards, operating procedures, version-control practices, and quality checks
  • Participate in peer review of code, analyses, and deliverables and address feedback promptly

​Required Qualifications

Work Experience:

Years of Applicable Experience - 2 or more years

Education:

Bachelors (Required)

Preferred Qualifications

Skills:

  • Foundational knowledge of statistics, epidemiology, or healthcare analytics
  • Ability to clean, join, summarize, and analyze structured data
  • Clear technical writing, presentation, and collaboration skills
  • Working knowledge of R or Python and SQL; familiarity with reproducible analysis and data modeling

Experience:

  • Academic, internship, or professional experience analyzing healthcare, public health, clinical, or other complex datasets
  • Experience applying statistical methods through coursework, research, internships, or employment
  • Experience producing documented analyses, tables, figures, or technical reports
  • Ability to work effectively on cross-functional teams and incorporate technical review feedback
  • Familiarity with real-world evidence datasets, including administrative claims or EHR data
  • Exposure to observational study designs, generalized linear models, propensity scores, or causal inference concepts
  • Experience with Git, Posit, Databricks, or another collaborative analytics environment
  • Coursework, internship, thesis, or publication experience in healthcare or public health research

Education:

  • Master’s degree, in statistics, biostatistics, epidemiology, public health, data science, economics, mathematics, engineering, or a related empirical field

Additional Job Requirements:

  • Remain in a stationary position for prolonged periods of time

  • Be adaptive and change priorities quickly; meet deadlines

  • Attention to detail

  • Operate computer programs and software

  • Ability to communicate effectively with audiences in person and in electronic formats.

  • Day-to-day contact with others (co-workers and/or the public)

  • Making independent decisions

  • Ability to work in a collaborative business environment in close quarters with peers and varying interruptions

Working Conditions: RemoteTravel Requirements: Travel 1-20% within the USPhysical Demands: Sedentary: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally, and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves remaining stationary most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if movement is required only occasionally, and all other sedentary criteria are met.Premier’s compensation philosophy is to ensure that compensation is reasonable, equitable, and competitive in order to attract and retain talented and highly skilled employees. Final salary is dependent upon several market factors including, but not limited to, departmental budgets, internal equity, education, unique skills/experience, and geographic location. Premier utilizes a wide-range salary structure to allow base salary flexibility within our ranges.

Qualified full-time and part-time employees also receive access to the following benefits:

raw.description:
About Anaconda

Be at the center of AI

Anaconda is built to advance AI with open source at scale, giving builders and organizations the confidence to increase productivity, and save time, spend and risk associated with open source. 95% of the Fortune 500 including Panasonic, AmTrust, Booz Allen Hamilton and over 50 million users rely on the value The Anaconda AI Platform delivers through a centralized approach to sourcing, securing, building, and deploying AI. With 21 billion downloads and growing, Anaconda has established itself as the gold standard for Python, data science, and AI and the enterprise-ready solution of choice for AI innovation. Anaconda is backed by world-class investors including Insight Partners. Learn more at .

Summary:

Marketing at Anaconda runs multiple concurrent programs—product launches, events, research reports, website updates, partner campaigns—each depending on several teams delivering the right work at the right time. We need someone to ensure those teams share one plan, understand dependencies, and surface schedule conflicts early enough to resolve them. You'll be the connective tissue across all marketing functions, owning the cross-functional calendar and turning strategic priorities into executable launch and campaign plans.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the cross-functional marketing calendar from planning through execution, building launch plans that define owners, deliverables, milestones, and dependencies for every program
  • Coordinate product launch timing with Product and Engineering via product marketing, bringing communications, web, design, demand gen, sales enablement, partner marketing, and regional marketing into plans at the right time
  • Map dependencies between functional teams and track through delivery, identifying conflicts, resource constraints, and timing risks early and proposing options for resolution
  • Assess the impact of scope or date changes on dependent work and communicate effects to affected teams and leadership before decisions are made
  • Participate in marketing leadership strategic planning meetings and translate priorities into campaign and launch plans with clear next steps
  • Establish Monday.com as the project management platform and system of record for all marketing programs, onboarding the team and maintaining visibility across initiatives
  • Produce clear status reporting using AI tools to automate tracking and updates, ensuring every team knows what it owes others and what it's waiting on
  • Lead postmortems after major launches and campaigns, document lessons learned, and turn insights into process, template, and timeline improvements that stick
Your Impact Will Be Measured Through:
  • Launches and campaigns hit planned dates, and any change comes with a clear view of effects on other work
  • The project tracker becomes the single source of truth for marketing programs, with every team using it to understand their deliverables and dependencies
  • Marketing leaders spend time on strategy and results instead of chasing status across functional teams
  • Each retrospective produces actionable changes that make the next program run better, with adoption confirmed through follow-up
What You Need:
  • 7+ years in B2B marketing campaign management or marketing project management at a software or developer tools company
  • Experience owning a project management tool (Monday.com, Asana, or Jira) as a system of record, including dependencies, critical path tracking, and stakeholder reporting—using one as a task list does not meet the bar
  • Track record of building project plans that reflect the real sequence of work, not the hoped-for one, with dependencies mapped and risks surfaced early
  • Credibility with senior leaders and cross-functional peers to push back when timelines are at risk, using data and dependency maps to support recommendations
  • Operator's mindset—you build processes where none exist and hold the line once they're in place, even when it's uncomfortable
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving company with shifting priorities and many programs running at once, adjusting plans without losing sight of dependencies
  • Technical fluency to understand product release stages, web projects like site migrations, and enough context to coordinate with Product and Engineering teams
  • Experience using AI tools to automate status reporting, tracking, and updates—you look for opportunities to eliminate manual work and improve visibility
  • Strong written and verbal communication that makes complex dependencies clear to leadership and cross-functional teams
What Will Make You Stand Out:
  • You've established Monday.com (or similar) as a source of truth for a siloed organization, onboarding teams and driving adoption across functional areas
  • You've worked in integrated marketing roles where you coordinated product marketing, demand gen, events, PR, and web teams on multi-layered campaigns
  • You've coordinated partner-related marketing activities within larger programs, managing dependencies across internal and external stakeholders
  • You've worked at a fast-paced startup or scale-up where priorities shift weekly and you've learned to adjust plans without losing sight of what matters
  • You've worked at an open-source, AI, or data science company and understand the unique challenges of developer-focused marketing programs
  • You embody our values: 'Curious by Default', 'Build Together', 'Own It', and 'Lead with Guts and Heart', and our behaviors: Clarity, Care and Candor
  • You care deeply about fostering an environment where people of all backgrounds and experiences can flourish
Why You'll Like Working Here:
  • You'll thrive in a high-performance environment where results are recognized and rewarded
  • Your work directly contributes to shaping the future of data science, machine learning, and AI in the enterprise.
  • You'll work alongside a collaborative team that values diverse, thoughtful discussion, clarity and candor.
  • You'll be supported by a culture that puts employees first - with flexible hours, a fully remote setup, and a genuine commitment to your wellbeing and growth.

The application deadline for this role is 01/09/2027;applicants will be reviewed on an ongoing basis until the role is filled.

The base salary range for this role is $136,000 - $176,500 for candidates in New York City and San Francisco, and $102,000 - $150,000 for other US-based team members, along with annual bonus potential, equity participation, and benefits.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by various factors, including work location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter will provide more specific details on the salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

In addition to base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  • Flexible Vacation Policy
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Short Term and Long Term Disability
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Monthly Wellness Stipend
  • Employee Assistance Program and Mental Health Resources

An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

Anaconda, Inc. (“We”, “Us”) are committed to protecting and respecting your privacy. This Privacy Notice sets out the basis on which the personal data collected from you, or that you provide to Us, will be processed by Us in connection with Our recruitment processes.

By clicking “Submit Application”, you acknowledge you have read our Privacy Policy and that Anaconda can retain your application data for up to 1-year, unless otherwise stated. raw.description:
Established in 2014 and based in Charleston, South Carolina, Soteria's expertise in the cybersecurity domain is predicated upon the accumulated practical experience across all team members. Soteria's security professionals have held leading positions in private industries, state governments, and federal intelligence communities.

Driven by this combined pool of knowledge as well as the belief that “Security is for Everyone,” Soteria offers advisory services and solutions which are significantly differentiated from the security status quo. Soteria treats each client as a unique case deserving of individualized security insights and specialized hands-on assistance.

About the role

At Soteria, our incident response professionals work directly with our clients to recover from incidents as quickly and effectively as possible. We strive to be the steady hand that guides our clients when they are having their worst day. Once the incident is over, we continue our partnership to assist our customers in implementing the changes needed to prevent repeat incidents in the future.

What you'll do

  • Provide clients with advice and guidance as they navigate the incident response and recovery process.
  • Lead and participate in security incident and data breach investigations, triaging, collecting, and analyzing forensically valuable data to determine the scope and severity of incidents.
  • Lead IR engagements and take ownership of multiple DFIR processes and procedures to improve overall team capabilities, ensuring timely delivery aligned with client expectations.
  • Coordinate resources and teammates as needed to deliver engagements on time and with accuracy, tailoring each engagement to meet the client's specific response needs.
  • Identify gaps in capabilities and tooling, and resolve those gaps to ensure the team is able to investigate new and unique threats.
  • Document and present findings and recommendations to clients in a professional manner.
  • Maintain relationships with clients post-engagement in order to assist and advise on longer-term remediation efforts.
  • Maintain competence in security trends, technologies, and practices.
  • Work with Soteria's managed detection and response team to improve detection capabilities.

raw.excerpt: Our client is a leading financial services organization supporting businesses with commercial payment solutions.
raw.description:
Our client is a leading financial services organization supporting businesses with commercial payment solutions. They are seeking a Supplier Enablement Specialist to help business customers transition supplier payments from traditional paper checks to electronic payment methods, including commercial card and ACH.

In this role, you will conduct supplier outreach, explain approved electronic payment options, facilitate enrollment, and coordinate with business customers and internal teams to resolve questions and manage exceptions. The ideal candidate brings direct supplier enablement experience, professional phone and email communication skills, and the ability to manage a high volume of cases accurately while supporting broader payment conversion goals.

The Details:

  • Location: Remote (must be able to work across U.S. time zones)
  • Duration: Approximately a 12-month consulting role with the possibility of extension (must be able to work on Blend’s W2 without sponsorship)
  • Benefits: We do offer benefits to our full-time consultants, including Health, Vision, Dental, 401K plan, Life Insurance, Pretax Commuter Benefits, and an incredibly supportive team cheering you on!

What you’ll do:

Supplier Outreach & Electronic Payment Conversion

  • Conduct proactive outbound phone and email outreach to suppliers assigned to payment conversion campaigns.
  • Explain approved electronic payment options, their benefits, and applicable program requirements.
  • Communicate with each business customer's payment strategy and relevant operating guidelines clearly and professionally.
  • Answer supplier questions, address common concerns, and help suppliers understand the steps required to adopt electronic payment methods.
  • Manage follow-up activities to move each supplier through enrollment, closure, or formal handoff.
  • Support campaign objectives by encouraging supplier participation and adoption of electronic payment solutions.

Supplier Research & Stakeholder Coordination

  • Review assigned supplier records and verify available contact information and payment details.
  • Research supplier questions and provide timely, accurate responses within established guidelines.
  • Coordinate communication among business customers, suppliers, and internal financial institution teams.
  • Identify questions or situations that fall outside standard procedures and route them to the appropriate team.
  • Escalate commercial, technical, policy, compliance, and other nonstandard issues as needed.

Enrollment, Documentation & Case Management

  • Enroll suppliers when their circumstances align with established operating procedures and approved guidelines.
  • Identify exceptions and route nonstandard enrollment requests to the designated team for review and resolution.
  • Maintain accurate records of supplier outreach, responses, enrollment progress, follow-up requirements, and final case status.
  • Track assigned cases through completion or handoff, ensuring appropriate documentation and follow-through.
  • Provide accurate activity data to support monthly reporting, campaign tracking, and overall program performance.
  • Manage multiple supplier cases and follow-up activities while maintaining productivity, accuracy, and attention to detail.

Compliance & Quality

  • Follow applicable policies, procedures, operating guides, regulatory requirements, and quality standards.
  • Apply approved solutions consistently and recognize when additional review or escalation is required.
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation in a regulated financial services environment.
  • Balance productivity and responsiveness with careful execution across repetitive, high-volume workflows.
  • Work independently while following client priorities, established processes, and escalation procedures.

Education & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in client service, sales, operations, financial services, payments, or a related field.
  • At least 2 years of direct supplier enablement experience supporting electronic payment adoption.
  • Professional outbound calling or sales experience, including the ability to communicate effectively with business contacts.
  • Experience in supporting supplier onboarding, business payments, commercial cards, ACH, Treasury Management, accounts payable, or payment conversion initiatives is preferred.
  • Experience working with a bank, payment provider, fintech organization, or large corporate payments program is a plus.
  • Experience in a regulated or compliance-driven environment is preferred.

Technical & Operational Skills

  • Moderate Microsoft Excel proficiency, including formulas, filtering, sorting, and formatting.
  • Experience using CRM systems, call-tracking platforms, workflow tools, or case-management systems.
  • Ability to review records, research questions, apply approved solutions, and maintain accurate documentation.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple cases, follow-ups, and competing priorities.
  • Ability to meet deadlines while maintaining quality and attention to detail.

Communication & Professional Skills

  • Strong verbal communication skills and a professional, confident telephone manner.
  • Clear and effective business email writing and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Ability to explain processes and payment options in straightforward, easy-to-understand terms.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the judgment to distinguish routine questions from issues requiring escalation.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with suppliers, business customers, and internal teams.
  • Reliable follow-through, attention to detail, and a consistent focus on service quality and campaign goals.

The starting pay rate for this role is $40.00 per hour. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent on several factors including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, certifications, training, and location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range and determining factors for compensation are considered for each individual circumstance. BLEND360 also offers a competitive benefits program to meet the health and financial well-being of our team and their families. You can look forward to a range of benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401K, PTO, commuter benefits, spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage, and EAPs.

A diverse workforce is a strong workforce
To deliver growth at BLEND360 and for our clients, we believe as a Talent Solutions Company, we have a responsibility and unique opportunity to positively impact the workforce. Diversity has played a critical role in our history, our growth, and continues to have a profound impact on our success. We are determined to have equality in the workplace, within our team and as an extension of our clients’ team.

BLEND360 is an equal opportunity employer.

Blend is a premier AI services provider, committed to co-creating meaningful impact for its clients through the power of data science, AI, technology, and people. With a mission to fuel bold visions, Blend tackles significant challenges by seamlessly aligning human expertise with artificial intelligence. The company is dedicated to unlocking value and fostering innovation for its clients by harnessing world-class people and data-driven strategy. We believe that the power of people and AI can have a meaningful impact on your world, creating more fulfilling work and projects for our people and clients.

Job Broker - Employer Engagement

Locations: Stratford-upon-Avon (Warwick, Leamington Spa)
Hours:Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm
Salary:£28,000 - £31,000

Contract:Full-time, permanent, home-based with regular travel and outreach across South Warwickshire.

Help young people take their next step into work

At Fedcap, we believe every young person should have the opportunity to build a better future through work.

This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in transforming futures by connecting young people with local employers. You'll build strong relationships with businesses, identify meaningful job opportunities and work closely with participants to understand their goals, match them to the right role and support them to succeed.

If you're someone who enjoys engaging employers, creating opportunities and seeing the life-changing impact that employment can have on an individual's confidence, independence and future, this could be the role for you.

What you’ll be doing

  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with local employers across a range of sectors.

  • Generating quality vacancies, work placements, apprenticeships and other employment opportunities.

  • Getting to know employers and understand their recruitment needs, workplace culture and progression opportunities.

  • Developing a pipeline of vacancies and actively match participants to suitable opportunities.

  • Using creative approaches such as reverse marketing to open up opportunities that may not otherwise exist.

  • Supporting participants throughout the recruitment journey, from identifying suitable roles through to interviews, job starts and beyond.

  • Working with employers and participants to agree effective onboarding arrangements, workplace support and reasonable adjustments where required.

  • Carrying out strengths-based vocational profiling to understand each participant’s skills, aspirations, experience and barriers.
  • Providing practical support with job searching, applications, CVs and interview preparation.
  • Connecting participants with specialist services and community organisations where additional support is needed.
  • Providing in-work support to help people settle into their roles, overcome challenges and sustain employment.

What we’re looking for

We’re interested in people who can build relationships, spot opportunities and genuinely want to help people succeed.

You’ll ideally have experience in recruitment, employer engagement, business development, sales, account management, employability, employment services or another employer-facing role.

We’re looking for someone who can:

  • Build trusted relationships with employers and other stakeholders.
  • Identify employer needs and turn conversations into real recruitment opportunities.
  • Match people effectively to vacancies and support successful recruitment.
  • Communicate confidently and influence a wide range of people.
  • Network within the local business community and develop new employer relationships.
  • Manage multiple employers, vacancies and participants while staying organised.
  • Work towards performance targets and contractual outcomes.
  • Understand local labour markets and the factors influencing recruitment.

Experience of welfare-to-work, employability, supported employment or working with people facing barriers to employment would be valuable, as would experience of working with young people, apprenticeships or skills pathways.

Above all, we’re looking for someone who is passionate about creating opportunities and making a tangible difference to people’s lives.

Why join Fedcap?

At Fedcap UK, we’re a mission-led, not-for-profit organisation focused on improving people’s economic mobility.

As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to make a real difference every day — helping people take steps towards employment while building lasting relationships with employers in your community.

Here’s what makes Fedcap a rewarding career…

At Fedcap, we’re proud to offer a comprehensive and rewarding benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, development and work-life balance:

  • 33 days’ annual leave (including bank holidays) with the option to buy or sell additional days
  • £500 annual benefits scheme to spend at over 900 retailers
  • Cycle to Work scheme open all year round
  • Pension scheme with up to 5% employer match
  • Free life assurance worth 4x your salary
  • Health & wellbeing support, including access to our 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme for you and your family
  • Digital gym, mindfulness resources, virtual GP and more

Equity, Diversity & Inclusion

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone is treated fairly, feels they belong, and can do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and communities, and we value the different perspectives and lived experiences they bring. We do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

  • Fedcap Employment is a Disability Confident Leader employer. We will consider reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process and, where required, in the workplace. We will not exclude a candidate with a disability unless they are unable to carry out a duty that is intrinsic to the role, after reasonable adjustments have been considered.
  • We are positive about employing veterans, serving personnel, and spouses/partners and family members, as part of our commitment to the principles of the Armed Forces Covenant.
  • As a Ban the Box employer, we assess applicants on their skills and potential. We do not ask about criminal convictions at the initial application stage, and any relevant information is considered fairly and in line with the role.

What You Will Do:

As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer Lead, you will work directly with clients and multidisciplinary delivery teams to turn complex business and mission needs into practical, production-ready AI solutions. You will operate at the intersection of AI, software engineering, data, and client delivery, moving quickly from ambiguous problems to working prototypes, integrated solutions, and scalable implementation patterns.

This role combines hands-on engineering, client-facing technical leadership, innovation, and team development. You will lead complex forward deployed engagements while helping build the next generation of Forward Deployed Engineers through hands-on mentorship, technical coaching, and repeatable engineering and delivery best practices.


Forward Deployed Engineering & Solution Delivery

  • Lead forward deployed engineering engagements, partnering directly with clients to understand complex workflows, identify high-value opportunities, and translate business and mission needs into working AI solutions.
  • Rapidly design, prototype, test, and deploy generative AI and agentic AI applications within complex enterprise environments.
  • Build advanced AI solutions using leading large language models, APIs, developer tooling, and enterprise AI platforms.
  • Translate ambiguous and evolving requirements into practical technical designs, prototypes, and production-ready solutions.
  • Design and implement agentic architectures incorporating Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent-to-agent (A2A) communication, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool use, structured outputs, orchestration, context management, and human review where appropriate.
  • Lead technical discovery sessions, architecture discussions, demonstrations, and hands-on solution working sessions with client stakeholders.
  • Partner directly with users throughout implementation to gather feedback, diagnose challenges, refine solutions, and drive adoption.
  • Identify innovative and practical ways to apply emerging AI capabilities to complex client challenges while balancing usability, performance, security, maintainability, and responsible AI.

Engineering & Integration

  • Architect, build, and maintain integrations with internal and external systems using APIs, services, data pipelines, and modern application development practices.
  • Design AI applications and agents that interact with enterprise data, tools, business systems, APIs, and other agents.
  • Design and implement MCP-based integrations connecting AI applications and agents with enterprise tools, services, and data sources.
  • Design and implement A2A and multi-agent patterns enabling specialized agents to coordinate and communicate as part of broader workflows.
  • Design and implement RAG solutions, including enterprise knowledge retrieval, embeddings, vector search, grounding, and related retrieval patterns.
  • Apply modern software engineering practices to move solutions from rapid prototype through testing, deployment, and operational support.
  • Work with relational databases, vector stores, retrieval systems, APIs, and related data patterns to support application state, knowledge retrieval, traceability, and auditability.
  • Implement testing, evaluation, logging, monitoring, and observability for AI-enabled applications and agentic workflows.
  • Diagnose complex technical and integration issues across applications, models, agents, APIs, data, and infrastructure.
  • Establish reusable technical patterns and accelerators that improve the quality and speed of future implementations.

Client & Technical Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted senior technical advisor to clients on complex generative AI and agentic AI initiatives.
  • Build relationships with technical, business, data, and leadership stakeholders, connecting client needs with practical technical solutions.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts, solution options, risks, and trade-offs clearly to technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior client leaders.
  • Facilitate technical discovery and working sessions that turn ambiguous client problems into actionable engineering decisions and solution approaches.
  • Present prototypes, solution demonstrations, architecture decisions, and technical recommendations to client stakeholders.
  • Ask effective questions, listen to client needs, and adapt technical approaches based on business, mission, user, and technology considerations.
  • Challenge assumptions constructively and propose innovative approaches when conventional solutions do not adequately address the problem.
  • Balance rapid experimentation and creative problem-solving with the engineering discipline required to deliver reliable, secure, maintainable, and scalable solutions.

FDE Capability Building & Mentorship

  • Mentor and develop junior and mid-level engineers into effective Forward Deployed Engineers, building both their technical engineering skills and client-facing delivery capabilities.
  • Coach team members on FDE best practices, including technical discovery, problem decomposition, requirements translation, rapid prototyping, solution design, client communication, demonstrations, implementation, troubleshooting, and knowledge transfer.
  • Provide hands-on technical direction, architecture guidance, code review, pairing, and engineering mentorship.
  • Develop and promote reusable FDE playbooks, engineering standards, solution patterns, accelerators, and implementation best practices.
  • Coach team members on modern agentic AI engineering patterns, including MCP, A2A, RAG, tool use, orchestration, evaluation, and responsible AI practices.
  • Help engineers become comfortable operating in ambiguous client environments and moving independently from problem identification through working solution.
  • Create opportunities for junior team members to progressively assume responsibility for technical discovery, client discussions, demonstrations, solution ownership, and technical leadership.
  • Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous learning, collaboration, technical excellence, and responsible AI development.
  • Capture and share lessons learned across engagements to continuously improve FDE practices and delivery quality.

What You Will Need:

  • Must be able to OBTAIN and MAINTAIN a Federal PUBLIC TRUST;. Candidates with an ACTIVE PUBLIC TRUST or SUITABILITY are preferred.
  • SEVEN (7+) or more years of overall work experience.
  • Experience in software engineering, data engineering, AI/ML engineering, solution engineering, or a related technical role.
  • Experience working as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Forward Deployed Software Engineer, Forward Deployed AI Engineer, or in a comparable client-embedded engineering role, including translating ambiguous client requirements into working technical solutions.
  • Hands-on experience designing and building generative AI, large language model, or agentic AI solutions.
  • Hands-on experience developing solutions using Claude APIs, Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, tool use, Custom Skills, or comparable enterprise large language model platforms and developer tooling.
  • Hands-on experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and its use in connecting AI applications or agents with tools, services, data sources, or enterprise systems.
  • Hands-on experience with agent-to-agent (A2A) and multi-agent solution patterns, including communication or coordination among specialized agents.
  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions, including enterprise knowledge retrieval, embeddings, vector search, and grounding LLM applications with authoritative data or content.
  • Hands-on experience designing agentic AI solutions using tool use, structured outputs, context management, orchestration, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
  • Strong software engineering experience using modern programming languages, APIs, services, and application development frameworks.
  • Experience integrating AI applications and agents with enterprise systems, databases, APIs, tools, and data sources.
  • Experience developing reliable, maintainable, testable, and well-documented production code.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring and developing engineers, including coaching team members on engineering standards, technical problem-solving, solution delivery, and client-facing responsibilities.
  • Strong client communication and consulting skills, with demonstrated ability to work effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior client leaders.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical discovery and translate ambiguous business or mission problems into actionable technical requirements and working solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex technical implementations and providing technical direction to engineering or multidisciplinary teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to think innovatively, challenge conventional approaches, rapidly evaluate emerging technologies, and develop creative technical solutions to complex or undefined problems.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts, architecture decisions, risks, recommendations, and trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

What Would Be Nice To Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university.
  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field.
  • Experience delivering AI, data, or software solutions within Federal Government, healthcare, financial services, or other highly regulated environments.
  • Experience deploying generative AI and agentic solutions on major cloud and enterprise AI platforms such as Microsoft Azure / Azure OpenAI, AWS / Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud / Vertex AI, Databricks, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience with modern AI and agent development frameworks and patterns, such as LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or comparable orchestration frameworks.
  • Experience operationalizing generative AI solutions, including LLM evaluation, tracing, observability, prompt and model management, guardrails, cost optimization, and production monitoring.
  • Experience designing secure AI architectures incorporating identity and access management, secrets management, API security, data protection, authorization, auditability, and responsible AI controls.
  • Experience working with containers, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and cloud-native deployment patterns, including technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Terraform.
  • Experience with knowledge graphs, graph databases, advanced retrieval techniques, hybrid search, reranking, or other approaches that improve the quality and reliability of enterprise RAG solutions.
  • Experience developing reusable AI accelerators, reference architectures, engineering frameworks, or platform capabilities that can be applied across multiple teams or client engagements.
  • Experience contributing to technical strategy, solution architecture, estimation, proposal development, technical demonstrations, or client pursuit activities.
  • Relevant cloud, AI, data, or security certifications.
  • Active Federal Public Trust, Secret, or higher-level security clearance.
The annual salary range for this position is $149,000.00-$248,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

What We Offer:

Guidehouse offers a comprehensive, total rewards package that includes competitive compensation and a flexible benefits package that reflects our commitment to creating a diverse and supportive workplace.

Kimbrell Agency

Remote (Oklahoma City, OK area)

Employment Type: Contractor

Compensation $50,000 to $100,000 per year (plus commission)

If you're reading this and thinking, "Insurance? Really?" I get it. I've thought that too—and I still do. The truth is, I'm not passionate about insurance. I'm passionate about people. We don’t just build careers; we build people who, in turn, build businesses. The result? Success and fulfillment.

We look forward to discovering what success means to you and, if we find that this is the right fit, we are fully committed to providing you with the tools, training, and support to make it happen.

The Problem with Most Insurance Jobs:

Let’s be real—most agencies are desperate to hire anyone with a pulse, offer minimal support, and if you're lucky, they might invest in you six months down the line. We think that's unacceptable.

At The Kimbrell Agency, we do things differently. We invest heavily from the start to ensure you're the right fit for this career. That means we pour everything into your long-term success. No leader can give everything it takes to help an agent succeed when they’re bringing on anyone who applies. Unfortunately, most agencies make empty promises: "Be in business for yourself, but not by yourself," or "We offer hands-on support and training."

Here, we actually mean it. And we have a proven track record of success to back it up.

What We Offer:

A Proven Lead System: Say goodbye to cold calling. Our streamlined lead generation system puts you in front of qualified buyers who have requested coverage. You’ll call these clients, set appointments, and meet virtually to help them find the best insurance plan for their needs and budget. Some agents even start part-time and transition to full-time.

A Real Opportunity for Growth: This role is perfect for self-disciplined sales professionals who are ready to put in the work. If you need someone looking over your shoulder or a time clock to punch, this isn't the right fit. But if you're driven, gritty and ready to build something meaningful, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities:

Present and sell insurance products to new and existing customers.

Reach out to potential clients who have requested coverage.

Handle customer inquiries and resolve complaints.

Participate in regular Zoom training sessions.

Who We're Looking For:

Previous experience in sales, customer service, or a related field is a plus.

Familiarity with CRM platforms is helpful.

You know how to build rapport and trust with clients.

You’re deadline-driven, detail-oriented, and dedicated to delivering results.

Integrity and a strong work ethic are a must.

We’re seeking individuals who are ambitious, coachable, passionate about helping others, and driven to achieve greatness. If you’re ready to take control of your future and create a career you can be proud of, we’d love to connect.

Why Choose Us?

True Agency Ownership: Here, you’ll have the chance to own your business—contractually protect what you build.

Game-Changing Lead Program: We provide the industry’s best leads, generated in-house and heavily subsidized to help you succeed.

Comprehensive Training & Support: From day one, we offer hands-on training, including daily coaching calls, weekly one-on-ones, and group sessions. You’ll have a system to follow at every step of the way.

Industry-Leading Compensation: Our compensation plan is designed to deliver real profit, with vested rights from day one.

Dedicated Conservation Team: Our team ensures your business stays protected from chargebacks, giving you one of the highest persistency rates in the industry.

World-Class Travel & Incentives: Have the ability to earn 3-4 fully-paid trips per year, all expenses covered.

Unlimited Earning Potential: This is a commission and bonus-based position, with no cap on how much you can earn. Your income potential is truly unlimited.

A Few More Details:

This role does require a Life and Health Insurance License, but don’t worry—we’ll help you obtain it through a streamlined online course that takes just 7-10 days.

Please note: Success in this role varies. Your level of success will depend on several factors, including the effort you put in, your ability to follow and implement our proven system, and the specific insurance needs in your geographic area. Not all agents achieve the same results, and earnings are based on individual performance.

Ready to Build Your Future with Us?

If you're ready to make a difference—not just in your own life, but in the lives of others—apply today. We can’t wait to see how you define success.

About Kimbrell Agency:

Kyle & Lisa Kimbrell are financial service industry veterans with over 50 years experience combined in sales, marketing and leadership. Since founding their Symmetry Financial Group business in July of 2016 their national agency has sold over 55,000 life, health, annuity, disability and retirement policies with over $85 million in sales. The Kimbrells attained Equity Partnership in only 24 months, which is the fastest in SFG history.

This role supports pricing strategy, portfolio management, planning, and product initiatives for a profitable $250 million book comprising Management Liability (Employment Practices Liability, Fidelity & Crime, Directors & Officers, and Cyber) and Surety (Commercial and Contract). The position reports to the AVP & Actuary of Professional and Executive Lines & Surety and serves as a key actuarial partner to underwriting and business leadership. This role works closely with Presidents, Chief Underwriting Officers, and cross‑functional stakeholders to inform decision‑making, drive pricing sophistication, and support profitable growth. You are expected to provide strong technical leadership, analytical insight, and business partnership. The position requires close collaboration across the Specialty actuarial team and the broader organization, including Corporate Underwriting, Claims, Enterprise Product, Data & Analytics, and Finance. The role balances hands‑on actuarial work with leadership, influence, and talent development. This is a full‑time, exempt role.

WHAT YOU WILL DO IN THIS ROLE:

Lead and continuously advance pricing segmentation, sophistication, and underwriting guidance aligned with business strategy Own segmented profitability reviews and ongoing portfolio monitoring to inform actions and manage performance Lead actuarial planning, forecasting, and IBNR analyses in partnership with Finance and Reserving Influence strategic investments in data, analytics, and technology to improve insight, efficiency, and decision-making Monitor performance trends and clearly communicate insights and recommendations to senior and executive leadership Partner with underwriting and business leadership to shape product strategy, growth initiatives, and market actions Anticipate and manage emerging issues, balancing risk, profitability, and growth Provide leadership, coaching, and performance management for actuarial staff Influence outcomes across the organization through strong relationships, credibility, and sound actuarial judgment

WHAT YOU NEED TO APPLY:

Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant technical field 7+ years of actuarial experience across multiple lines and disciplines (pricing, reserving, analytics) Prior people leadership experience preferred ACAS required; FCAS preferred Advanced communication skills, including the ability to translate analysis into clear business insights Advanced data analysis, modeling, and portfolio management capabilities Intermediate programming or automation experience Strong actuarial judgment and understanding of modeling techniques, assumptions, and limitations Ability to lead, develop, and motivate teams Ability to influence decisions and partner effectively across functions Strategic Thinking Business & Enterprise Acumen Talent & Change Leadership Results Orientation Influence & Relationship Building

The Opportunity:

The Contract Analyst – State Government Contracts is responsible for leading, administering, coordinating, and supporting VWR’s State Government contract programs, with ownership of contract administrative efforts and customer relationships for major state and cooperative contract vehicles, including NASPO. This role ensures contractual requirements are monitored, reported, and executed in alignment with customer obligations, internal policies, and compliance expectations. The Contract Analyst serves as the primary point of contact for state government contracting entities and partners closely with Sales, Bids/Quotes, Pricing, Legal, Government Contracts leadership, and external customers to support contract performance, issue resolution, reporting accuracy, and continuous process improvement.


The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable leading the State Government portfolio and managing time-sensitive contract administration activities in a fast-paced environment. This individual must be able to operate independently within defined business objectives while maintaining strong communication with internal stakeholders and state government customers.


How you will thrive and create an impact


  • Lead contract administrative efforts for the State Government portfolio, including NASPO, ensuring contract requirements are executed accurately, timely, and in compliance with customer obligations.
  • Serve as the primary VWR relationship owner and point of contact for NASPO and other state contracting entities, including lead state contract administrators and participating states.
  • Manage the lifecycle of state and cooperative contracts, including participating addenda, renewals, extensions, amendments, and contract transitions.
  • Own periodic sales reporting and administrative fee calculation and remittance for state and cooperative contracts, ensuring accuracy and on-time delivery.
  • Take ownership of contract compliance issues by performing and communicating root-cause analysis to management and successfully implementing corrective action plans in collaboration with internal and external partners and customers.
  • Perform analysis and complete reporting functions for assigned state government customers, including customer-specific reporting, fee requirements, and contract performance tracking.
  • Perform contract modifications and administrative actions on assigned state government contracts, including completion and maintenance of customer pricing files.
  • Proactively recommend tools, policies, and processes that enhance state government customer performance, contract compliance, reporting accuracy, and operational efficiency; assist in developing, auditing, and implementing such functionality.
  • Provide supporting analytics to Sales leadership and the Government Contracts Manager to improve state government customer growth, profitability, and performance across NASPO and other state and cooperative contracts.
  • Set priorities and direction for the State Government contract program in partnership with the Government Contracts Manager, including growth opportunities, risk mitigation, and process standardization.
  • Partner with Bids/Quotes and Legal to coordinate state and cooperative contract solicitation responses, pricing submissions, and contract negotiations.
  • Partner with Sales and Bids/Quotes teams to implement new agreements and ensure all aspects of contractual requirements are delivered to the customer.
  • Train and assist internal partners to ensure customer reporting, administrative fee requirements, and other contract obligations are maintained and executed in compliance with VWR’s contracts.
  • Proactively manage and measure assigned accounts against departmental metrics to drive business support, process improvement, and accountability.
  • Maintain effective communication with internal stakeholders and external state government customers regarding contract requirements, reporting obligations, pricing files, timelines, and administrative actions.
  • Support audit readiness, documentation accuracy, and contract file maintenance to ensure clear records of contract activity, decisions, actions, and customer communications.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for state contracting and provide guidance to internal partners; perform other duties as assigned in support of Government Contracts administration and operational excellence.

What we're looking for


  • College degree or equivalent applicable experience required.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of applicable experience in contracts, government procurement, pricing, customer contract operations, reporting, or a related business support function.
  • State government procurement and contract administration background preferred.
  • Knowledge of state procurement rules and cooperative purchasing programs preferred; familiarity with Federal Acquisition Regulations a plus, but not required.
  • Strong Excel capabilities
  • Experience managing state or cooperative purchasing contract vehicles such as NASPO ValuePoint or similar programs strongly preferred; federal contract experience (e.g., GSA, DLA eCAT) a plus.
  • Excellent communication and analytical skills, with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently with broad general guidance against a framework of defined business objectives.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead a contract portfolio, build and sustain relationships with government customers, and influence cross-functional partners.
  • Ability to analyze data, prepare reports, maintain pricing files, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Ability to navigate and effectively communicate with internal partners and external customers, including state government contract administrators and procurement officials.
  • Ability to prioritize work and manage extremely time-sensitive deadlines.
  • Ability to understand and comply with internal policies, contract terms, customer requirements, and reporting obligations.
  • Ability to travel approximately 5% as business needs require.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • High level of accountability, ownership, and follow-through on assigned contract administration activities.
  • Leadership presence with the ability to represent VWR with state government customers and guide internal partners on contract requirements.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes, recommend corrective actions, and support implementation.
  • Customer-focused approach with the ability to balance service, compliance, risk management, and business needs.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Sales, Bids/Quotes, Pricing, Legal, Operations, Customer Service, and external customer contacts.
  • Ability to identify process gaps and recommend practical improvements to increase efficiency, compliance, and customer performance.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Security Architect responsible for designing, developing, and governing enterprise security architectures that protect information systems, applications, infrastructure, cloud environments, and sensitive data. This role establishes security architecture principles, reference designs, technical standards, and implementation patterns aligned with organizational risk tolerance, mission objectives, and applicable federal security requirements.

Work Location: This is a remote position, but candidate must be willing to work during the hours of 8am - 5pm EST

This position is contingent upon contract award

What You Will Do:

  • Develop and maintain enterprise security architecture principles, reference architectures, technical standards, and security design patterns.
  • Translate business, mission, and regulatory requirements into secure architectural solutions across applications, infrastructure, networks, endpoints, and cloud environments.
  • Conduct security architecture reviews and threat modeling to identify design weaknesses, architectural risks, and opportunities to strengthen security controls.
  • Define security requirements for new systems, technology integrations, modernization initiatives, and enterprise platforms.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and provide architecture recommendations that balance security, scalability, performance, cost, and operational requirements.
  • Establish architecture governance processes and ensure security considerations are incorporated throughout the system development lifecycle.
  • Provide technical architecture guidance to security engineering, DevSecOps, cloud platform, infrastructure, and application teams.
  • Establish secure integration patterns for security monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, and threat detection capabilities.
  • Review technical designs, solution proposals, and implementation plans to validate alignment with security architecture standards.
  • Support the selection and integration of security technologies based on technical requirements, threat models, and organizational needs.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust level clearance
  • Bachelors Degree and 12 years of experience, a Masters Degree and 10 years of experience, an Associates Degree and 14 years, or a High School Diploma or equivalent and 16 years of experience
  • One or more of the following relevant certifications: CISSP, CISM, CASP, CCISO, Security+, or CAP
  • Experience designing Zero Trust and identity-centric architectures, including FICAM-aligned identity, credential and access management.
  • FedRAMP and AWS GovCloud or Azure Government experience
  • Demonstrated experience designing and reviewing security architectures for complex enterprise, cloud, hybrid, or federal information systems.
  • Strong understanding of security architecture principles, threat modeling, defense-in-depth, least privilege, identity security, encryption, and network security.
  • Experience applying security frameworks and controls, including NIST SP 800-53 and other applicable federal or industry standards.
  • Proven experience translating security requirements into technical architecture designs, implementation standards, and security control specifications.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Active Secret clearance
  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
  • AWS Certified Security - Specialty certification, or an architecture certification such as SABSA, TOGAF, or CISSP-ISSAP
  • Experience with federal agency modernization roadmaps

Target Salary Range

$112,000 - $179,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at

Based on the depth of experience acquired in the past 25 years, we have developed proprietary data-driven tools and technologies that enhance patient engagement and empower Change for Good.

Our Vision
To preserve the health of people everywhere, in any place at any time.

Our Purpose

  • Bilingual in English/Spanish is preferred.

  • Proficient with Microsoft Office suite, specifically PowerPoint (PPT) and Excel

  • Exceptional time management, communication, and organizational skills

  • Excellent and proactive problem solver

  • Ability to adapt quickly and be flexible in the face of changing priorities

  • Excellent attention to detail

• Comprehensive healthcare benefits package

• Retirement savings plan

Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on.     • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

The role replaces manual, spreadsheet-based scorecard tracking with a structured, automated, and secure reporting system, and hands it over to Microsoft owners with full documentation.

Key Responsibilities

1. Environment Setup

  • Stand up Power Platform environments (Dev / Test / Prod) with Dataverse, DLP policies, and approved connectors
  • Configure Power BI and Fabric workspaces per environment, including capacity and naming conventions
  • Provision a SQL database (Azure SQL or Fabric SQL) for structured scorecard data
  • Set up security groups, service principals / service accounts, and source control for solutions and reports

2. Data Integration (ETL)

  • Inventory current data sources (Excel trackers, SharePoint lists, emails, existing systems)
  • Replace free-form spreadsheets with structured data entry (Power Apps / Forms into Dataverse or SQL)
  • Build Fabric pipelines and dataflows to load, clean, and validate data on a schedule
  • Design a star-schema semantic model (lessor, property, period, metric) as the single source for reporting

3. Automation and AI

  • Build Power Automate flows for scorecard requests, reminders, approvals, and escalations
  • Implement automated data-quality checks with exception routing to data owners
  • Where it adds value, apply AI capabilities (e.g., Copilot Studio, AI Builder) to extract data from submitted documents, draft lessor summaries, or answer questions on scorecard status

4. Metrics and Reporting

  • Define the metric catalog with business stakeholders: KPI definitions, formulas, thresholds, and owners
  • Develop Power BI reports, including portfolio overview, lessor scorecard, trends, and drill-down
  • Configure email alerts and subscriptions for threshold breaches and periodic management packs
  • Build Power App views for operational users to submit, review, and act on scorecards

5. Monitoring and Access Control

  • Implement role-based access (workspace roles, Dataverse security roles, row-level security in Power BI)
  • Set up pipeline and refresh monitoring with failure alerts, plus usage and adoption tracking
  • Establish ALM with deployment pipelines (Dev → Test → Prod) and change control
  • Deliver documentation, runbooks, and knowledge transfer to Microsoft owners

Required Skills

  • Hands-on experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Power BI
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric (pipelines, dataflows, lakehouse/warehouse) and SQL
  • Strong data modeling skills, including star-schema design and DAX
  • Familiarity with Power Platform governance, security, and ALM practices
  • Ability to work directly with business stakeholders to define metrics and requirements

Salary: $85K/Annum

raw.description:
Who are Tyk, and what do we do?

The Tyk API Management platform is helping to drive the connected world and power new products and services. We’re changing the way that organisations connect any number of their systems and services. Whether internal, external, public or highly encrypted systems, Tyk helps businesses drive value across the retail, finance, telecoms, healthcare, or media industries (to name just a few!)

If you’ve banked online, used an app to check the news, or perhaps even driven a connected car, API’s, and by extension, Tyk, make that possible. Founded in 2015 with offices in London - UK, London - Ontario, Atlanta and Singapore, we have many thousands of users of our B2B platform across the globe. Brands using Tyk range from Lotte, Bell, T Mobile, to RBS, Capital One and Vinci. We have a varied user base hailing from every continent – even Antarctica.

Our Mission

Tyk is on a mission to connect every system in the world. We’ve started by building an API Management platform.

Total flexibility, default remote, radical responsibility

We offer unlimited paid holidays and remote working from anywhere in the world, for everyone, Why? Tyk was founded on the principle of offering flexibility and autonomy to our employees, we believe this allows our employees to achieve their best results. It also means we can build the best possible team, location and working hours are no barrier.

If this sounds like an environment that you believe could work for you then read on to find out more.

About the role

As a Senior Customer Success Engineer at Tyk, you'll be a strategic and technical leader within the Customer Success organization. The team owns traditional support, but this role goes well beyond reacting to issues. You'll help build a proactive Customer Success function focused on long-term customer trust, early risk detection, a better customer experience, and making sure customers get the most value from Tyk.

You'll lead high-priority and technically complex engagements, mentor Customer Success Engineers, and work with Engineering, Product and Account Management to turn customer challenges into improvements across the business.

Your focus is your region. You'll work alongside the Customer Success Engineers there to raise their technical understanding, share knowledge and close gaps, so the region handles more complex work independently.

A key part of the role is improving how the team operates. You'll build processes that strengthen customer relationships, improve technical delivery and let the team scale. You'll also champion AI across Customer Success: faster debugging and investigation, better knowledge sharing, and less repetitive work.

You're the person people turn to when things get complex, whether technical, customer-facing, operational or cross-functional.

Key responsibilities

Escalation management

  • Proactively oversee the Zendesk queue, making sure SLAs are met and stepping in on critical escalations.
  • Act as an escalation point for systemic issues, leading incident resolution. Escalations come to you before going to Product.
  • Work with Senior and Principal engineers across regions to resolve recurring support workflow challenges.
  • Guide triage practices so issues are isolated quickly and accurately across the team.

Mentorship and team development

  • Coach and mentor Customer Success Engineers in your region on technical depth, customer engagement, ownership and handling complex situations independently.
  • Set a high standard for technical quality, communication, accountability and customer ownership.
  • Flag capability gaps to Customer Success leadership and help close them through training, documentation and hiring input.
  • Support engineers through complex cases while building their confidence to lead them independently.
  • Foster a culture of learning, knowledge sharing, collaboration and constructive feedback.

Proactive customer engagement

  • Build trusted relationships with key Enterprise customers through regular account syncs, acting as their senior technical partner.
  • Lead onboardings and regular syncs for Enterprise customers, whose complex environments need senior-level judgement. Onboardings are completed to the checklist.
  • Partner with Account Management to spot customer risk, recurring pain points and opportunities before they become escalations.
  • Help improve proactive engagement processes, so the team builds relationships rather than only answering tickets.

Technical excellence and innovation

  • Lead deep technical investigations, including complex debugging and source code analysis.
  • Innersourcing is strongly encouraged: contribute bug fixes, small features or workarounds to the product to unblock customers, and help other engineers do the same.
  • Build and adopt tools, automation and AI to reduce response and resolution time.
  • Maintain ticket quality, so Product receives actionable, high-quality submissions.
  • Anticipate platform-wide issues and prevent them through architecture awareness.
  • Keep critical knowledge documented: the Zendesk knowledge base, debugging guides and external documentation.

Operations and cross-team collaboration

  • Meet escalation SLAs and play a key role in the on-call rotation for 24/7 global support.
  • Own high-severity incidents and critical customer escalations.
  • Review team metrics regularly and help set team goals and focus areas.
  • Represent Customer Success in company initiatives, and help evolve support policies such as SLAs, escalation procedures and "won't fix" standards.

Voice of the customer and long-term impact

  • Contribute evidenced trends to the monthly Voice of the Customer digest to Product.
  • Lead root cause analysis and post-mortems for major incidents from the Customer Success side.
  • Reduce ticket volume by finding recurring pain points and proposing durable fixes in the platform or documentation.
  • Help evolve support strategy as Tyk grows, influencing structure, tooling and hiring.

Requirements

What we're looking for

Job Description Summary

For over forty years, HarbourVest has been home to a committed team of professionals with an entrepreneurial spirit and a desire to deliver impactful solutions to our clients and investing partners. As our global firm grows, we continue to add individuals who seek a collaborative, open-door culture that values diversity and innovative thinking.


In our collegial environment that’s marked by low turnover and high energy, you’ll be inspired to grow and thrive. Here, you will be encouraged to build on your strengths and acquire new skills and experiences.


We are committed to fostering an environment of inclusion that promotes mutual respect among all employees. Understanding and valuing these differences optimizes the potential of both the individual and the firm.

HarbourVest is an equal opportunity employer.


This position will be a fully remote work arrangement based in California.


The Vice President, Investor Relations will drive the growth of our US West Coast institutional client base by deepening relationships with current investors and securing new client commitments. This individual will contribute significantly to capital raising across our global investment platform. The Vice President will partner closely with internal teams—investor relations associates, product specialists, investment professionals, marketing, and product management—as well as the Global Consultant Relations team to reinforce bonds with key U.S.-based field consultants. This position reports to the Managing Director, LatAm and US West Coast Institutional Investor Relations.


The ideal candidate is someone who is:

  • Collaborative: Actively listens and engages with others to improve client outcomes, fostering a team-oriented environment.
  • Proactive: Drives capital raising initiatives by pinpointing and engaging with potential investors.
  • Pragmatic: Quickly assesses situations, both internal and external, and makes informed decisions based on gathered and analyzed information.
  • Data-driven – Strong focus on straightforward reporting of their own activities, ensuring accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Innovative: Actively listens to client needs and crafts tailored processes to align HarbourVest's resources with those needs. Provides valuable feedback and insights to improve or develop strategies and solutions that meet evolving client requirements.

What you will do:

Investor Relations & Capital Raising

  • Build a solid understanding of the designated territory and institutional client group
  • Develop a solid grasp of the full range of product offerings, and ability to clearly articulate the HarbourVest story
  • Raise capital from Western US institutional investors across commingled funds and customized accounts
  • Identify and seek out new business opportunities with sophisticated investors spanning various client segments, including pensions, endowments, foundations, healthcare systems, insurers, single-family offices.
  • Expand and manage client relationships, including ongoing communication, relationship mapping, and strategic engagement
  • Coordinate efforts alongside the Global Consultant Relations team to establish and cultivate collaborative partnerships with field consultants

Client Engagement & Outreach

  • Disciplined and creative outreach approach and follow up, using available tools such as AI/CoPilot
  • Schedule and attend investor meetings, conference calls, roadshows, and industry events
  • On a weekly basis, update and maintain accurate CRM (Salesforce) records of investor interactions
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to build and complete targeted outreach campaigns

Operational & Marketing Support

  • Oversee the coordination and completion of Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and Due Diligence Questionnaires (DDQs)
  • Partner with internal team members to ensure timely delivery of customized client materials and responses
  • Provide feedback to marketing and product teams to enhance messaging and collateral

What you bring:

  • Ability to prioritize prospects and cross-sell opportunities for targeted outreach.
  • Ability to discern publicly available data on investor portfolios and key contacts to craft targeted outreach
  • Demonstrated business development approach across client segments and the region, with connections to both large and mid-sized institutions in the Western US.
  • Demonstrated success in developing new relationships with institutional investors and single-family offices across multiple private markets. Proven track record of cross-selling and growing existing relationships.
  • Experience in preparing and leading strategy or topical roadshows and small group events, including content creation, speaker preparation, and post-event follow-ups.
  • Extensive knowledge of the private markets environment, including private equity, private credit, and real assets/infrastructure. Solid awareness of competitor products and changing market dynamics.
  • Ability to work independently to source, conduct diligence, and follow-up with potential investors while also being collaborative and transparent with key collaborators at the Firm
  • Problem-solving attitude and willingness to roll up sleeves to assist colleagues and clients
  • Outstanding written and presentation skills.

Education Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree (B.A./B.S.) or equivalent professional experience

Experience

8-12 years of institutional sales experience within the asset management industry with a preference for private markets.


Base Salary Range:

$190,000.00 - $200,000.00

This USD base salary range represents only one component of total compensation for this role and is provided in accordance with local requirements. This role is eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, which is determined based on individual and overall firm performance. In addition to salary and bonus eligibility, total compensation may include participation in long-term reward programs (typically for more senior-level roles).
